https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.summary: In a statement, Macalintal stressed that passing the task of rescheduling the BSKE should the Supreme Court rule in his favor would be a “mockery of justice” and effectively reward Congress alleged abuse of discretion in postponing the polls. Macalintal, in his 19-page motion for partial reconsideration filed Tuesday night, urged the high tribunal to reconsider its ruling postponing the BSKE and direct the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to hold the polls at the earliest feasible date.
https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.summary_zh: 在一份声明中，Macalintal 强调，如果最高法院裁定 BSKE 改期任务应交由其负责，那么此举将是“对司法的嘲弄”，并会实质上奖励国大党被指滥用裁量权、推迟选举的行为。Macalintal 于周二晚提交了一份19页的部分复议动议，敦促最高法院重新考虑推迟 BSKE 的裁定，并指示选举委员会（Comelec）尽早可行日期举行投票。
https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.body: In a statement, Macalintal stressed that passing the task of rescheduling the BSKE should the Supreme Court rule in his favor would be a “mockery of justice” and effectively reward Congress alleged abuse of discretion in postponing the polls. “This grants the legislature unchecked power over election scheduling,” he said. “For instance, if a postponement law is enacted just days before the scheduled polls—leaving virtually no time to question its constitutionality—the public is left without recourse. READ: BSKE delay: Macalintal cites public outrage in bid to flip SC decision The veteran lawyer pointed out that putting a court-ordered election in the hands of the lawmakers would result in further postponement of the election. Macalintal, in his 19-page motion for partial reconsideration filed Tuesday night, urged the high tribunal to reconsider its ruling postponing the BSKE and direct the Commission on Elections (Comelec) to hold the polls at the earliest feasible date. He said the majority of the high tribunal, voting 9-5, “gravely erred” in allowing the deferment of the BSKE as a “mere incident,” setting the term of office at five years. Macalintal initially challenged Republic Act No. 12326, the law that moved the polls to Nov. 13, 2028, from the original date of Nov. 2 this year. After filing Macalintal’s motion, Comelec Chair George Garcia said the poll body no longer has the mandate to reschedule the polls once 30 days have passed since the original election date. Macalintal said precedent shows that immediate Comelec action, not intervention from Congress, is required, as in the Supreme Court’s ruling in Hagedorn v. House of Representatives. “The court emphasized that conducting a special election within 60 days of a vacancy is a primary power and duty of the Comelec, and waiting for formal legislative declarations causes unnecessary delay,” he said, citing the 2025 decision on the case. “I appreciate Chairman Garcia bringing up this position, as it reinforces my resolve to ask the Supreme Court to reconsider its stance and set my motion for partial reconsideration for oral arguments,” he added. /mr
https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.title_zh: 最高法院申请人：重排BSKE考试日程是选举委员会的决定，而非国会的决定
https://www.inquirer.net/495575/sc-petit.body_zh: 在一份声明中，Macalintal强调，如果最高法院裁定支持他的诉求，将重新安排菲律宾基层公务员和服务员考试（BSKE）的任务交由他人负责将是“对司法公正的嘲弄”，并会实际纵容国会被指滥用裁量权、推迟考试。他说：“这赋予立法机构不受制约的选举安排权。例如，如果在原定考试日期前仅有数日便通过一项推迟法律——几乎没有时间质疑其合宪性——公众将无处寻求救济。阅读：BSKE延期：Macalintal援引公众愤怒，企图推翻最高法院裁决。这位资深律师指出，把法院下令举行的考试交由立法者掌控，将导致考试进一步延期。Macalintal于周二晚提交一份长达19页、请求部分重新审议的动议，敦促最高法院重新审议推迟BSKE的裁决，并指示选举委员会（Comelec）在最早可行日期举行考试。他说，最高法院以9比5表决形成的多数意见允许将BSKE延期，将其视为一个“次要附带事项”，并将任期设定为5年，属于“严重错误”。Macalintal最初对《共和国法》第12326号提出挑战，该法将考试日期由今年的11月2日推迟至2028年11月13日。Macalintal提交动议后，选举委员会主席George Garcia表示，自原定选举日期过去30天后，选举委员会便不再拥有重新安排考试的授权。Macalintal说，先例表明，应立即采取行动的是选举委员会，而非等待国会介入，正如最高法院在Hagedorn诉众议院案中的裁决一样。他援引该案2025年的判决称：“法院强调，在空缺出现后60天内举行特别选举是选举委员会的一项主要权力和职责，而等待正式的立法声明会造成不必要的延迟。”他说：“我很感谢Garcia主席提出这一立场，因为这增强了我请求最高法院重新审议其立场的决心，并请求就我的部分重新审议动议进行口头辩论。”/mr

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国产业部表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张局势的背景下，韩国政府周五连续第五个周期维持燃油产品最高限价不变。自6月26日下调后，政府已将最高限价维持在当前水平20周。政府于3月中旬推出燃油最高限价，旨在稳定因美伊战争在中东引发的供应链中断而出现波动的国内燃油价格。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: The Korean government on Friday kept its price caps on fuel products unchanged for a fifth consecutive period amid elevated international oil prices and continued tensions in the Middle East, the industry ministry said. The maximum prices at which local refiners can supply gasoline, diesel and kerosene to gas stations will remain unchanged at 1,784 won ($1.3), 1,773 won and 1,380 won per liter, respectively, for the four weeks beginning Saturday, according to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources. The government has kept the caps at their current levels for 20 weeks since June 27, following a reduction on June 26. "International oil prices fell below $100 per barrel, with Brent crude reaching $96 per barrel on Nov. 12. However, the price remains more than $20 higher than at the end of June," the ministry said. The freeze is aimed at easing upward pressure on consumer prices amid elevated oil prices and high ocean freight costs, it added. The government introduced the fuel price caps in mid-March to stabilize domestic fuel prices amid supply chain disruptions stemming from the U.S.-Iran war in the Middle East. It plans to adjust the emergency measures as necessary while closely monitoring developments in the Middle East and economic conditions at home
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.title_zh: 中东局势紧张之际，首尔冻结燃油价格上限
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，在国际油价高企和中东地区持续紧张的背景下，连续第五个周期维持燃油产品价格上限不变。根据韩国贸易、工业和资源部消息，自周六起四周内，本地炼油商向加油站供应汽油、柴油和煤油的最高价格将分别维持在每升1,784韩元（1.3美元）、1,773韩元和1,380韩元。自6月26日下调价格上限以来，政府已连续20周将上限维持在当前水平。该部称：“国际油价已跌破每桶100美元，布伦特原油在11月12日降至每桶96美元。然而，油价仍比6月底高出20多美元。”该部补充称，冻结价格上限旨在缓解油价高企和海运费高企给消费者价格带来的上行压力。政府于3月中旬推出燃油价格上限，以稳定因美伊战争在中东引发供应链中断而上涨的国内燃油价格。政府计划在密切监测中东局势和国内经济状况的同时，必要时对这些紧急措施作出调整。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title: Ex-vice minister brings Shakespeare to life with AI music
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 前官员推出商会民谣专辑，改编经典十四行诗。前文化、体育和旅游副部长 Yong Ho-seong 正利用人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启艺术生涯大胆崭新的篇章。他借助 AI 辅助作曲和演唱，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力，共推出10张唱片。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: Former official drops chamber folk album adapting classic sonnets Yong Ho-seong, former vice minister of culture, sports and tourism, is stepping into a bold new chapter of his creative life by using artificial intelligence (AI) technology to set classical literature to music. Performing under the stage name Dr. Dragon, Yong released his debut full-length album, "Fragile Beauty," on Nov. 10, breathing contemporary musical life into 15 of William Shakespeare's sonnets through AI-assisted composition and vocals. The release marks the first installment of "DiVerse," an ambitious ongoing project to set all 154 of Shakespeare's sonnets to modern music. The idea was sparked by a hardcover edition of Shakespeare's complete sonnets that a British friend gifted him during his tenure as director of the Korean Cultural Centre UK. "The name reflects both Shakespeare's original verse and the newly written lyrics, as well as the diverse musical genres used to reimagine centuries-old classics," Yong told The Korea Times during an interview in Seoul, Thursday. The former vice minister explained that the album's sound production leans into late-1960s avant-garde folk and chamber folk, driven by nylon-string guitars, upright contrabass, cellos, violas, flutes, harmoniums and bass clarinets, while featuring the contralto tones of his AI vocal persona NikkiD. "Rather than big, sweeping arrangements, the quiet, intimate sound of late-1960s chamber folk felt like the right fit for these poems," Yong said. Yong’s journey into music creation is rooted in a lifelong passion. Long before entering government service, he studied classical music and jazz extensively and built a massive personal collection of over 10,000 records. While serving as a government official, he also debuted as a music critic in 1993 after winning an annual music criticism competition hosted by the prominent performing arts magazine Auditorium. He has also spent decades playing drums in jazz and rock bands. After retiring from his career as a high-ranking bureaucrat last year — during which he played a pivotal role in establishing major cultural institutions and drafting key legislation — Yong turned his sights toward AI. In July, he won the AI.LOVE.JAZZ. composition competition in Montreux, Switzerland, with "Frozen Edge," a vocal jazz piece inspired by Shakespeare's Sonnet 97. For Yong, AI is not a replacement for human artistry, but an essential creative tool. "AI is a loyal assistant that expands the possibilities of songwriting and production," the creator said. "I write detailed prompts spanning a full page to specify rhythm, instrumentation and musical references, and sometimes regenerate a track 30 or 40 times before editing individual tracks myself until I find the exact sound I envision." Comparing AI to the historical introduction of digital sampling in popular music decades ago in the 1980s, the former official believes that technology ultimately broadens the base of music creators rather than diminishing human value. Rather than requiring years of formal composition training, individuals with a clear artistic perspective can now use these tools to bring their musical concepts to life, he added. "Just like sampling decades ago, AI acts as a faithful assistant that expands the pool of people who can create music, making the process far more efficient for everyone," Yong said. Looking ahead, he envisions how this collaborative approach could even transform traditional education by allowing students to turn personal stories and daily emotions into original songs. "When students learn to turn their daily experiences into melodies, music becomes a powerful tool for self-expression," Yong said. Following the release of "Fragile Beauty," Yong plans to issue a new sonnet-inspired album every month, spanning genres from jazz and blues to hip-hop, rap-metal and K-pop. He has already reached out to various Shakespeare-related societies, associations and academic institutions around the world to explore educational and cultural collaborations. He is also developing progressive rock operas based on Shakespeare's tragedies, such as "Hamlet" and "Macbeth," alongside a project reinterpreting the poetry of Joseon Dynasty poet Yi Mae-chang (1573-1610). "Just as I am reimagining Shakespeare, I wanted to bring the poignant and soul-searching poetry of Yi Mae-chang into contemporary folk and blues," Yong said. While the former vice minister devotes up to six hours a day to composing and two hours of practicing drums, Yong said his creative ventures are fueled by personal fulfillment rather than commercial success. He recently earned his first-ever revenue as a musician by composing a theme song for T&C Foundation, a public interest foundation, though the ex-official primarily views his creative output as a natural extension of a well-prepared second act in life. "For me, happiness is not about the high intensity of achievements, but the frequency of joyful moments," Yong said. "Whether it is practicing drums in the morning or giving classical literature a new voice through modern music, I am simply enjoying a life where I can freely explore what I love."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.title_zh: 前副部长借助人工智能音乐让莎士比亚鲜活起来
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body_zh:
前官员发行室内民谣专辑，以人工智能改编古典十四行诗
前文化、体育和旅游部副部长龙浩成正以人工智能（AI）技术为古典文学谱曲，开启创意人生的大胆新篇章。他以艺名“Dragon博士”演出，11月10日发行首张完整专辑《脆弱之美》，通过人工智能辅助作曲和人声演绎，为威廉·莎士比亚的15首十四行诗注入当代音乐生命力。这次发行是“DiVerse”计划的第一部分；该雄心勃勃的持续项目旨在将莎士比亚全部154首十四行诗谱成现代音乐。这一构想源于一位英国朋友在他担任韩国文化中心英国主任期间送给他的《莎士比亚十四行诗全集》精装版。龙浩成周四在首尔接受《韩国时报》采访时表示：“这个名字既反映莎士比亚的原诗，也体现新创作的歌词，以及重新演绎百年经典时采用的多样音乐类型。”这位前副部长介绍，专辑的声音制作以20世纪60年代末的前卫民谣和室内民谣为主，由尼龙弦吉他、立式低音提琴、大提琴、中提琴、长笛、风琴和低音单簧管支撑，并展现其人工智能人声形象NikkiD的女中音音色。龙浩成说：“与宏大、层层铺陈的编曲相比，20世纪60年代末室内民谣安静而亲密的声音，更适合这些诗。”
龙浩成投身音乐创作，源于一生的热爱。早在进入政府部门之前，他就广泛学习古典音乐和爵士乐，并收藏了1万多张唱片。担任政府官员期间，他还在1993年赢得知名表演艺术杂志《Auditorium》主办的一年一度音乐评论比赛，首次以乐评人身份登台。他还花了数十年时间在爵士和摇滚乐队中担任鼓手。去年从高级官僚职位退休——任职期间，他在建立重要文化机构和起草关键立法方面发挥了关键作用——后，龙浩成将目光转向人工智能。今年7月，他凭借受莎士比亚第97首十四行诗启发创作的声乐爵士作品《冰冻边缘》，在瑞士蒙特勒赢得AI.LOVE.JAZZ.作曲比赛。这位创作者表示，对龙浩成而言，人工智能不是人类艺术创作的替代品，而是一种不可或缺的创作工具。他说：“人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了歌曲创作和制作的可能性。我会写满整整一页的详细提示词，规定节奏、乐器配置和音乐参考，有时还会将一首曲子重新生成30或40次，再亲自编辑各个音轨，直到找到自己设想的确切声音。”
这位前官员将人工智能与20世纪80年代数字采样技术首次引入流行音乐作比较，认为技术最终拓宽了音乐创作者的群体，而非削弱人的价值。他补充说，人们不必再经过多年的正规作曲训练，只要拥有清晰的艺术视角，如今就能利用这些工具让音乐构想成为现实。龙浩成说：“就像几十年前的采样一样，人工智能是一名忠实的助手，扩大了能够创作音乐的人群，让每个人的创作过程都高效得多。”
展望未来，他设想这种协作方式甚至可以改变传统教育，让学生能够将个人故事和日常感受转化为原创歌曲。龙浩成说：“当学生学会把日常经历化为旋律时，音乐就成为自我表达的强大工具。”继《脆弱之美》发行后，龙浩成计划每月推出一张受十四行诗启发的专辑，涵盖爵士、布鲁斯、嘻哈、说唱金属和K-pop等多种风格。他还联系了世界各地与莎士比亚有关的社团、协会和学术机构，探讨教育与文化合作。他也在根据莎士比亚的悲剧创作前卫摇滚歌剧，如《哈姆雷特》和《麦克白》，同时推进一个重新诠释朝鲜王朝诗人李梅昌（1573—1610）诗歌的项目。龙浩成说：“就像我重新演绎莎士比亚一样，我也希望把李梅昌那些动人、直击灵魂的诗歌带入当代民谣和布鲁斯。”
这位前副部长每天最多投入六小时作曲，并花两小时练习鼓乐。龙浩成说，他的创作动力来自个人满足感，而非商业成功。他最近通过为公益基金会T&C Foundation创作主题曲，首次获得音乐人生的第一笔收入；但这位前官员主要把自己的创作成果视为充分准备的人生第二幕的自然延伸。龙浩成说：“对我来说，快乐不在于成就的高强度，而在于欢乐时刻的频率。无论是清晨练鼓，还是通过现代音乐为古典文学赋予新声，我只是在享受一种能够自由探索所爱之物的生活。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Fresh uncertainties surrounding artificial intelligence (AI) investments following the US midterms could provide a "golden opportunity" for Korea, a high-level science ministry official said Wednesday. Second Vice Science Minister Ryu Je-myung made the remarks at a congratulatory address during an AI conference hosted by the ministry in Seoul as he mentioned growing concerns in the United States that the incoming Democratic Congress could tighten regulations on AI and data centers. "There are observations that market uncertainty could increase amid potential changes in the investment environment for AI and data centers (following the US midterms)," Ryu said at the event. "It (actually) provides a golden opportunity to narrow our gap with leading countries and secure overwhelming national AI competitiveness through aggressive and speedy investments and technological innovation," he added. To that end, the government is considering doubling the amount of funding for the AI sector to around 9.4 trillion won next year, he said. "South Korea is a major research and development powerhouse, whose funding for the R&D sector accounts for over 5 percent of the country's gross domestic product," Ryu pointed out. Meanwhile, markets have been rattled with worries that the Democrats' sweeping victory in the US midterm elections could lead to a slowdown in the building of AI data centers. Such fears have sent the tech-heavy Nasdaq down by more than 5 percent. Local semiconductor giants suffered as well, with Samsung Electronics and SK hynix both shedding over 3 percent, following the election results

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 一位高级科学部门官员周三表示，美国中期选举后围绕人工智能投资出现的新不确定性，可能为韩国提供“黄金机遇”。第二科学技术次官柳在明在首尔举行的一场人工智能会议上致贺辞时表示，美国日益担心新一届民主党国会可能收紧对人工智能和数据中心的监管。他说：“有观点认为，在美国中期选举后，人工智能和数据中心投资环境可能发生变化，市场不确定性随之加剧。这实际上为我们提供了缩小与领先国家差距的黄金机遇，通过积极、快速的投资和技术创新，确立压倒性的国家人工智能竞争力。”他补充说，为实现这一目标，政府正考虑明年将人工智能领域的资助金额翻倍，增加至约9.4万亿韩元。柳指出：“韩国是重要的研发强国，研发领域的资助额占国内生产总值的5%以上。”与此同时，市场因担忧民主党在美国中期选举中取得压倒性胜利可能拖慢人工智能数据中心建设而受到冲击。这些担忧已令科技股占比较高的纳斯达克指数下跌逾5%。选举结果公布后，本地半导体巨头也遭受重创，Samsung Electronics和SK hynix的股价均下跌逾3%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: Google complies with Korea's security requirements for high-precision map data: gov't
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google已经遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是获准向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了Google落实安全措施的情况。该机构曾于2月有条件批准Google出口比例尺为1:5000的数字地图数据。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The Korean government said Friday that Google has complied with security requirements imposed as a condition for allowing the transfer of high-precision map data overseas. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said a government-led consultation body reviewed Google's implementation of security measures following its conditional approval in February to export 1:5,000-scale digital map data. The review found that the global tech giant had implemented measures to prevent the exposure of geographic coordinates, as well as sensitive military and security facilities, on its global Google Maps and Google Earth services, including web and mobile platforms. To meet the requirements, Google developed a dedicated control system for Korea and introduced safeguards to block app updates if they risk exposing restricted geographic coordinates. In August, Google also signed an agreement to obtain satellite imagery processed for security purposes by the National Geographic Information Institute (NGII) through a local partner. Google is said to have chosen the local navigation company, TMAP Mobility, to process base map data, according to industry sources. Under the agreement, Google must replace existing imagery on its map services as soon as it receives the security-processed images, without making any modifications. Currently, Naver Map, operated by the local portal giant Naver Corp., is the most widely used service in the country, with monthly active users of 31.2 million in October, according to data from market tracker Mobile Index. TMAP came next with 15.1 monthly active users, followed by Kakao Map with 13.8 million users and Google Map with 10.5 million users locally
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国政府：Google遵守韩国对高精度地图数据的安全要求
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国政府周五表示，Google 已遵守相关安全要求；这些要求是允许其向海外传输高精度地图数据的附加条件。国土交通部表示，政府牵头的咨询机构审查了 Google 在2月获准出口比例尺为1:5,000的数字地图数据后所采取安全措施的落实情况。审查发现，这家全球科技巨头已在旗下 Google Maps 和 Google Earth 服务（包括网页端和移动端）实施相关措施，防止泄露地理坐标以及敏感的军事和安全设施。为满足有关要求，Google 为韩国开发了一套专用控制系统，并设置安全防护机制，在应用更新可能暴露受限地理坐标时予以阻止。今年8月，Google 还签署了一项协议，将通过一家本地合作伙伴获取由国家地理信息院（NGII）出于安全目的处理的卫星图像。据行业消息人士称，Google 选择了本地导航企业 TMAP Mobility 处理基础地图数据。根据该协议，Google 在收到经过安全处理的图像后，必须立即替换其地图服务中的现有图像，且不得作任何修改。据市场追踪机构 Mobile Index 的数据，目前由本地门户网站巨头 Naver Corp. 运营的 Naver Map 是韩国使用最广泛的服务，10月月活跃用户达到3120万。TMAP 以1510万月活跃用户紧随其后，Kakao Map 和 Google Map 在当地的月活跃用户分别为1380万和1050万

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Lawmaker seeks $4.9 mil. budget to detect AI smart glasses cheating
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Korean government is stepping up efforts to crack down on cheating involving artificial intelligence (AI)-powered smart glasses, as concerns spread beyond the annual college entrance exam to national licensing tests, with even top scorers facing suspicions of misconduct.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国政府正加大力度，打击利用人工智能（AI）智能眼镜作弊的行为。相关担忧已从年度大学入学考试蔓延至国家资格考试，甚至连高分考生也受到不端行为嫌疑的审查。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Korean government is stepping up efforts to crack down on cheating involving artificial intelligence (AI)-powered smart glasses, as concerns spread beyond the annual college entrance exam to national licensing tests, with even top scorers facing suspicions of misconduct. However, concerns are also emerging that widespread suspicions, even without concrete evidence, could undermine public trust in the fairness of exams. While authorities have pledged zero tolerance for cheating ahead of the College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT), growing allegations involving high scorers in other major exams have prompted the government to seek additional funding for electronic signal detectors and dedicated personnel to prevent high-tech cheating. According to the National Assembly, Friday, Rep. Kim Wi-sang of the main opposition People Power Party has proposed an additional 6.57 billion won ($4.92 million) in next year's budget to crack down on cheating involving AI-powered smart glasses and other high-tech devices in national licensing exams. The proposal comes after the growing use of such devices for cheating drew scrutiny during a recent parliamentary audit. The Human Resources Development Service of Korea, which oversees national licensing exams, estimated the funding needed to introduce detection equipment and deploy additional monitoring personnel. While no separate budget was allocated for such measures this year, mounting concerns over high-tech cheating have prompted efforts to tighten exam security. As of the end of October, six cases of cheating involving smart glasses had been detected in national licensing exams held this year. The Ministry of Education and the Prime Minister's Office have also pledged zero tolerance for cheating following a series of incidents during essay-based college entrance exams, warning that such misconduct threatens the fairness of the admissions process. The education ministry warned that students caught using smart glasses to cheat on the CSAT could be barred from taking the exam for up to three years and face criminal charges. Meanwhile, suspicions of cheating involving AI-powered smart glasses continue to emerge across various national exams, fueling calls to overhaul traditional paper-based testing methods and exam monitoring systems. However, concerns are also growing over excessive allegations of cheating, particularly against high scorers without concrete evidence of misconduct. A top scorer on the certified tax accountant exam held in April became the center of controversy after answering 159 out of 160 questions correctly, earning 397.5 out of 400 points. Some fellow test takers and practicing tax accountants questioned whether such a score was achievable within the time limit, raising suspicions that the candidate had used AI-powered smart glasses to cheat. However, an investigation found no evidence to support the suspicions. Similar suspicions have also been directed at the first person to achieve a perfect score across all sections of the Law School Admission Test (LEET) since its introduction 19 years ago, with some online users questioning whether the record-breaking result was achieved through cheating with smart devices. The individual, who went from achieving Grade 7 — on a nine-grade scale where Grade 1 is the highest — to earning a perfect score in the Korean language section of the 2026 college entrance exam, said they had taken the LEET to test the effectiveness of their study methods. As unsubstantiated cheating allegations continued to spread, the top scorer announced plans to solve the Korean language section of the 2027 CSAT, scheduled for Thursday, live on YouTube to demonstrate their abilities and address the suspicions
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国政府正加大力度打击利用人工智能（AI）智能眼镜作弊的行为。随着相关担忧从年度大学入学考试蔓延至国家资格考试，就连高分考生也受到作弊嫌疑。不过People Power Party主要反对党议员金Wi-sang周五表示，其他重大考试中涉及高分考生的指控不断出现，促使政府寻求追加资金，用于购置电子信号探测器及配备专职人员，防止国家资格考试中利用高科技手段作弊。据韩国国会介绍，金Wi-sang已提议在明年的预算中追加657亿韩元（$4.92 million），用于打击国家资格考试中利用AI智能眼镜及其他高科技设备作弊的行为。此前，近期一次国会审计对这些设备在作弊中的日益广泛使用展开审查。负责监管国家资格考试的韩国人力资源开发院估算，引入检测设备和增派监察人员所需资金约为这一数额。尽管今年没有为这些措施单独安排预算，但围绕高科技作弊日益加剧的担忧促使各方加大考试安保力度。截至10月底，今年举行的国家资格考试中已发现6起利用智能眼镜作弊的案件。继一系列基于论文写作的大学入学考试发生作弊事件后，韩国教育部和总统办公室也承诺对作弊行为零容忍，并警告称，此类不当行为将威胁招生考试的公平性。教育部警告，被查出利用智能眼镜在韩国大学修业能力试验（CSAT）中作弊的考生，最长3年内可能被禁止参加考试，并可能面临刑事指控。与此同时，在各类国家考试中，利用AI智能眼镜作弊的嫌疑持续出现，推动外界要求全面改革传统纸笔考试方式和考试监考制度。然而，针对作弊的过度指控也引发更多担忧，尤其是针对缺乏具体不当行为证据的高分考生。4月举行的税务士考试中，一名高分考生因160道题答对159道、获得400分中的397.5分而成为争议焦点。一些同行考生和执业税务士质疑，该分数是否能在规定时间内取得，由此引发该考生利用AI智能眼镜作弊的嫌疑。然而，调查未发现支持这些指控的证据。类似嫌疑也指向韩国法学院入学考试（LEET）自创设19年来首个各部分均获满分的考生，一些网络用户质疑这一创纪录成绩是否借助智能设备作弊取得。这名考生原先在九级评分制中获得7级——其中1级为最高等级——随后在2026年大学入学考试的韩国语文科目中取得满分，并表示参加LEET是为了检验其学习方法的成效。随着缺乏依据的作弊指控持续蔓延，这名高分考生宣布，定于周四举行的2027年CSAT将全程在YouTube直播解答韩国语文试题，以展示自身能力并回应外界质疑……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Senior officials of South Korea and the U.N. Office for Disarmament Affairs (UNODA) held a meeting Friday and discussed North Korea's nuclear program and the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) in the military domain, the foreign ministry said. The meeting between Vice Foreign Minister for Strategy and Intelligence Jeong Yeon-doo and U.N. High Representative for Disarmament Affairs Izumi Nakamitsu took place on the sidelines of the two-day Korea-U.N. Conference on Disarmament and Nonproliferation, held in Seoul from Thursday. During the talks, the two sides exchanged views on the situation on the Korean Peninsula and the North Korean nuclear issue, the outcomes of the U.N. General Assembly's First Committee and ways to deepen cooperation between South Korea and the UNODA. During the conference, Jeong stressed the need for international cooperation to promote the responsible use of AI in the military domain while addressing related challenges. He also said South Korea would continue to play an active role in the field, noting that it had spearheaded a U.N. General Assembly resolution on military AI and co-hosted a relevant summit with the Netherlands. Nakamitsu warned that rapid advances in AI and other technologies could expose new vulnerabilities and increase the risks of miscalculation and unintended escalation. The official stressed that international law must be observed at every stage of AI development and use, and that humans must retain control and responsibility for decisions involving AI. She also outlined such priorities as developing policies based on technical expertise and finding appropriate forums for dialogue, the ministry said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国与联合国讨论朝鲜核问题和军事人工智能
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国高级官员与联合国裁军事务办公室（UNODA）官员于周五举行会面，讨论朝鲜核计划以及在军事领域负责任地使用人工智能（AI）。韩国外交部表示，此次会面于周四在首尔举行的为期两天的韩国—联合国裁军与不扩散会议期间进行。会面双方是负责战略与情报事务的副外长郑铉斗与联合国裁军事务高级代表中西 izumi。会谈中，双方就朝鲜半岛局势、朝鲜核问题、联合国大会第一委员会的工作成果，以及深化韩国与联合国裁军事务办公室合作的方式交换了意见。在会议期间，郑铉斗强调，需要通过国际合作推动在军事领域负责任地使用人工智能，同时应对相关挑战。他还表示，韩国将继续在这一领域发挥积极作用，并指出韩国牵头制定了关于军事人工智能的联合国大会决议，还与荷兰共同主持了一场相关峰会。中西警告称，人工智能及其他技术的迅速进展可能暴露新的薄弱环节，增加误判和意外升级的风险。这位官员强调，在人工智能开发和使用 的每个阶段都必须遵守国际法，涉及人工智能的决策必须由人类掌控并承担责任。外交部称，中西还概述了若干重点任务，包括根据技术专业知识制定政策，以及寻找适当的对话论坛。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: Employees struggle to communicate with suppliers, access shared work files A global Microsoft outage disrupted operations at major Korean companies on Friday, leaving some employees unable to access emails, coordinate with business partners and manage daily workflows as the tech giant struggled to restore its systems. Some major companies sent urgent companywide notices alerting employees about the outage and asking them to check which Microsoft services were affected.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 员工难以与供应商沟通，也无法访问共享工作文件。全球性Microsoft系统故障于周五扰乱了韩国大型企业的运营。随着这家科技巨头竭力恢复系统，一些员工无法访问电子邮件、与业务合作伙伴协调工作及管理日常工作流程。一些大型公司发布紧急的全公司通知，提醒员工系统故障情况，并要求他们查看哪些Microsoft服务受到影响。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Employees struggle to communicate with suppliers, access shared work files A global Microsoft outage disrupted operations at major Korean companies on Friday, leaving some employees unable to access emails, coordinate with business partners and manage daily workflows as the tech giant struggled to restore its systems. The disruption affected multiple Microsoft services, including its Outlook email, parts of its Teams messaging app, Microsoft 365 productivity tools and Copilot artificial intelligence (AI) assistant. While the impact varied by company depending on the services used, some employees were forced to postpone work or turn to alternative communication channels. Some major companies sent urgent companywide notices alerting employees about the outage and asking them to check which Microsoft services were affected. Some companies also circulated email notices identifying services that were unavailable. An information technology (IT) industry official said employees had turned to other messaging apps to keep some work moving but the workaround offered only limited relief. “Since we cannot use email, we are exchanging files through messaging apps. But some files cannot be sent that way, so certain tasks are on hold,” the official said. “We also cannot access shared calendars linked to employees’ schedules, which is inconvenient. For now, we’re focusing on tasks we can work on with the materials available.” The disruption was particularly severe for businesses that rely on Microsoft's cloud-based collaboration tools. A retail industry official said the disruption left her team struggling to communicate with suppliers and coordinate work across departments, as email services and Microsoft's document management platform SharePoint became inaccessible. "We need to communicate with our business partners, but we cannot even check the emails we've received from them or who sent what. And even if I send an email through personal mail, if they use Outlook, they can’t check it at all," the official said. An official of a major business group said the outage had called into question Microsoft's reputation as a global IT giant and market leader. "As a company that prides itself on driving workplace productivity and efficiency, Microsoft should feel a greater sense of responsibility for leaving businesses and users around the world struggling with disruptions throughout the day due to flaws in its own quality and service management systems," the official said. Beyond questions of corporate responsibility, the outage could also expose Microsoft to potential compensation claims from affected businesses. "From a legal standpoint, a claim is certainly possible in theory. Even if there was no intent, negligence could still be established," said Lee Joo-heon, an attorney at law firm Songyul. However, he noted the challenge would be proving that the disruption caused measurable financial losses and determining how much compensation could be sought. "In Korea, damages are generally awarded in monetary form, so the amount of loss ultimately has to be calculated (financially)," Lee said. "For large companies, daily revenue does not necessarily decline simply because their operations are disrupted. The key will be determining how much damage they suffered over the hours they were affected." Asked whether Microsoft had compensation arrangements for affected customers, Microsoft Korea said the local office had not received any related information from its headquarters. "We have not received any information from our headquarters regarding compensation, so we have nothing further to share at this point," its official said. Downdetector, which tracks online service disruptions based on user reports, recorded over 138,000 reports of Outlook problems in the United States at its peak shortly after 1 p.m. on Thursday (local time). It said reports also surged in the United Kingdom, India and New Zealand, with nearly three in 10 reports coming from outside the U.S. during the first two hours of the disruption, as the outage spread to 74 countries and territories within roughly an hour of reports beginning to climb in the U.S. Microsoft said the outage was caused by some servers unexpectedly going offline, putting additional strain on the rest of its infrastructure, rather than by a surge in traffic and said it had found no evidence of a cyberattack. “We regret that today’s outages caused disruptions for our customers, and we are working to address the issue,” Charles Lamanna, Microsoft's executive vice president of Copilot, Agents and Platform, wrote on social media. “For now, I can confirm that there is no indication this is the result of malicious or cyber activity. The company said it was redistributing traffic across its global infrastructure and bringing affected servers back online to restore capacity. However, its initial recovery measures did not work as expected, prompting the company to explore alternative ways to increase capacity and address traffic imbalances. “We’ve monitored the status of the changes applied to improve serviceability and confirmed they're not taking as expected,” Microsoft said. “We’re identifying alternate workstreams that can be applied to increase capacity in the face of sustained traffic management imbalances.” The outage also disrupted integrations connecting OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI services to Microsoft's workplace tools, potentially limiting their ability to retrieve and work with business data. OpenAI said new connections through its Microsoft connectors could fail and that some tools were not working as expected. Anthropic reported failures affecting its Microsoft 365 connector, including access to email, SharePoint files, Teams chats and calendars, as well as difficulties establishing new connections
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 微软服务中断数小时，扰乱韩国企业日常运营
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 员工难以与供应商沟通，也无法访问共享工作文件。韩国大型企业的运营周五受到微软全球故障影响，一些员工无法访问电子邮件、协调业务伙伴并处理日常工作流程，这家科技巨头当时正努力恢复其系统。此次故障影响了多项微软服务，包括Outlook电子邮件、Teams即时通信应用的部分功能、Microsoft 365生产力工具以及Copilot人工智能（AI）助手。尽管各家公司所受影响的服务不同，但一些员工不得不推迟工作或改用其他通信渠道。一些大型企业发布了紧急的全公司通知，向员工告知故障情况，并要求他们查看哪些微软服务受到影响。一些公司还通过电子邮件发布通知，列明无法使用的服务。一位信息技术行业官员表示，员工已转用其他即时通信应用，以维持部分工作运转，但这种变通办法只能有限缓解问题。该官员说：“由于无法使用电子邮件，我们只能通过即时通信应用交换文件。但有些文件无法通过这种方式发送，因此某些任务只能暂停。我们也无法访问与员工日程关联的共享日历，这很不方便。目前，我们专注于利用现有材料能够开展的任务。”对于依赖微软云端协作工具的企业而言，此次故障造成的冲击尤为严重。一位零售行业官员表示，电子邮件服务和微软文档管理平台SharePoint均无法访问，故障使其团队难以与供应商沟通，也难以协调各部门工作。该官员说：“我们需要与业务伙伴沟通，但连他们发来的邮件以及是谁发送了什么都无法查看。即使我通过个人邮箱发送邮件，如果他们使用的是Outlook，也完全查看不到。”一家大型商业团体的官员表示，此次故障引发了外界对微软作为全球信息技术巨头和市场领导者的声誉质疑。该官员说：“微软是一家以推动职场生产力和效率为傲的公司，理应对其自身质量和服务管理系统的缺陷导致全球企业和用户全天遭受服务中断承担更大责任。”除企业责任问题外，此次故障还可能使微软面临受影响企业提出的赔偿诉求。Songyul律师事务所律师Lee Joo-heon说：“从法律角度看，理论上当然可以提出索赔。即使没有主观故意，仍可能认定存在过失。”不过，他指出，难点在于证明故障造成了可量化的经济损失，以及确定可以要求多少赔偿。Lee说：“在韩国，损害赔偿通常以金钱形式支付，因此最终必须对损失金额进行财务计算。对大公司而言，运营中断并不一定意味着每日营收下降。关键在于确定它们在受影响的这几个小时内遭受了多大损失。”当被问及微软是否为受影响客户安排了赔偿时，微软韩国表示，办事处尚未收到总部的任何相关信息。该公司的官员说：“我们尚未收到总部关于赔偿的任何信息，因此目前没有其他内容可分享。”根据用户报告追踪在线服务中断情况的Downdetector记录显示，周四（当地时间）下午1点后不久，美国出现了超过138,000份Outlook问题报告，达到峰值。该网站称，英国、印度和新西兰的报告数量也大幅上升；在故障发生后的最初两小时内，近十分之三的报告来自美国以外地区。故障蔓延至74个国家和地区及地区，从美国报告数量开始攀升算起大约只用了一个小时。微软表示，故障原因是一些服务器意外离线，给其余基础设施增加了压力，而非流量激增；公司没有发现网络攻击的证据。微软Copilot、Agents and Platform执行副总裁Charles Lamanna在社交媒体上写道：“今天的故障给客户造成了中断，我们对此深表歉意，并正努力解决这一问题。目前，我可以确认没有迹象表明这是恶意行为或网络攻击活动所致。公司表示，正在全球基础设施之间重新分配流量，并恢复受影响服务器上线，以恢复处理能力。然而，其初步恢复措施未达到预期效果，因此公司开始探索其他提高处理能力及解决流量失衡的方法。”微软表示：“我们已监测为提高可服务性而实施的状态调整，并确认这些调整未达到预期效果。我们正在确定替代工作流，以便在持续出现流量管理失衡的情况下提高处理能力。”此次故障还中断了OpenAI和Anthropic的AI服务与微软办公工具之间的集成，可能限制这些服务检索和处理业务数据的能力。OpenAI表示，通过其微软连接器建立的新连接可能失败，一些工具也未按预期运行。Anthropic报告称，其Microsoft 365连接器出现故障，影响了电子邮件、SharePoint文件、Teams聊天和日历的访问，也导致建立新连接时出现困难

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/ba.body: Woori Bank CEO Jung Jin-wan has secured a one-year extension of his term, becoming the first among the heads of Korea's five major commercial banks whose terms expire at the end of this year to win another term. Woori Financial Group said Friday that its subsidiary CEO recommendation committee decided to recommend Jung for an additional year, extending his term through Dec. 31, 2027. His reappointment is subject to final approval at a shareholders' meeting scheduled for later this month. Jung was initially appointed in November 2024 for a two-year term, with the possibility of a one-year extension based on his performance. Announcing the recommendation results, Woori Financial pointed to his efforts to strengthen the bank's capital position, expand its digital platform businesses and advance inclusive finance initiatives during his tenure. In particular, the group said Jung had raised Woori Bank's common equity Tier 1 capital ratio — which lagged behind those of rival lenders when he took office — to the second-highest level among commercial banks. Woori Financial also cited his efforts to strengthen the bank's long-term competitiveness, including plans to build an artificial intelligence data center and training facility in Namyangju, Gyeonggi Province. "After a comprehensive review, we concluded that Jung can turn the bank's strengthened capital position into business growth, restore profitability and narrow the gap with competitors during his additional year in office," an official from the recommendation committee said. Jung's reappointment comes as the terms of the other four major commercial bank CEOs — Lee Hwan-ju of KB Kookmin, Jung Sang-hyuk of Shinhan, Lee Ho-seoung of Hana and Kang Tae-young of NH NongHyup — are set to expire in December. Of the four banks, only Shinhan's CEO has previously been reappointed, having secured a second term after taking office in February 2023. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: Hoban weighs 3 scenarios: stake sale, takeover or board influence Hoban Group is facing a strategic dilemma over its next move in its ongoing ownership battle with Hanjin Group Chairman Cho Won-tae, as sharp swings in Hanjin KAL’s stock make it increasingly costly for either side to keep buying shares to maintain the top shareholder position. The stock has since become even more volatile.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: Hoban权衡三种方案：出售股份、收购或影响董事会。在与韩进集团会长赵元泰围绕公司控制权展开的持续争夺中，Hoban Group下一步面临战略抉择；随着韩进KAL股价大幅波动，双方继续买进股份以维持最大股东地位的成本越来越高。该股此后波动更加剧烈。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Hoban weighs 3 scenarios: stake sale, takeover or board influence Hoban Group is facing a strategic dilemma over its next move in its ongoing ownership battle with Hanjin Group Chairman Cho Won-tae, as sharp swings in Hanjin KAL’s stock make it increasingly costly for either side to keep buying shares to maintain the top shareholder position. Hoban became Hanjin KAL’s largest shareholder on Nov. 4 after increasing its stake to 20.69 percent, narrowly overtaking the 20.58 percent held by Cho and his affiliates. The shift followed a surge in Hanjin KAL shares. The stock has since become even more volatile. It hit a record high of 245,000 won on Tuesday before plunging to an intraday low of 185,000 won on Thursday and closing at 203,500 won on Friday. The sharp swings have added to the financial burden on both sides as they continue to accumulate shares in their battle for control. Hoban could negotiate with Cho around next year's annual shareholders meeting over whether to halt further purchases and participate in Hanjin KAL's board. If an agreement proves possible, Hoban could eventually sell its stake in a block deal to another investor, allowing it to realize a premium without continuing an expensive ownership battle. “The value of Hoban’s stake may ultimately be determined less by its ability to win a shareholder vote than by how much of a premium it can command in a potential block sale,” said Park Se-yeon, an analyst at Hanwha Investment & Securities. Cho has agreed to purchase another 325,000 shares, which could put his side back ahead once the transaction is settled until Jan. 1, 2027. Even then, Park estimates Hoban would need to acquire only about 0.37 percentage points more, worth roughly 46 billion won ($34.4 million) at current prices, to regain the top shareholder position. But repeatedly buying shares at elevated prices would require significant additional capital, making a prolonged contest increasingly costly for both sides. The third option is to use its stake to gain board influence. Hoban's more than 20 percent stake gives it considerable leverage in negotiations over board seats and major corporate decisions. This could allow the group to secure influence without bearing the full financial cost of taking control. The balance of voting power also complicates the race for the largest stake. Even if Hoban becomes the largest individual shareholder, combined stakes from Cho and his sides, such as Delta Air Lines, surpass those of the construction group by a huge margin. For Hoban, therefore, it is more important to build allies on Hanjin KAL’s board, rather than continuing to pursue the position as the largest shareholder. If Hoban Group seeks to gain greater management influence over Hanjin Group, Hanjin KAL's regular shareholders meeting in March could offer an opportunity to secure board seats, as the terms of three outside directors recommended by the Korea Development Bank are set to expire. “If Hoban shifts toward greater management participation, it could gain some representation on the board,” said Yang Seung-yoon, an analyst at Eugene Investment & Securities. “However, it remains a long way from securing a board majority and taking control of Korean Air. In the longer term, the key variable will be how the state-run lender handles its stake following the restructuring of the group, including the integration of its low-cost carriers.” Shares of Hanjin KAL sharply increased by around 8 percent during intraday trading, Friday, but returned most of the gains by closing at a gain of only 0.25 percent at the benchmark KOSPI. “Volatility is expected to persist through the end of the year, as Hoban and Cho remain locked in a neck-and-neck race for the top shareholder position,” an aviation industry official said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: [封面报道] 大韩航空股权争夺战推高股价溢价并加剧波动
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh:
Hoban权衡三种方案：出售持股、收购控制权或争取董事会影响力

Hoban Group正面临战略抉择。在与Hanjin Group董事长赵元泰围绕公司所有权展开的争夺中，随着Hanjin KAL股价剧烈波动，双方继续增持股份以维持第一大股东地位的成本越来越高。

11月4日，Hoban将持股比例提高至20.69%，以微弱优势超过赵元泰及其关联方持有的20.58%，成为Hanjin KAL第一大股东。这一变化发生在Hanjin KAL股价飙升之后。此后，该股波动更加剧烈。周二，股价创下245,000韩元的历史高点；周四又一度暴跌至盘中低点185,000韩元；周五收于203,500韩元。双方在争夺控制权的过程中持续增持股份，股价剧震进一步加重了两方面的财务负担。

Hoban可围绕明年的年度股东大会与赵元泰展开磋商，讨论是否停止进一步购股并进入Hanjin KAL董事会。如果能够达成协议，Hoban最终可通过大宗交易将持股出售给其他投资者，在不继续承担高昂控股权争夺成本的情况下实现溢价收益。

Hanwha Investment & Securities分析师朴世妍表示：“Hoban持股的价值最终可能并非取决于其赢得股东投票的能力，而在于其能在潜在的大宗出售中争取到多高的溢价。”

赵元泰已同意再购买325,000股。交易交割后，截至2027年1月1日，他一方可能重新领先。即便如此，朴估计，Hoban只需再增持约0.37个百分点，按当前价格计算约需460亿韩元（3,440万美元），便可重夺第一大股东地位。但反复以高价购股需要投入大量额外资本，使长期较量对双方的代价日益高昂。

第三种方案是利用其持股争取董事会影响力。Hoban持有的20%以上股份，使其在董事会席位和重大公司决策的谈判中拥有相当大的筹码。这有助于该集团在不承担全面控股成本的情况下确保影响力。

投票权分布也使最大股东之争更加复杂。即使Hoban成为最大个人股东，赵元泰及其一方关联方合计持有的股份，包括Delta Air Lines，仍将大幅超过这家建筑集团。因此，对Hoban而言，争取Hanjin KAL董事会中的盟友比继续争夺第一大股东地位更为重要。

如果Hoban Group寻求加强对Hanjin Group的管理影响力，Hanjin KAL定于3月举行的定期股东大会可能成为争取董事会席位的机会，因为由Korea Development Bank推荐的3名外部董事任期即将届满。

Eugene Investment & Securities分析师杨升允表示：“如果Hoban转向更深入地参与公司治理，就可能在董事会获得一定席位。但它距离取得董事会多数席位并控制大韩航空仍相去甚远。从长远来看，关键变量在于集团重组后国有贷款机构将如何处理其持股，包括整合旗下低成本航空公司。”

Hanjin KAL股价周五盘中一度大涨约8%，但收盘时回吐大部分涨幅，在基准指数KOSPI仅收涨0.25%。

航空业一位人士表示：“由于Hoban与赵元泰仍在第一大股东位置上难分胜负，预计波动将持续至年底。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Three members of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK)'s Supreme Council boycotted a council meeting Friday in protest of party leader Kim Min-seok's decision to order an ethics probe into one of the officials over controversial remarks about President Lee Jae Myung. The three officials, who are aligned with former DPK leader Jung Chung-rae, criticized Kim for ordering the party's ethics committee to investigate Rep. Choi Min-hee's remarks suggesting that Lee had opposed former President Yoon Suk Yeol's impeachment. Choi, along with Reps. Lee Sung-yoon and Han Min-soo, who together make up three of the party's five elected Supreme Council members, skipped the meeting and held a press conference at the National Assembly instead. "It should be Chairman Kim himself who should face an ethics investigation right now," they said. Rep. Choi also came under fire this week for referring to journalists as "a pack of hyenas" in a KakaoTalk group chat. The lawmakers took aim at Kim for raising allegations that anti-Lee party lawmakers had colluded with the Shincheonji Church of Jesus, a nonmainstream religious sect, to have church followers join the DPK to sway the outcome of a party leadership race earlier this year. "He was quick to order an ethics investigation into a fellow Supreme Council member without even asking for an explanation or considering the circumstances," they added, accusing Kim of being lenient on his own misconduct. Kim apologized earlier this month after an internal party investigation found no evidence to support his allegations regarding Shincheonji, reversing his earlier claim but withholding public disclosure of the results of the probe. Meanwhile, lawmakers aligned with Kim criticized the three officials for boycotting Friday's meeting, accusing them of fueling divisions within the party. The presidential office on Thursday rejected Choi's remarks as groundless and expressed strong regret. Choi later acknowledged that she had been mistaken, saying Lee had consistently supported Yoon's impeachment since the martial law bid in December 2024
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 执政党高层官员因派系分裂加剧而集体缺席会议
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 执政的朝鲜劳动党（DPK）最高议政会三名成员于周五缺席议政会会议，以抗议党魁金旻锡决定对其中一名官员展开道德调查。该官员曾就总统李在明发表争议言论。三名官员与前朝鲜劳动党领导人郑清莱立场一致，他们批评金旻锡下令由该党道德委员会调查众议员崔敏赫的言论。崔敏赫暗示李在明曾反对弹劾前总统尹锡悦。与众议员李成允、韩民秀共同出席记者会的崔敏赫三人，构成了该党五名民选最高议政会成员中的三人。他们缺席会议，转而在国民议会举行记者会，称：“眼下理应接受道德调查的人，正是金委员长本人。”本周，崔敏赫还因在KakaoTalk群聊中把记者称为“一群鬣狗”而受到批评。上述议员还指责金旻锡提出反李议员与非主流宗教团体“真耶稣教会”串通，让教会信徒加入朝鲜劳动党，以影响今年早些时候党内领导层竞选结果的指控。他们补充道：“他既没有要求解释，也没有考虑具体情况，就迅速下令对最高议政会同僚展开道德调查。”他们还指责金旻锡对自身不当行为宽大处理。本月初，党内调查未发现支持其有关真耶稣教会指控的证据后，金旻锡道歉并撤回了先前的说法，但没有公开调查结果的细节。与此同时，与金旻锡立场一致的议员批评这三名官员缺席周五会议，指责他们加剧党内分歧。总统办公室周四否定了崔敏赫的言论，称其毫无根据，并表示强烈遗憾。崔敏赫后来承认自己判断有误，称自2024年12月尹锡悦试图实施戒严以来，李在明一直支持对尹锡悦的弹劾

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: President Lee Jae Myung on Friday highlighted hostile takeovers as a key mechanism to correct what he described as distorted corporate governance and address the undervaluation of Korean stocks, calling for measures to make mergers and acquisitions (M&A) easier and more frequent. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 李在明总统周五强调，恶意收购是纠正其所称扭曲的公司治理并解决韩国股票估值偏低问题的一项关键机制，并呼吁采取措施，让并购更容易、更频繁地开展。李在明还敦促对科斯达克市场进行整顿，要求严格执行退市规则，使陷入困境或经营不佳的公司及时退市。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: President Lee Jae Myung on Friday highlighted hostile takeovers as a key mechanism to correct what he described as distorted corporate governance and address the undervaluation of Korean stocks, calling for measures to make mergers and acquisitions (M&A) easier and more frequent. Lee also urged a shake-up of the Kosdaq market, calling for delisting rules to be rigorously applied so that troubled or poorly performing companies exit promptly. His remarks came during a policy meeting on the capital market at the Korea Exchange (KRX). Acknowledging that the recent stock slide had tested his administration’s resolve and policies, Lee said its commitment to normalizing the capital market remained beyond doubt. "Markets can be normalized only when M&A deals are made easier and more widespread. Hostile M&A is the most important mechanism for normalizing the market," Lee said. Calling for more concrete measures to encourage such deals, Lee said a more active M&A market would help resolve the problem of Korean companies trading at unusually low valuations and expand the overall value of the stock market. Behind Lee’s remarks was concern that Korea’s stock undervaluation reflects more than weak earnings or growth prospects. He questioned whether some controlling shareholders deliberately keep share prices low to reduce inheritance taxes. He also pointed to distrust arising from abuses of management control and disregard for minority shareholders. By encouraging hostile takeovers, which involve attempts to gain control without the consent of existing management, Lee sought to make those controlling shareholders more vulnerable to challenges from outside investors. Such bids allow investors to pursue control without management’s approval, putting pressure on existing owners to improve governance and shareholder value. The policy meeting came as sharp corrections in both KOSPI and Kosdaq, following record highs earlier this year, heightened concerns over financial market stability. The benchmark KOSPI surpassed 9,000 for the first time on June 18, closing at 9,063.84, but has since retreated to the 5,000 range. The Kosdaq reached a record high of 1,226.18 on April 27, breaking above 1,200 for the first time, before falling back to around 700. Amid the market turbulence, the government is seeking to boost stock valuations and overhaul the secondary Kosdaq market to address structural weaknesses in Korea’s capital market. On his second visit to the KRX as president, Lee wore a red tie, apparently signaling hopes for a market rebound through a color associated with stock gains in Korea. "Capital market reform is once again being put to the test, but our government's commitment to normalizing the capital market is not in doubt," Lee said. He was joined by senior government officials, lawmakers, industry representatives and market experts for discussions on addressing the undervaluation of Korean stocks. Lee particularly stressed that Kosdaq must become a more reliable market where innovative companies can grow and investors can invest with confidence. "Many people are also concerned about the Kosdaq market. We need to reform the market and build a stable investor base," Lee said. "We must comprehensively review the systems governing market entry, exit and valuation to turn Kosdaq into a market where innovative companies can grow and investors can invest with confidence." The government has already begun tightening delisting rules to improve the quality of listed companies and restore investor confidence. The measures include raising minimum market capitalization requirements for maintaining a listing and introducing stricter delisting criteria for stocks trading below 1,000 won. He pointed to a lack of English-language materials, calling for better communication with foreign shareholders. "Foreign investors say they want to invest in Korean stocks but cannot find materials in English," Lee said. "What is so difficult about preparing materials in English or other major foreign languages and posting them online?" In response, KRX Chairman Jeong Eun-bo said the exchange was considering revising its requirements for listed firms to oblige them to hold at least one IR event a year. Requirements on English-language disclosure, which is already mandatory for KOSPI-listed companies, would soon be extended to Kosdaq-listed firms, he said. To coordinate the broader reform effort, Lee proposed setting up a high-level task force to address the issues raised at Friday’s meeting. "There seems to be too much reform work that needs to be done specifically for the KRX and the broader capital market. I would like to see a high-level body established to take charge of these issues," he said. Lee suggested that the body could bring together lawmakers from both the ruling and opposition parties, as well as private exchanges and investment associations. He also called for surveys and consultations to identify areas requiring legislative or institutional changes
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 李在明呼吁放宽并购限制、增加并购频率，以实现市场正常化
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 李在明总统周五强调，恶意收购是纠正其所称扭曲的公司治理和解决韩国股票估值过低问题的一项关键机制，并呼吁采取措施，使并购更加容易、更加频繁。李还要求整顿科斯达克市场，主张严格适用退市规则，使陷入困境或经营不佳的公司迅速退出市场。他说，这番话是在韩国交易所（KRX）举行的资本市场政策会议上发表的。李承认，近期股市下跌考验了其政府的决心和政策，但政府推动资本市场正常化的承诺依然坚定不移。他说：“只有让并购交易变得更容易、更普遍，市场才能实现正常化。恶意收购是市场正常化最重要的机制。”李呼吁采取更具体的措施鼓励此类交易，并表示更活跃的并购市场将有助于解决韩国企业估值异常偏低的问题，并提升股市整体价值。李这番话背后，是外界对韩国股市估值过低不仅反映盈利疲弱或增长前景有限的担忧。他质疑，一些控股股东是否故意压低股价，以降低遗产税。他还指出，滥用管理控制权及漠视少数股东所引发的不信任，也是问题所在。通过鼓励恶意收购——即在未经现有管理层同意的情况下试图取得控制权——李希望让这些控股股东更容易受到外部投资者的挑战。这类收购要约允许投资者在无需管理层批准的情况下谋求控制权，从而促使现有所有者改善治理并提升股东价值。在今年早些时候股市创下历史高点后，KOSPI和科斯达克指数均出现大幅回调，资本市场政策会议正是在这种情况下举行的，市场对金融稳定性的担忧随之加剧。基准指数KOSPI于6月18日首次突破9,000点，收于9,063.84点，但此后已回落至5,000点区间。科斯达克指数于4月27日创下1,226.18点的历史新高，首次突破1,200点，随后又跌至约700点。市场动荡之际，政府正寻求提升股票估值，并全面整顿二级科斯达克市场，以解决韩国资本市场的结构性弱点。李以总统身份第二次到访韩国交易所时佩戴了一条红领带，显然是在以韩国股市中与上涨相联系的颜色传递市场反弹的希望。他说：“资本市场改革再次面临考验，但我们政府推动资本市场正常化的承诺毫无疑问。”李与政府高级官员、议员、行业代表和市场专家一道，讨论如何解决韩国股票估值过低的问题。李尤其强调，科斯达克必须成为更可靠的市场，让创新型企业得以成长，让投资者能够放心投资。他说：“许多人也对科斯达克市场感到担忧。我们需要改革这个市场，并建立稳定的投资者基础。”他说：“我们必须全面审查市场准入、退出和估值制度，把科斯达克打造成一个创新型企业能够成长、投资者能够放心投资的市场。”政府已经开始收紧退市规则，以提升上市公司质量并恢复投资者信心。这些措施包括提高维持上市地位所需的最低市值门槛，并对交易价格低于1,000韩元的股票实行更严格的退市标准。他指出，面向外国股东的英文资料不足，呼吁加强与外国股东的沟通。他说：“外国投资者表示，他们想投资韩国股票，却找不到英文资料。”他说：“准备英文资料或其他主要外语资料并发布到网上，有什么难的？”对此，韩国交易所董事长郑殷镐表示，该交易所正考虑修订对上市公司的要求，强制其每年至少举行一次投资者关系活动。他说，针对英文信息披露的要求很快将从已在韩国交易所主板上市的企业延伸至科斯达克上市公司。为协调更广泛的改革工作，李提议成立一个高级别特设小组，处理周五会议提出的各项问题。他说：“似乎有太多改革工作需要专门针对韩国交易所及整个资本市场推进。我希望设立一个高级别机构，负责处理这些问题。”李建议，该机构可以吸纳执政党和反对党议员，以及私营交易所和投资协会参与。他还呼吁通过调查和磋商，确定需要立法或制度调整的领域

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body: Actor and singer Park Jin-young has topped the buzz rankings for drama performers, marking a new milestone in his 14-year career. Having moved seamlessly between music and acting, Park is now demonstrating the versatility that has earned him a reputation as an all-round entertainer. Years of steadily building his acting career are translating into tangible success as he draws growing public attention. The tvN 20th anniversary special drama "100 Days of Deception," starring Park, surpassed a 10 percent viewership rating with its 10th episode, according to Nielsen Korea. Interest in the series has continued to grow with each episode, boosting the popularity of its cast. According to Good Data Corporation's rankings of the most buzzworthy TV and streaming dramas, Park took the top spot among performers, followed by his co-star Kim You-jung in second place. In the drama, Park plays Sato Hideo, also known as Kim Tae-woong, a character torn between his Korean roots and the Japanese identity he was forced to adopt to survive during Japan's colonial rule of Korea. His character becomes entangled in an espionage romance with a spy played by Kim You-jung, delicately portraying the emotional conflict between truth and love. The pair's tense yet emotionally layered performances, particularly in the closing scenes of each episode, have become a major draw for viewers. Another key point of interest is whether the two characters, positioned on opposite sides as a high-ranking official in the Japanese colonial government and an undercover agent for the Korean independence movement, can overcome the barriers separating them and find love. Park anchors the drama alongside Kim You-jung, Kim Hyun-joo, Lee Moo-saeng and Jin Sun-kyu. His appearance, combining youthful charm with masculine appeal, has attracted attention, while his performance in the drama's central anti-Japanese espionage storyline has also drawn favorable reviews. Director Yoo In-sik, who helms "100 Days of Deception," previously expressed strong confidence in Park's casting, saying the actor has "remarkably clear eyes." He said Park's "clean, unpretentious acting and pure-hearted nature" were among the reasons he was chosen for the role. The popularity of "100 Days of Deception" has also renewed interest in Park's previous acting projects. "Yumi's Cells 2" and "Our Unwritten Seoul," in particular, helped establish Park's appeal as a romantic lead. Both are now considered standout works for viewers who have discovered him through "100 Days of Deception" and want to explore his earlier performances. Park has also maintained an active music career. Beginning with the duo JJ Project, he went on to become a member of K-pop group GOT7 before pursuing solo activities, demonstrating his musical abilities and versatility along the way. His continued commitment to music, even while building his acting career, has been a defining feature of his professional journey. Recently, Park released his second solo mini-album and met fans in Seoul during his first concert tour, "CODE#." Following the Seoul concert, he is scheduled to continue the tour in six Asian cities: Osaka, Manila, Tokyo, Taipei, Bangkok and Macao. Growing interest in Park has also brought renewed attention to "When I Stop Thinking," his duet with singer Choi Yu-ree, released in May. The video has accumulated approximately 35.04 million views five months after its release, with its viewership continuing to climb. One of Park's greatest strengths is his ability to achieve results independently in both acting and music. While maintaining his identity as a singer through group activities and solo releases, he has continued to take on new challenges as an actor across television dramas and films. Rather than simply using popularity gained in one field to expand into another, Park has consistently demonstrated his capabilities in both areas, building a distinct career in each. "100 Days of Deception" represents the culmination of years of acting experience meeting growing mainstream recognition. His current popularity is not an overnight success but the result of a career shaped by diverse roles and steadily accumulated experience. Having established his place in both music and acting, attention is now focused on whether Park can use the success of "100 Days of Deception" to further solidify his standing as a leading man. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.title_zh: 朴仁勇稳步上升，最终以《欺骗百日》收获成果
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/entertainme.body_zh: 演员兼歌手朴宝剑登顶电视剧演员热议度榜首，为其14年职业生涯写下新的里程碑。朴宝剑游刃有余地穿梭于音乐与表演领域，如今展现出的多才多艺令他赢得了全能艺人的声誉。多年来持续耕耘演艺事业，如今终于转化为切实成果，公众关注度也与日俱增。据Nielsen Korea数据，由朴宝剑主演的tvN二十周年特别剧《骗过百日》第10集收视率突破10%。该剧每播一集热度便继续攀升，带动主演阵容人气上涨。根据Good Data Corporation发布的最受热议电视剧及流媒体剧集榜单，朴宝剑位居演员榜首，搭档金有贞名列第二。剧中，朴宝剑饰演佐藤秀男，又名金泰勇。这个角色身处韩国血统与日本身份之间；在日本殖民统治朝鲜时期，他为了生存被迫接受日本人的身份。该角色与金有贞饰演的间谍展开一段谍战爱情，细腻呈现真相与爱之间的情感纠葛。两人紧张而层次丰富的表演，尤其是每集结尾场景，已成为吸引观众的重要看点。另一个关注焦点是，这两名分别身处对立阵营的角色——一方是日本殖民政府的高官，另一方是韩国独立运动的卧底特工——能否跨越横亘在彼此之间的阻碍，最终找到爱情。朴宝剑与金有贞、金贤珠、李武成和 Jin Sun-kyu共同担纲该剧主演。他兼具少年感与男性魅力的外貌引来关注，在该剧核心的抗日谍战 storyline中的表演也获得好评。执导《骗过百日》的导演 Yoo In-sik此前对朴宝剑的选角充满信心，称这位演员拥有“无比清澈的眼睛”。他说，朴宝剑“干净、不做作的演技和纯粹善良的天性”是选中他出演该角色的原因之一。《骗过百日》的人气也重新唤起了公众对朴宝剑过往影视作品的关注。其中，《穿孔效应2》和《未写完的我们的首尔》尤其帮助他确立了爱情男主演员的魅力。对于通过《骗过百日》认识他、并希望了解其早期表演的观众而言，这两部作品如今都被视为佳作。朴宝剑同时也一直活跃于音乐领域。他从组合JJ Project起步，后来成为K-pop组合GOT7成员，再转向个人活动，一路展现音乐实力与多面才华。即使在发展演艺事业期间，他仍坚持音乐事业，这一直是他职业生涯的鲜明特点。最近，朴宝剑发行了第二张个人迷你专辑，并在首次巡演“CODE#”期间于首尔与粉丝见面。首尔演唱会后，他计划继续前往六座亚洲城市巡演：大阪、马尼拉、东京、台北、曼谷和澳门。朴宝剑日益攀升的人气，也让公众重新关注他与歌手Choi Yu-ree于5月发布的合唱曲《When I Stop Thinking》。该视频发布五个月后累计观看量约为3504万次，收视数据仍在持续上涨。朴宝剑最突出的优势之一，是能够同时在表演与音乐领域独立取得成果。他在通过组合活动和个人发行作品维持歌手身份的同时，也不断作为演员在电视剧和电影中迎接新挑战。朴宝剑并未仅凭一个领域积累的人气向另一个领域拓展，而是一直在两个方面展现自身能力，并分别打造出Distinct的事业道路。《骗过百日》代表着多年表演经验与日益提升的大众认可相结合后的集大成之作。他当前的人气并非一夜之间取得，而是源于一段由多样化角色和持续积累的经验塑造的职业生涯。如今，朴宝剑已在音乐与表演领域确立地位，外界关注的是，他能否借助《骗过百日》的成功，进一步巩固自己作为一线男主的地位。本文原载于《韩国时报》的姊妹报《Hankook Ilbo》，由生成式AI系统翻译，并经《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Bill would make 'bukhyangmin' legal term as defectors disagree over what it means to them A bill to change South Korea’s legal term for North Korean defectors set off a shouting match at the National Assembly Thursday after an opposition lawmaker challenged Unification Minister Chung Dong-young over the proposed name. “Minister Buk Dong-young, why is it OK to call me ‘bukhyangmin?’” asked Rep. Park Choong-kwon of the main opposition People Power Party, who fled North Korea in 2009. He had replaced Chung’s surname with “buk,” the Korean word for north. Rep. Lee Ki-heon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea shot back by asking whether he could call Park “Tal Choong-kwon.” He took “tal,” meaning escape, from “talbukmin,” the term commonly used for North Korean defectors in the South. Chung demanded an apology. Park apologized before the meeting resumed. The exchange came as the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee took up a bill introduced by Rep. Kim Jae-won of the Rebuilding Korea Party. It would replace the legal term for North Korean defectors with bukhyangmin, a term for people whose hometowns are in North Korea. The unification ministry has used the term since early this year. “North Korean defectors rejected the dictatorship and risked their lives in search of freedom,” Park said. He accused Chung of trying to erase “that history and identity.” In a YouTube interview, Park said the survey on the name change gave respondents few alternatives and steered them toward bukhyangmin. “There was no consensus among defectors on the term,” he said. “Changing the term won’t change how people see North Korean defectors.” Chung backed an earlier effort to change the name during his first stint as unification minister. In 2005, the ministry introduced “saeteomin,” a term for people starting life in a new place. The government dropped it from official use in 2008. The legal term, “bukhan ital jumin,” meaning residents who defected from North Korea, remained in place, while talbukmin stayed in everyday use. In March, the unification ministry adopted “North Korean-born citizens” for its English materials, saying the term reflected both where defectors were born and their status as South Korean citizens. The foreign ministry was cautious about adopting the wording. In October, it told lawmakers that changing the legal term could make it harder for Seoul to persuade third countries to refrain from forcibly returning defectors to North Korea. About 50 North Korean defectors rallied outside Government Complex Seoul Thursday to oppose the change. They chanted “We are North Korean defectors” and called for Chung to resign. “We fled North Korea because we were fed up with the Kim Jong-un regime. Leaving the North is part of our identity,” said Lee Eun-taek, secretary-general of the defector association that organized the rally. “We reject the label bukhyangmin because it denies our identity.” Cho Kyung-il, head of Peace Agora, said he supports bukhyangmin because it acknowledges the ties defectors still have to their hometowns. “When you call us 'talbukja' (someone who fled North Korea) or 'italja' (a broader term for someone who has left or broken away), it makes us sound like we abandoned our hometown. It cuts us off from who we are,” Cho said on his YouTube channel. After the rally, the unification ministry said it was using the new term to promote respect for defectors and help them integrate into South Korean society. A ministry official said the government was listening to different views and hoped to keep talking with the group that organized the rally
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 围绕朝鲜叛逃者标签的争议激起有关身份认同的讨论
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh:
一项法案将把“bukhyangmin”确立为法律术语，但脱北者对这一称呼的含义存在分歧。韩国国民大会周四就修改韩国对朝鲜叛逃者法律术语的法案发生激烈争论。执政党共同民主党议员朴钟权质问统一部长郑东永，反对党议员追问这项拟议名称为何可行。2009年从朝鲜逃到韩国的国民力量党议员朴钟权问：“郑部长，为什么称我为‘bukhyangmin’就可以？”他把郑的姓氏替换成了韩语中表示“北方”的“buk”。执政党共同民主党议员李基宪则反击，问自己是否可以称朴为“Tal Choong-kwon”。他从韩国常用的朝鲜叛逃者称谓“talbukmin”中取出了表示“逃离”的“tal”。郑东永要求对方道歉。会议恢复前，朴钟权道了歉。

这场交锋发生在外交统一委员会审议韩国重建党议员金在元提出的法案之际。法案将朝鲜叛逃者的法律术语改为“bukhyangmin”，指故乡在朝鲜的人。统一部从今年年初开始使用这一称呼。

朴钟权说：“朝鲜叛逃者拒绝独裁统治，并冒着生命危险追求自由。”他指责郑东永试图抹去“那段历史和身份”。朴钟权在一次YouTube采访中说，有关更名的调查只给受访者提供了很少的选择，并引导他们选择“bukhyangmin”。他说：“脱北者对这一称呼并没有形成共识。改变这一称呼不会改变人们对朝鲜叛逃者的看法。”

郑东永支持此前担任统一部长期间更名的努力。2005年，该部提出“saeteomin”，意为在新地方开始生活的人。政府于2008年停止在官方文件中使用这一称谓。表示从朝鲜叛逃而来的居民的法定术语“bukhan ital jumin”仍然保留，而“talbukmin”则继续用于日常称呼。

今年3月，统一部在其英文材料中采用“North Korean-born citizens”，称这一表述既反映叛逃者的出生地，也反映他们作为韩国公民的身份。外交部对采用这一措辞持谨慎态度。10月，外交部告诉议员，更改法律术语可能使首尔更难说服第三国不要强行将叛逃者遣返朝鲜。

约50名朝鲜叛逃者周四在韩国政府综合大楼外集会，反对更名。他们高喊“我们是朝鲜叛逃者”，并要求郑东永辞职。组织此次集会的脱北者协会秘书长李恩泽说：“我们逃离朝鲜，是因为我们受够了金正恩政权。离开北方是我们身份认同的一部分。我们拒绝‘bukhyangmin’这个标签，因为它否认我们的身份。”

和平Agora负责人赵京日说，他支持“bukhyangmin”，因为这一称谓承认了脱北者与其故乡仍存的联系。赵京日在其YouTube频道上说：“当你称我们为‘talbukja’（逃离朝鲜的人）或‘italja’（更宽泛地指离开或脱离的人）时，听起来就像我们抛弃了故乡。它把我们同自身的身份割裂开来。”

集会后，统一部表示，正在使用新称谓是为了促进对脱北者的尊重，并帮助他们融入韩国社会。该部一名官员说，政府正在听取不同意见，并希望继续与组织此次集会的团体对话……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: Related policies, services must be revisited, improved to attract frequent visitors Korea saw the number of foreign visitors to the country hit 20 million Thursday, nearing its 2026 target of 23 million tourists. It is a significant figure, considering that Korea first saw 10 million international visitors in 2014. Koreans can easily feel the growing range and presence of foreign visitors not only in the swanky shops of Myeong-dong, Gangnam and Seongsu-dong, but also at local pharmacies, traditional markets and big box stores. It's also not limited to the capital city — the southeastern port city of Busan is expecting its annual number of foreigner visitors to stand at around 5 million, Gangwon Province in the northeast beckons with its beaches and mountains and, of course, the traditional holiday spot of Jeju remains popular with international and domestic travelers. International visitors bring a fresh injection of diversity, curiosity and revenue. Statistics show that overseas tourists spent $12 billion in the first nine months of the year — an increase of 47.7 percent over the same period the previous year. Yonhap reported that commercial vacancies in major neighborhoods in Seoul have seen a drop of 1.4 percentage points to stand at 7.1 percent in third quarter of the year, citing a Cushman & Wakefield Korea report. Vacancies in Myeong-dong and Seongsu-dong were among the lowest at 3.9 percent and 3.7 percent, respectively. According to the report, a growing number of tourists purchasing Korean cosmetics is believed to have led to more shops being rented out in the two areas. Indeed, the continued global popularity of Korean culture, from K-pop to food to beauty, has helped ensure the sustainability of the new flow of tourists to the country. In the annual 2026 Hallyu Overseas survey, released by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism in March, 69.7 percent of 27,400 respondents who first encountered Korean content elsewhere reported an affinity for Korean culture. Interest in K-pop (54 percent), food (55 percent), beauty (53 percent), K-dramas (51 percent) and cinema (49 percent) all played a role in bringing in tourists. Tourism can inspire cultural exchanges and understanding, helping to strengthen Korea's soft power. Like other leading nations, Korea works best when hard and soft power work together. For a country that has long aspired international recognition, we should make the most of the inflow of travelers by providing high-quality experiences, including making sure that there is good transit, accommodations and accessibility. While services have overall improved, there are still reports of issues like outsized taxi bills and discrimination, which shows the need to revisit related policies and services to ensure international visitors return. Beyond Seoul, where 80 percent of tourists spend most of their trip in Korea, regional cities and towns should also look to places like Busan as an example and develop their distinctive experiences and tourism ecosystems.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 韩国必须重新审视并完善相关政策和服务，以吸引游客频繁到访。周四，韩国的外国游客人数达到2000万人次，接近2026年2300万人次的目标。考虑到韩国直到2014年才首次迎来1000万人次国际游客，这一数字颇具分量。韩国人不难感受到外国游客日益增多带来的多元化和存在感，这种情况不仅出现在明洞、江南和圣水洞的高档商店，也体现在当地药店、传统市场和大型购物中心。外国游客的到访并不局限于首都——东南部港口城市釜山预计今年外国游客人数约为500万人次；东北部江原道凭借海滩和群山吸引游客；当然，传统度假胜地济州仍受到国内外游客的欢迎。国际游客为韩国注入了新的多样性、好奇心和收入。数据显示，今年前九个月，海外游客消费了120亿美元，较去年同期增长47.7%。韩联社援引Cushman & Wakefield Korea的报告称，首尔主要街区的商业空置率已下降1.4个百分点，第三季度降至7.1%。明洞和圣水洞的空置率分别仅为3.9%和3.7%，均处于最低水平之列。报告认为，购买韩国化妆品的游客日益增多，促使这两个地区的更多商铺获得出租。事实上，韩国文化在全球持续受到欢迎，从K-pop到美食再到美容，都有助于确保赴韩游客新增长流的持续性。文化体育观光部于3月发布的《2026年韩流海外调查》显示，在27,400名最初通过其他渠道接触韩国内容的受访者中，69.7%对韩国文化抱有好感。对K-pop（54%）、美食（55%）、美容（53%）、韩剧（51%）和电影（49%）的兴趣，都在吸引游客方面发挥了作用。旅游业能够促进文化交流与理解，帮助韩国增强软实力。与其他领先国家一样，韩国在硬实力与软实力协同发挥作用时表现最佳。对于一个长期寻求国际认可的国家而言，我们应充分利用游客流入带来的机遇，提供高质量体验，同时确保便捷的交通、舒适的住宿和无障碍服务。尽管整体服务已有改善，但仍有关于出租车费用异常高和歧视等问题的报道，这表明有必要重新审视相关政策和服务，确保国际游客再次到访。在首尔以外的地区——80%的游客在韩国的大部分行程都在首尔度过——各地区城市和城镇也应以釜山等地为榜样，打造自身独特的体验和旅游生态。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliament-s.body: Parliament has abandoned plans to hold its post-budget workshop in the Volta Region, opting to organise the exercise at the Chamber of Parliament in Accra following opposition from the Minority, as preparations begin for a week of debate on the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy. The decision brings an end to the proposed arrangement to move the workshop outside the parliamentary premises, with lawmakers now expected to undertake the exercise within the House over two days. The change was announced by Majority Leader James Agalga during the presentation of the Business Statement, in which he outlined the revised arrangements for the workshop and the schedule for the budget debate. According to Mr Agalga, the workshop will take place from Monday, November 16, to Tuesday, November 17, 2026, at the Chamber of Parliament, with proceedings beginning at 9 a.m. on each day. "Honourable members are reminded that the post-budget workshop would be held from Monday 16th to Tuesday 17th November 2026 at the Chamber of Parliament at 9 a.m. each day." he announced. He further informed the House that there would be no parliamentary sitting on Tuesday, November 17, to allow members to take part in the workshop. "In view of the above, the House will not sit on Tuesday , November 17. Sitting will accordingly commence on Wednesday November 18," he added. Mr Agalga urged MPs to take note of the revised arrangements and make themselves available for the exercise, which will precede the formal debate on the government's economic policy. Beyond the workshop, the Business Statement also outlined Parliament's programme for examining the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy. The debate has been scheduled to begin on Wednesday, November 18, and continue until Tuesday, November 24, 2026. Mr Agalga explained that the Business Committee had programmed the exercise in accordance with Order 195(3) of Parliament's Standing Orders. "The Business Committee has programmed the commentary on the Budget Statement and Economic Policy of the Government to commence on Wednesday 18th and end on Tuesday 24th November 2026," he told the House. The Majority and Minority Leaders are expected to deliver the concluding contributions on Wednesday, November 25, bringing the scheduled commentary to a close. The arrangement will allow members from both sides of the House to present their views on the government's budget proposals and economic policy direction for the 2027 fiscal year. Presenting the Business Committee's recommendations, Majority Leader James Agalga told the House that the Majority Leader and Minority Leader would each be allocated 35 minutes to contribute to the debate, while other parliamentary leaders would have 20 minutes. He said Ministers of State, chairpersons and ranking members of parliamentary committees would each be given 15 minutes, with vice-chairpersons and deputy ranking members allocated 10 minutes. Mr Agalga further stated that other Members of Parliament would have seven minutes each to present their contributions. He informed the House that the debate would run from November 18 to 24, 2026, with the Majority and Minority Leaders expected to conclude proceedings on November 25
https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliament-s.title_zh: 议会取消在议会场外举行2027年预算研讨会的计划
https://www.myjoyonline.com/parliament-s.body_zh: 议会在少数派反对后放弃原计划，决定在阿克拉的议会大厅举行预算后研讨会，而不在沃尔塔地区举行；目前各方正为持续一周审议2027年预算报告和经济政策作准备。这一决定终止了将研讨会移至议会场外的安排，议员现预计将在院内用两天时间完成相关活动。多数派领袖James Agalga在介绍业务报告时宣布了这一变更，并说明了研讨会的修订安排及预算辩论日程。Agalga先生宣布，研讨会将于2026年11月16日星期一至11月17日星期二在议会大厅举行，每日会议于上午9时开始。“提醒各位尊敬的议员，预算后研讨会将于2026年11月16日星期一至11月17日星期二举行，地点为议会大厅，每日上午9时开始。”他还告知议院，为让议员参加研讨会，11月17日星期二将不举行全体会议。“鉴于上述情况，议院于11月17日星期二不举行会议，会议 accordingly 将于11月18日星期三开始。”Agalga先生敦促议员了解修订后的安排并准时参加研讨会，该活动将在政府经济政策正式辩论之前举行。除研讨会外，业务报告还概述了议会审议2027年预算报告和经济政策的日程。辩论定于11月18日星期三开始，持续至2026年11月24日星期二。Agalga先生表示，业务委员会已依照议会常规议事程序第195(3)条安排此项活动。“业务委员会已安排对政府预算报告和经济政策的审议于11月18日星期三开始，并于2026年11月24日星期二结束。”他告诉议院。多数派领袖和少数派领袖预计于11月25日星期三发表总结发言，为相关审议画上句号。这一安排将让议院两派议员就政府的预算提案及2027财年的经济政策方向陈述意见。在介绍业务委员会的建议时，多数派领袖James Agalga告诉议院，多数派领袖和少数派领袖将各获分配35分钟用于发言，其他议会领袖则有20分钟发言时间。他说，各部部长、议会委员会主席及资深成员将各获15分钟，副主席及副资深成员则各获10分钟。Agalga先生进一步表示，其他议员每人将有7分钟时间发表意见。他告知议院，辩论将于2026年11月18日至24日进行，多数派领袖和少数派领袖预计于11月25日总结全部审议。

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/i.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription In a significant breakthrough towards the conclusion of the India-U.S. interim deal on trade, the U.S. has assured India of a comparative advantage over its competitors once it finalises its tariff structure, a senior official in the Ministry of Commerce and Industry said, adding that both sides are working to complete the deal by the end of the current financial year. Indian officials have repeatedly been saying that India would move ahead with a deal only if the U.S. assured it of a comparative advantage, as was agreed to in the February 2026 joint statement between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and U.S. President Donald Trump. Separately, Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal confirmed that a two-man team from the U.S. visited India earlier this month during which substantial progress was made towards finalising the text of the deal. “Talks between India and the U.S. are ongoing and the U.S. has assured us of a comparative advantage over our competitor countries,” the senior official said on the condition of anonymity as the details of the bilateral discussions have not yet been made public. This is a significant development because Indian officials, including Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal, have repeatedly said that India would move ahead with a deal with the U.S. only if it is assured of a comparative advantage over its competitors. The February joint statement stated that the U.S. and India “commit to provide each other preferential market access in sectors of respective interest on a sustained basis”. However, since then, the U.S. has imposed additional 10% ‘forced labour’ tariffs on India, the same as on some of its competitors such as Indonesia, Malaysia, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka. Further, the U.S. is currently conducting another investigation into India and several other countries related to excess capacity, which could see additional tariffs being levied. The official, however, said that the U.S. assurance of comparative advantage for India takes into account this future tariff. “The attempt by both sides is to complete the deal by the end of this financial year,” the official added. “We have also agreed to a clause that says that if either country changes its tariffs on the other country, then the second country can also modify its commitments under the deal. This was also a part of the February joint statement.” The official said that such a clause is “not usual” in trade deals that India enters into, but that it had specifically been included in the deal with the U.S. Separately, Mr. Agrawal said that the talks between the two sides were “on the right track” and that the teams are engaged both in-person and virtually. “There was a small team from the U.S. that visited India for discussions on customs and trade facilitation in the first week of November,” he said. “The discussions went off in a very positive direction. A lot of issues were closed, and there was convergence in a lot of areas.” In addition, he said that the chief negotiators of both sides regularly speak with each other virtually to carry forward the discussions and “iron out some of the language issues or some of the small fixes that remain in the agreement”. 在印度与美国临时贸易协议即将取得重大进展之际，印度工商部一名高级官员表示，美国已向印度保证，待其最终确定关税结构后，印度将相对其竞争对手享有比较优势；双方正努力在本财政年度结束前完成协议。

印度官员多次表示，只有美国保证印度相对其竞争对手享有比较优势，印度才会推进协议。2026年2月，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪与美国总统唐纳德·特朗普发表的联合声明中曾就此达成一致。

此外，商务秘书拉杰什·阿格罗沃尔证实，美国派出了一个两人代表团，于本月早些时候访问印度，双方在敲定协议文本方面取得了实质进展。

这名高级官员在匿名条件下表示：“印度与美国之间的谈判仍在进行，美国已向我们保证，相对竞争国家，我们将享有比较优势。”由于双方双边讨论的细节尚未公开，他要求匿名。

这是一项重大进展。印度官员，包括商务部长皮尤什·戈亚尔在内，多次表示，只有美国保证印度相对其竞争对手享有比较优势，印度才会推进与美国的协议。

2月发表的联合声明称，美国和印度“承诺持续在各自关注的相关领域为彼此提供优惠市场准入”。然而，自那以后，美国对印度额外征收了10%的“强迫劳动”关税，对印度尼西亚、马来西亚、巴基斯坦和斯里兰卡等一些竞争对手也征收了同样税率的关税。

此外，美国目前正就产能过剩问题对印度及其他几个国家展开另一项调查，未来可能征收额外关税。不过，该官员表示，美国向印度作出的比较优势保证已考虑这项未来可能征收的关税。

该官员补充说：“双方的目標是在本财政年度结束前完成协议。我们还同意加入一项条款：如果其中任何一国调整对另一国的关税，另一国也可以修改其在协议中的承诺。2月的联合声明中也包含了这一内容。”

该官员表示，此类条款在印度参与签订的交易中“并不常见”，但这次却专门纳入了印度与美国的协议。

阿格罗沃尔先生另行表示，双方谈判“方向正确”，各团队正通过线下和线上方式开展磋商。

他说：“11月第一周，美国派出一个小代表团访问印度，讨论海关和贸易便利化事宜。讨论进展非常积极，许多问题得到解决，双方在许多领域达成了共识。”

他还表示，双方首席谈判代表经常通过线上方式交流，以推进讨论，并“解决协议中残留的一些措辞问题或一些小幅修改事项”。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/minority-say.summary_zh: 议会少数派指控政府在2027年预算中提出了前后不一致的数据，质疑提交议会的部分财政信息的可靠性和清晰度。议会财政委员会排名成员穆罕默德·阿明·亚当博士表示，对预算声明的审查发现，文件不同章节所列的关键支出和经济指标数字并不一致。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/minority-say.body: The Minority in Parliament has accused the government of presenting inconsistent figures in the 2027 budget, raising questions about the reliability and clarity of some of the financial information provided to Parliament. The Ranking Member of Parliament’s Finance Committee, Dr Mohammed Amin Adam, said a review of the Budget Statement revealed different figures for key expenditure and economic indicators in various sections of the document. He cited Ghana's gross international reserves at the end of September 2026, which were recorded as US$12.7 billion in one paragraph and US$12.1 billion in another. He also pointed to varying allocations for the Big Push programme, which were listed as GH¢27.8 billion, GH¢28 billion and GH¢29.8 billion in different sections of the Budget. The Minority further identified discrepancies in the capital expenditure figures, which were stated as GH¢98.4 billion, GH¢98.3 billion and GH¢100.4 billion across different parts of the document. Dr Amin Adam also questioned the Budget's statement that it had identified five principal risks, saying only four were listed. He argued that the risks omitted included the Bank of Ghana's losses, COCOBOD's GH¢30.55 billion debt and arrears in the energy sector. “The Budget's numbers do not add up. Where the numbers do not match, Ghanaians must ask which one is real,” he said. Addressing the media at Parliament on Friday, November 13, following Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson's presentation of the 2027 Budget, Dr Amin Adam called for explanations to reconcile the differences. He said the government must provide clear and consistent information to enable Parliament to properly scrutinise its expenditure plans, revenue projections and economic targets
https://www.myjoyonline.com/minority-say.title_zh: 少数派称已发现2027年预算中的数据冲突
https://www.myjoyonline.com/minority-say.body_zh: 议会少数派指责政府在2027年预算中提出了前后不一致的数据，引发外界对提交议会的部分财政信息是否可靠、清晰的疑问。议会财政委员会排名成员穆罕默德·阿明·亚当博士表示，对《预算声明》的审查发现，文件不同章节对主要支出和经济指标列出了不同数据。他指出，加纳截至2026年9月底的国际储备总额在一段中被记为127亿美元，在另一段中则为121亿美元。他还指出，“Big Push”计划的拨款金额不同，预算不同章节分别列出278亿加纳塞地、280亿加纳塞地和298亿加纳塞地。少数派还发现资本支出数据存在差异，文件不同部分分别列为984亿加纳塞地、983亿加纳塞地和1004亿加纳塞地。阿明·亚当博士还质疑预算称已识别五项主要风险的说法，因为文件中只列出了四项。他认为，遗漏的风险包括加纳银行的亏损、COCOBOD的305.5亿加纳塞地债务以及能源行业拖欠款项。他说：“预算中的数字对不上。数字不一致时，加纳人必须问一问，究竟哪一个才是真实的。”11月13日星期五，在财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士向议会介绍2027年预算后，阿明·亚当博士在议会对媒体表示，有关方面应作出解释，消除这些差异。他说，政府必须提供清晰且前后一致的信息，使议会能够妥善审查其支出计划、收入预测和经济目标。
