https://www.myjoyonline.com/prof-bokpin-.body: Professor of Finance and Economics at the University of Ghana Business School, Prof. Godfred Bokpin, has urged the government to adopt Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs) to finance major road infrastructure projects, saying that the approach would ease pressure on public finances and free up funds for schools, hospitals and other essential services across the country. He said Ghana could not continue to rely heavily on limited tax revenue to finance expensive road projects while communities across the 16 regions struggled with inadequate public infrastructure, including poor roads, insufficient school facilities and a shortage of doctors. Speaking on Joy FM's Super Morning Show on Friday, November 13, during a discussion on the review of the 2027 Budget, Prof. Bokpin said the government needed to reconsider its approach to infrastructure financing and allow private investors to take the lead in projects capable of generating revenue. He said that sound public finance principles required governments to avoid committing scarce public resources to commercially viable infrastructure that could be financed through private investment. “Let's not go against that sound theory. It has worked in so many countries.” Prof. Bokpin questioned the decision to commit substantial public funds to major road projects, particularly when other parts of the country urgently needed investment in basic infrastructure. He acknowledged the importance of improving major transport routes but argued that relying solely on the national budget to finance such projects would leave little room for investment in other critical areas. He cited the Accra-Kumasi and Accra-Takoradi roads as examples of projects that could attract private sector financing through properly structured PPP arrangements. According to him, the volume of traffic on these routes, coupled with their economic importance, provides a strong basis for considering private investment. He said the government should identify commercially viable infrastructure projects and develop financing arrangements that would attract investors, rather than using limited tax revenue to meet the entire cost. Prof. Bokpin also drew attention to the economic cost of road crashes, saying Ghana loses more than $4 billion annually through accidents and their associated effects. He said that improving major roads could reduce accidents, save travel time and increase productivity, making investment in such infrastructure economically worthwhile. “Road crashes alone impose a significant economic burden, costing Ghana over $4 billion annually. Road crashes alone,” he stressed. He explained that reducing accidents and travel delays would deliver savings to the economy, while a more efficient road network would support businesses and improve the movement of people and goods. The economist maintained that well-designed PPP arrangements could provide the funding needed for major infrastructure projects without placing the full financial burden on government. He acknowledged that some PPP projects in Ghana had not delivered the expected results but said that should not discourage the government from exploring the model. He cited Terminal 3 at Kotoka International Airport as an example of a project that demonstrated the potential of private sector participation in infrastructure development. For him, the success or failure of PPPs depends largely on the legal, financial and contractual arrangements put in place. “PPPs, some of them haven't worked in this country, but we know some that have also worked, including Terminal 3. It's about the structure, the framework that we put in place. Let's look at that,” he said. Prof. Bokpin further said that private sector involvement could result in lower construction and maintenance costs because investors would have an incentive to build durable infrastructure and manage it efficiently to recover their investments. He said investors would be more willing to participate if projects were properly planned, financially viable, and supported by a clear legal framework. “I am confident that if the private sector is doing it, the cost may be lower than the public sector doing it. And the longevity can be guaranteed, and the maintenance cost will be lower because the private sector will do it in such a way that the maintenance cost will be lower so that they can get their money from the excludable, bankable cash flows,” he explained. He therefore urged the government to prioritise key transport corridors, including Accra-Kumasi, Accra-Takoradi and Accra-Aflao, and explore PPP arrangements to develop them into modern expressways. He said such projects could attract capital from both local and international investors, reducing the need for the government to depend on tax revenue to finance major infrastructure development. Prof. Bokpin said one of the major benefits of adopting this approach would be the opportunity to redirect public funds towards infrastructure that might not be commercially attractive to private investors. He said that government revenue should be used to improve access to quality education, healthcare and other essential public services, particularly in underserved districts and regions. He said communities should not have to depend on major cities for basic services because of inadequate facilities in their own areas. The professor also linked Ghana's persistent traffic congestion to uneven development, saying that many people were forced to travel long distances to access better schools, hospitals and other services. According to him, more balanced development across the country could reduce unnecessary travel and ease pressure on urban roads. “If we can ensure structurally and spatially inclusive development, we can eliminate close to 20 per cent of the traffic you see in town,” he said. He explained that people often spend between two and two-and-a-half hours commuting to access services that should be available closer to their communities. He believes that investing in quality schools, hospitals and other facilities at the district and regional levels would reduce these journeys while improving living standards. Prof. Bokpin said the government could achieve this by using private capital for commercially viable projects and directing its limited revenue towards public infrastructure that does not generate direct financial returns. The economist cautioned that the government risked achieving only limited progress if it continued with its current infrastructure financing approach without considering the wider economic and social costs. He said focusing heavily on a few major projects could mean sacrificing investment in other areas that were equally important to national development. Using a major expressway as an example, he warned that celebrating the completion of one high-profile project could conceal the development needs left unmet elsewhere. “If you do that analysis, you will realise that four years to come, you celebrate an Accra expressway as a big project, but the denial and the sacrifice in all other areas will be such that, if you put everything together, if you are not careful, you may end up with a negative-sum game,” he said
https://www.myjoyonline.com/prof-bokpin-.title_zh: 博克平教授敦促政府利用公私合作伙伴关系为大型道路项目融资，腾出资源建设社会基础设施
https://www.myjoyonline.com/prof-bokpin-.body_zh: 加纳大学商学院金融与经济学教授Godfred Bokpin敦促政府采用公私合作（PPP）模式，为重大道路基础设施项目融资，称这一做法可以缓解公共财政压力，腾出资金用于全国各地的学校、医院及其他基本服务。他说，在全国16个地区普遍面临公共基础设施不足的情况下，加纳不能继续高度依赖有限的税收收入来资助成本高昂的道路项目；这些地区存在道路状况差、学校设施不足和医生短缺等问题。Bokpin教授于11月13日星期五接受Joy FM《超级早间秀》采访时，在讨论2027年预算审查时表示，政府需要重新考虑其基础设施融资方式，并允许私人投资者主导那些能够创造收入的项目。他说，稳健的公共财政原则要求政府避免将稀缺的公共资源投入可由私人融资、且在商业上具有可行性的基础设施项目。“我们不要违背这一稳健理论。它已经在许多国家奏效。”Bokpin教授质疑将大量公共资金投入重大道路项目的决定，尤其是在全国其他地区迫切需要投资基础基础设施的情况下。他承认改善主要交通线路十分重要，但认为仅靠国家预算为此类项目融资，将几乎没有余力投资其他关键领域。他以阿克拉—库马西公路和阿克拉—塔科拉迪公路为例，指出通过妥善设计公私合作安排，这些项目能够吸引私营部门融资。他认为，这些线路的交通流量及其经济重要性，为考虑私人投资提供了充分依据。他说，政府应确定在商业上可行的基础设施项目，并制定能够吸引投资者的融资安排，而不是依靠有限的税收收入承担全部成本。Bokpin教授还提请关注道路碰撞事故造成的经济成本，称加纳每年因事故及其相关影响损失超过40亿美元。他认为，改造主要道路可以减少事故、节省出行时间并提高生产率，因此投资此类基础设施在经济上是值得的。“仅道路碰撞事故就带来了沉重的经济负担，每年让加纳损失超过40亿美元。仅道路碰撞事故。”他强调说。他解释道，减少事故和出行延误将为经济带来节省，而更高效的道路网络将支持企业运营，并改善人员和货物流动。这位经济学家坚持认为，设计良好的公私合作安排能够为重大基础设施项目提供所需资金，而无需让政府承担全部财政负担。他承认，加纳部分公私合作项目未能取得预期成果，但表示这不应阻碍政府探索这一模式。他以科托卡国际机场3号航站楼为例，说明私人参与基础设施开发的潜力。在他看来，公私合作的成败很大程度上取决于所建立的法律、金融和合同安排。“公私合作中有些项目在这个国家没有奏效，但我们也知道有些项目取得了成功，包括3号航站楼。关键在于结构，以及我们建立的框架。我们应该审视这一点。”他说。Bokpin教授进一步表示，私营部门参与可能降低建设和维护成本，因为投资者会有动力修建耐久基础设施并高效管理，以收回投资。他说，如果项目规划得当、具有财务可行性并获得明确法律框架支持，投资者将更愿意参与。“我确信，如果由私营部门来做，成本可能低于公共部门来做，而且使用寿命可以得到保障，维护成本也会更低，因为私营部门会采用使维护成本更低的运营方式，从而从可排除、可用于融资的现金流中收回资金。”他解释道。因此，他敦促政府优先推进关键交通走廊，包括阿克拉—库马西、阿克拉—塔科拉迪和阿克拉—阿福劳公路，并探索公私合作安排，将其建设成现代化高速公路。他说，此类项目能够吸引本地和国际投资者的资本，减少政府依赖税收收入为重大基础设施开发融资的需要。Bokpin教授表示，采用这一方式的主要益处之一，是可以把公共资金转用于可能不具备私人投资者商业吸引力的基础设施。他认为，政府收入应用于改善优质教育、医疗保健和其他基本公共服务的可及性，特别是在服务不足的地区和区域。他说，社区不应因本地设施不足而不得不依赖大城市获得基本服务。这位教授还把加纳持续存在的交通拥堵与发展不均衡联系起来，指出许多人不得不长距离出行，才能获得更好的学校、医院和其他服务。他认为，全国范围内更加均衡的发展可以减少不必要的出行，并缓解城市道路的压力。“如果我们能够确保在结构和空间上具有包容性的发展，就能消除你在城内看到的近20%的交通流量。”他说。他解释道，人们经常需要花两至两个半小时通勤，才能获得本应在社区附近获得的服务。他认为，在地区和区域层面投资优质学校、医院及其他设施，可以缩短这些出行距离，同时提高生活水平。Bokpin教授说，政府可以利用私人资本为商业上可行的项目提供资金，并将有限的收入投向不能产生直接财务回报的公共基础设施。这位经济学家警告称，如果政府继续采用当前的基础设施融资方式，而不考虑更广泛的经济和社会成本，其进展可能十分有限。他说，过度集中于少数重大项目，可能意味着牺牲其他同样对国家发展重要领域的投资。他以一条大型高速公路为例，警告庆祝一个高知名度项目完工，可能掩盖其他地方尚未满足的发展需求。“如果你进行这样的分析，就会发现四年后，你会把阿克拉高速公路作为重大项目来庆祝，但所有其他领域遭受的忽视和牺牲会非常严重。把所有因素放在一起看，如果你不谨慎，最终可能会变成一场负和博弈。”他说。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The remains of two Korean independence fighters laid to rest in the United States and Uzbekistan will return home next week to mark the 80th anniversary of a project to repatriate the remains of such activists from overseas, the veterans ministry said Friday. It marks the first time that the remains of an independence fighter buried in Uzbekistan will return home.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国退伍军人部周五表示，安葬在美国和乌兹别克斯坦的两位韩国独立运动人士遗骸将于下周回国，以纪念从海外迎回此类活动人士遗骸项目实施80周年。这标志着安葬在乌兹别克斯坦的独立运动人士遗骸首次回国。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The remains of two Korean independence fighters laid to rest in the United States and Uzbekistan will return home next week to mark the 80th anniversary of a project to repatriate the remains of such activists from overseas, the veterans ministry said Friday. The remains of Ho Si-han and Lee Gwal will be brought back from the U.S. and Uzbekistan, respectively, on Sunday, according to the ministry. It marks the first time that the remains of an independence fighter buried in Uzbekistan will return home. An event marking their return will be held at a memorial park in Seoul on Monday, attended by some 300 personnel, and the remains will later be buried at the national cemetery in the central city of Daejeon. Ho, born in Seoul in 1885, was arrested by the Japanese police while raising military funds following the March 1 independence movement against Japan's 1910-45 colonial rule of Korea. He also took part in a number of fundraising schemes to support the Korean independence movement from 1927 to 1945, before he died in Los Angeles in 1956. The Korean government posthumously awarded him the Aejok Order of Merit for National Foundation in 2021 over his role in the country's independence. Lee, born in North Hamgyong Province in 1898, moved to Manchuria and actively participated in Korean national organizations in Russia's far eastern region of Primorsky Krai in 1919. He also served as the diplomatic delegate of the Korean Provisional Government in the early 1920s, but he was later deported to Uzbekistan in 1937, where he died. Lee was awarded the National Foundation Medal in 2009. The repatriation comes as part of civilian and government-led efforts that began with the return of the remains of three renowned Korean independence fighters, including Yun Bong-gil, in 1946 and have continued for 80 years. Meanwhile, the ministry has identified 240 tombs in total of Korean independence fighters buried across 10 countries, including China, the U.S. and Kazakhstan, and plans to bring their remains back home after consulting with their bereaved families. The veterans ministry said 158 sets of remains of independence fighters have been so far repatriated from 14 countries
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 两名韩国独立运动人士的遗骸将从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运回韩国
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国 veterans ministry 周五表示，两名分别安葬在美国和乌兹别克斯坦的韩国独立运动人士的遗骸将于下周回国，以纪念从海外迎回此类活动人士遗骸计划80周年。据该部透露，Ho Si-han和Lee Gwal的遗骸将分别于周日从美国和乌兹别克斯坦运回。这是首次迎回一位安葬在乌兹别克斯坦的独立运动人士遗骸。纪念他们归国的活动将于周一在首尔的一座纪念公园举行，约有300人参加，随后遗骸将被安葬在大田市中心的国家公墓。Ho于1885年出生于首尔，在日本殖民统治朝鲜的1910年至1945年间，他曾参加反对日本殖民统治的3月1日独立运动并筹集军费，后被日本警察逮捕。1927年至1945年间，他还参与了多项支持韩国独立运动的筹款活动，之后于1956年在洛杉矶去世。鉴于他在韩国独立事业中的贡献，韩国政府于2021年追授他爱国建国勋章。Lee于1898年出生于朝鲜咸镜北道，1919年移居满洲，并积极参与俄罗斯远东滨海边疆区的韩国人组织。20世纪20年代初，他还担任韩国临时政府的外交代表，但后来于1937年被驱逐至乌兹别克斯坦，并在那里去世。Lee于2009年获颁建国勋章。这次迎回遗骸是民间和政府共同推动的工作的一部分；该工作始于1946年迎回包括Yun Bong-gil在内的三名著名韩国独立运动人士遗骸，并持续了80年。与此同时，该部已在包括中国、美国和哈萨克斯坦在内的10个国家确认了240处韩国独立运动人士墓葬，并计划在与遇难者家属协商后将其遗骸迎回国内。韩国 veterans ministry 表示，截至目前，已从14个国家迎回158具独立运动人士遗骸

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's rice output declined for the fifth consecutive year in 2026 amid changing dietary habits, data showed Friday, with the cultivation area also reaching a new low. Rice production decreased 0.9 percent year-on-year to 3.5 million tons this year, according to data compiled by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. It marked the fourth-lowest level since the government began compiling the data in 1965. The combined area of rice paddies in the country fell 1.1 percent year-on-year to 670,000 hectares, the smallest on record. Despite the decline in overall production, output per 1,000 square meters increased 0.2 percent year-on-year to 524 kilograms this year, according to the ministry. Rice remains a staple food in Korea, but consumption has steadily fallen in recent decades amid shifts in dietary preferences. The decrease in production also came amid the government's efforts to manage output while encouraging farmers to switch to other crops. By region, South Jeolla Province and Gwangju together produced 736,000 tons of rice, followed by South Chungcheong Province with 681,000 tons and North Jeolla Province with 526,000 tons, the government findings showed

https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.body: Account subscription benefits alongside Premium Stories, Editorials, Opinions and more. Unlock these with Subscription Senior Congress leader and MP Shashi Tharoor has alleged that 115 of the 315 speakers invited to the second edition of the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad were denied entry into India or had their visas cancelled, “apparently on the instructions of the Union Ministry of Home Affairs”. Mr. Tharoor, who is in Hyderabad for the Bharat Summit, in a post on social media platforms, questioned the legal basis for the action and said it was unclear under which provision of law the government had taken such a step. He pointed out that the summit would conclude on Saturday (November 14, 2026), making it impossible to reverse the decision in time for the affected participants to attend. “What a shame that a proud democracy has become so insecure that it must stifle any voices it fears will be critical!” he wrote. His allegations came in the wake of a Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng claiming that she had been advised by the Indian Embassy not to travel to India despite holding a valid visa to participate in the summit. She works for the Oslo-based newspaper Dagsavisen. Earlier, Congress MP and Telangana Congress media in-charge Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy had also alleged that nearly 30% of the invitees could not travel to India because of visa-related issues. Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi is scheduled to participate in the valedictory session on Saturday. The controversy has raised questions over the participation of international delegates at the two-day summit, which seeks to bring together nearly 1,000 participants from India and around 70 countries. The event is being held against the backdrop of the 80th year of India’s Independence and the 137th birth anniversary of the country’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. Mr. Tharoor said the summit would also focus on establishing a think tank, ‘Our World Institute’, and creating a platform for dialogue and cooperation between the Global South and the Global North. The allegations come amid political controversy over the event, with the BJP calling it an “anti-India summit” and accusing Mr. Gandhi of giving a platform to forces opposed to the country’s interests. BJP leaders in Telangana have announced plans to protest against his visit to Hyderabad. Union Coal Minister G. Kishan Reddy, addressing a press conference in New Delhi on Thursday, termed the Bharat Summit an “anti-India summit”. The BJP alleged the event was meant to bring together forces critical of India and questioned the Congress leadership’s motives for organising it. Telangana BJP president N. Ramchander Rao questioned the rationale behind holding such an event in the State when the government was facing financial constraints. He accused Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy of spending public money to sponsor what he described as anti-India forces, in order to please Mr. Rahul Gandhi. The BJP’s criticism has added a political dimension to the controversy surrounding the summit, particularly following allegations that several international speakers and invitees were unable to travel to India because of visa-related issues. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/t.body_zh:
订阅账户还可享受《Premium Stories》、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些权益。

资深国会议党领袖兼议员沙希·塔鲁尔称，在海得拉巴举行的第二届 Bharat Summit 邀请了315名发言人，其中115人被拒绝入境印度或签证遭取消，“显然是根据联邦内政部的指示”。塔鲁尔先生目前正在海得拉巴参加 Bharat Summit。他在社交媒体平台发文，质疑这一行动的法律依据，并表示不清楚政府依据法律中的哪一项条款采取了这一措施。他指出，峰会将于星期六（2026年11月14日）闭幕，因此受影响者不可能及时推翻这一决定并参会。他写道：“一个引以为豪的民主国家竟变得如此缺乏安全感，以至于必须压制任何它认为可能提出批评的声音，真是可悲！”

这些指控是在挪威记者 Helle Lyng 声称自己尽管持有参加峰会的有效签证，仍被印度使馆建议不要前往印度之后提出的。她供职于总部位于奥斯陆的报纸《Dagsavisen》。此前，国会议员兼特伦甘纳邦国大党媒体负责人 Chamala Kiran Kumar Reddy 也曾指控，近30%的受邀者因签证相关问题无法赴印度。

人民院反对党领袖拉胡尔·甘地计划于星期六参加闭幕会议。这场争议引发了对国际代表参与这场为期两天的峰会的疑问。此次峰会旨在汇集来自印度及约70个国家的近1,000名参与者。活动是在印度独立80周年暨该国首任总理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁诞辰137周年的背景下举行的。

塔鲁尔先生表示，峰会还将重点关注成立一个名为“Our World Institute”的智库，并搭建全球南方与全球北方之间的对话与合作平台。

这些指控出现之际，该活动正引发政治争议。印度人民党称其为“反印度峰会”，并指责甘地先生为反对国家利益的势力提供平台。印度人民党在特伦甘纳邦的领导人宣布计划抗议他访问海得拉巴。联邦煤炭部长 G. Kishan Reddy 星期四在新德里举行的新闻发布会上称 Bharat Summit 是“反印度峰会”。印度人民党声称，该活动旨在召集批评印度的势力，并质疑国大党领导层举办此次活动的动机。

特伦甘纳邦印度人民党主席 N. Ramchander Rao 质疑，在政府面临财政约束的情况下在该邦举办此类活动的原因。他指责首席部长 A. Revanth Reddy 花费公共资金赞助他所谓的反印度势力，以取悦拉胡尔·甘地先生。

在多名国际发言人和受邀者因签证相关问题无法赴印度的指控之后，印度人民党的批评又为围绕此次峰会的争议增添了政治层面的争论。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 外交部长赵显星期五启程前往中国，与中国外交部长王毅就双边关系及朝鲜半岛问题举行会谈，其中包括华盛顿与平壤恢复对话的可能性。根据外交部的消息，赵显计划于当天晚些时候与王毅会谈，随后出席中国外交部长主持的晚宴。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Foreign Minister Cho Hyun departed for China on Friday for talks with his Chinese counterpart, Wang Yi, on bilateral relations and issues concerning the Korean Peninsula, including the possibility of renewed dialogue between Washington and Pyongyang. Cho was scheduled to hold talks with Wang later in the day, followed by a dinner hosted by the Chinese foreign minister, according to the foreign ministry. "We plan to discuss the overall state of bilateral relations, particularly issues that need to be coordinated between the two countries ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit," Cho told reporters at Gimpo International Airport before departing for China. His visit comes ahead of President Lee Jae Myung's planned trip to China for the APEC summit in Shenzhen from Wednesday to Thursday, and the ministerial meeting was expected to help lay the groundwork for a potential meeting between Lee and Chinese President Xi Jinping. "We plan to hold comprehensive discussions with China on these issues, particularly North Korea-related matters, including the possibility of U.S.-North Korea talks," Cho added. There has been speculation about a possible meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un during Trump's trip to Asia, as the U.S. president has expressed interest in resuming dialogue with Pyongyang. Asked whether he believes China is willing to mediate between Washington and Pyongyang, Cho expressed uncertainty over how actively Beijing might pursue such efforts. "I don't think there is much chance of China actively inviting (Kim) to the APEC summit for talks, but it is still too early to tell," the minister said. Wang accompanied Xi during his visit to the U.S. in August. The Chinese foreign minister was also present during Kim's surprise visit to the Chinese border city of Dandong last month. He also met with Kim Song-nam, a senior ruling Workers' Party official, in Beijing last week. A South Korean presidential official said Thursday that a meeting between Trump and Kim on the sidelines of the APEC summit was unlikely, while noting that it was difficult to predict whether contact between the two leaders might take place before or after the summit. China's foreign ministry said Thursday that Beijing attaches great importance to Cho's visit and is willing to work with Seoul to implement important agreements reached by the two countries' leaders. Cho's visit follows an invitation from Wang during their talks in Seoul in August. At the time, the two ministers exchanged views on bilateral relations and Korean Peninsula issues, with Cho calling for Beijing to play a constructive role in bringing North Korea back to dialogue. Cho plans to return home Saturday after holding a meeting with Korean correspondents in China, officials said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国外交部长赵显周五启程前往中国，与中国外长王毅就双边关系及朝鲜半岛问题举行会谈，其中包括华盛顿与平壤重启对话的可能性。据韩国外交部介绍，赵显当天晚些时候将与王毅会谈，随后出席由中国外长主持的晚宴。赵显在金浦国际机场启程前往中国前对记者说：“我们计划讨论双边关系的总体状况，尤其是亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会前两国需要协调的议题。”赵显此访是在李在明总统计划于周三至周四赴深圳出席亚太经合组织峰会之前进行的；此次部长级会议预计将为李在明与中国国家主席习近平可能举行的会晤铺路。赵显补充说：“我们计划就这些问题与中国进行全面讨论，尤其是与朝鲜有关的事务，包括美朝会谈的可能性。”在特朗普亚洲之行期间，外界一直猜测美国总统特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩可能会面，因为特朗普已表示有兴趣恢复与平壤的对话。当被问及是否认为中国愿意在华盛顿与平壤之间进行调解时，赵显对北京会多积极地推动此类努力表示不确定。他说：“我认为，中国主动邀请（金正恩）参加亚太经合组织峰会并举行会谈的可能性不大，但现在下结论还为时过早。”今年8月习近平访问美国期间，王毅陪同习近平出访。中国外长上个月还陪同金正恩突然访问中国边境城市丹东。上周，他还在北京会见了朝鲜执政党劳动党高级官员金正南。韩国总统府官员周四表示，特朗普与金正恩在亚太经合组织峰会期间会面的可能性不大，同时指出，难以预测两位领导人是否会在峰会前或峰会后接触。中国外交部周四表示，北京高度重视赵显此次访问，并愿与首尔合作落实两国领导人达成的重要协议。赵显此次访问源于王毅8月在首尔会谈时发出的邀请。当时，两位外长就双边关系和朝鲜半岛问题交换了意见，赵显呼吁北京在推动朝鲜重返对话方面发挥建设性作用。官员表示，赵显计划于周六在中国与驻华韩国记者举行会面后回国。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — The FBI said Thursday that it had seized more than $1.2 billion of cryptocurrency reported stolen last month from Binance , the world's largest crypto exchange. The theft of about $6.3 billion from Binance is regarded as the biggest crypto heist in history, and the FBI has previously attributed it to a North Korean hacking group known as TraderTraitor. The U.S. government and private sector have so far combined to freeze more than $2.7 billion of the stolen funds, and the Justice Department said Thursday that it has now obtained court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of that total. Typically in those situations, the U.S. government will file a claim of forfeiture with a judge, who will then determine who has a legitimate claim to the recovered funds. Also Thursday, the FBI blamed North Korea for a separate social engineering scheme that officials say resulted in the theft of $400 million worth of cryptocurrency over the last 18 months. That scheme, known as FaceStealer, involves a complicated chain of events combining the hijacking of popular messaging apps and the recording of deepfake videos. U.S. officials have repeatedly accused North Korea of using cyber schemes to generate funds for its regime, including its illicit weapons program

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: WASHINGTON — The U.S. House of Representatives has passed a bill aimed at protecting American small businesses from economic and cybersecurity threats posed by foreign adversaries, including North Korea. The House passed the Combating Foreign Threats to Main Street Act of 2026 on Wednesday, The bill would require the Small Business Administration (SBA) to provide small businesses with information and guidance on identifying and responding to threats from foreign adversaries. "China, Russia and North Korea are working to undermine our economic and national security, and American businesses are increasingly caught in the crosshairs," Rep. Roger Williams (R-TX) said during a House floor debate on Wednesday. The legislation seeks to help businesses address risks such as intellectual property theft, cyberattacks, counterfeit goods and predatory investment practices. It now subject to deliberation by the Senate. "While these threats affect businesses of every size, small businesses are often the most vulnerable, and they simply do not have the resources or expertise to identify these threats and protect themselves," Williams said. Under the bill, the SBA would be required to review its educational materials annually starting in October 2027 and notify relevant congressional committees of certain activities posing significant risks to U.S. economic or national security interests
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 美国众议院通过法案，保护小企业免受外国对手侵害，包括朝鲜
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 华盛顿——美国众议院通过了一项法案，旨在保护美国小型企业，使其免受外国对手（包括朝鲜）带来的经济威胁和网络安全威胁。众议院于周三通过了《2026年应对外国对主街威胁法案》。根据该法案，美国小企业管理局（SBA）必须向小型企业提供相关信息和指导，帮助其识别并应对外国对手的威胁。众议员罗杰·威廉姆斯（共和党，得克萨斯州）在周三的众议院辩论中说：“中国、俄罗斯和朝鲜正试图破坏我们的经济和国家安全，美国企业日益成为他们的目标。”该法案旨在帮助企业应对知识产权盗窃、网络攻击、假冒商品和掠夺性投资行为等风险。该法案现交由参议院审议。威廉姆斯说：“虽然这些威胁影响着各种规模的企业，但小型企业往往最为脆弱，而且它们根本不具备识别这些威胁并保护自身所需的资源或专业能力。”根据该法案，从2027年10月起，美国小企业管理局每年都必须审查其教育材料，并将美国经济或国家安全利益面临重大风险的某些活动通报给相关国会委员会

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title: China's memory makers are catching up. What happens when they do?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary: CXMT and Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC) are the twin pillars of China’s drive for memory self-sufficiency, part of Beijing’s broader pursuit of technological independence facing U.S. export restrictions. CXMT, founded in Hefei, capital city of China’s eastern Anhui province, in 2016, has become the world’s fourth-largest producer of DRAM, the working memory used in computers and smartphones.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.summary_zh: 长鑫存储和长江存储（YMTC）是中国实现存储芯片自主化的两大支柱，也是北京在美国实施出口限制之际推进更广泛技术独立的组成部分。长鑫存储于2016年在中国东部安徽省省会合肥成立，现已成为全球第四大DRAM生产商。DRAM是计算机和智能手机使用的工作内存。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: The memory business has rarely had it this good, thanks to the artificial intelligence (AI) boom. Korea’s chipmakers are reporting extraordinary earnings and unusual confidence that the good times will last. SK hynix’s third-quarter operating profit rose more than sevenfold to 83.3 trillion won ($62 billion), an operating margin of almost 80 percent. Samsung Electronics’ rose nearly ninefold to 107.4 trillion won, with its memory business setting records of its own. Across the West Sea, China’s challengers are sharing in the windfall. ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) remains far smaller, but its quarterly revenue rose more than sevenfold to 118.7 billion yuan ($17.8 billion), with a net profit attributable to shareholders of 54.4 billion yuan, reversing years of losses. CXMT and Yangtze Memory Technologies (YMTC) are the twin pillars of China’s drive for memory self-sufficiency, part of Beijing’s broader pursuit of technological independence facing U.S. export restrictions. Fresh capital, new factories and increasingly sophisticated technology are helping them challenge the overseas incumbents that have long dominated the industry. The remaining tech gap is “hard to close,” according to Laila Khawaja, research director at Gavekal Technologies. She expects Chinese and non-Chinese memory markets to diverge in supply chains and technology paths, but sees Chinese suppliers’ gains at home spilling over into global pricing and bargaining power. “Chinese suppliers do not need to flood overseas markets to create that pressure,” she said. CXMT, founded in Hefei, capital city of China’s eastern Anhui province, in 2016, has become the world’s fourth-largest producer of DRAM, the working memory used in computers and smartphones. Its share of global DRAM revenue reached 9 percent in the third quarter of 2026, up from 5 percent a year earlier, Counterpoint Research's latest data shows. Government funding helped finance its entry into the capital-intensive industry. The memory boom is now funding its ramp-up: revenue rose more than eightfold to 269 billion yuan in the first nine months of 2026. Its blockbuster Shanghai IPO in July raised 66.6 billion yuan, the biggest in Asia of the year. Morgan Stanley estimates that CXMT’s monthly wafer-processing capacity could reach 500,000 by 2028, roughly 15 percent of the global DRAM total, with bit shipments growing at a compound annual rate of 40 percent between 2025 and 2028. CXMT is also moving up the technology ladder. At an earnings briefing on Oct. 30, the company highlighted it had begun mass production using its fifth-generation process, which it claims produces at least 50 percent more chips per wafer than its predecessor. CXMT also said it had validated prototypes using its sixth-generation 4F2 design, which could theoretically shrink memory cells by a third compared with conventional layouts. It plans to send customers samples of server memory modules using the technology by year-end. YMTC, founded in Wuhan the same year with central and provincial state backing, has made similar strides in NAND flash, which retains data without power. By the second quarter of 2026, it ranked third globally by shipment volume, with a 16.5 share, ahead of Japan’s Kioxia, according to Counterpoint. “With AI driving the NAND super cycle, YMTC has become the fastest-growing vendor, with prudent investments in capability and capacity despite geopolitical headwinds,” said Choi Jeong-ku, senior analyst at Counterpoint Research, noting that the chipmaker’s revenue in 2026 is bound to grow six times faster than the industry and its peers. Its strength lies partly in Xtacking, an architecture unveiled in 2018 that builds memory cells and their control circuitry on separate wafers before bonding them together. This allows denser storage and faster data transfer. Samsung has licensed YMTC’s hybrid-bonding patents and SK hynix was also said to be in talks, local media outlets reported, while Micron faces patent infringement lawsuits brought by the Chinese company. YMTC is seeking 33 billion yuan through a Shanghai listing without a clear timeline.It reported a first-quarter net profit of 33.4 billion yuan — more than twice its earnings for all of 2025, prospectus shows. Equipment orders tell the same story. Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment China (AMEC), which makes tools that etch microscopic structures into chips, booked record orders in the first nine months of 2026, with memory manufacturers accounting for about 60 percent. The harder test is turning those advances into chips that can be made reliably, at competitive cost and in volume. CXMT’s earlier announcement on 4F2 rattled investors, sending shares in SK hynix, Samsung and Micron tumbling that day, although broader concerns over AI spending also weighed on the sector. However, its rivals were more circumspect. SK hynix said it would keep extending its proven 6F2 architecture before switching to a new design. “The timing of technological development and the timing of commercialization are distinct from each other,” management said during its third-quarter earnings call. Samsung is also developing 4F2. Micron has excluded it from its road map, arguing that smaller transistor layouts do not necessarily improve density and the capacitors that store electrical charge remain the limiting factor. Nomura expects CXMT’s 4F2 chips to reach volume production only in 2027-28, and estimates that its manufacturing technology still trails the leaders by at least three years. “CXMT remains about two generations behind the industry leaders,” Macquarie’s Daniel Kim wrote in an October report. He estimates its conventional DRAM process delivers only about 65 percent as much memory per wafer as the industry’s leading processes. The divide is wider in high-bandwidth memory (HBM), which stacks DRAM chips to feed data rapidly to AI processors. “CXMT remains primarily a conventional DRAM maker, and is not yet capable of mass-producing HBM profitably,” Khawaja said. Its preceding DRAM platform still falls short of mature industry yields — the proportion of working chips — of 85-90 percent, she estimates. YMTC is closer to the leaders in NAND, but still trails by about a generation in cutting-edge layer counts. Adding more layers requires equipment capable of etching ever deeper, narrower structures through the stack — another area where Chinese toolmakers lag. Equipment remains a central constraint for both companies. Beyond gaps in technology, manufacturing know-how and research talent, domestic toolmakers face “patent walls, not to mention the rigorous validation period required and the high requirement for tool stability,” Khawaja said. “My base case remains further erosion of foreign suppliers’ market share in China,” Khawaja said. That displacement can affect global prices even without Chinese chips leaving the country. The first openings are in mainstream memory for smartphones, PCs and storage, supported by Beijing’s localization mandates for state-backed users and Chinese companies’ efforts to hedge against supply risks, she said. As established manufacturers prioritize AI products, shortages are also prompting customers outside China to qualify Chinese alternatives. Once qualified, Chinese suppliers can gain a foothold as second or third sources, which “could affect the big three's [Samsung, SK Hynix, Micron] bargaining power over the long run,” she said. The pressure will be uneven. CXMT poses a more immediate challenge in conventional DRAM than advanced HBM, where the manufacturing gap remains wide. YMTC’s push into enterprise SSDs could bring it into closer competition with industry leader Samsung in higher-value data center storage. Counterpoint Research expects server-related products to generate nearly 39 percent of its revenue by 2028, up from virtually nothing in 2024. “The bigger question is whether YMTC can convert this into design wins with customers outside China, not just domestic hyperscalers,” said MS Hwang, a research director at Counterpoint. The greater medium-term risk is that AI demand slows after new capacity comes online, Khawaja said. That could push incumbents to redirect DRAM capacity towards conventional products, where stronger Chinese competition could weaken their pricing power. Equipment constraints make an imminent China-driven glut unlikely, she added. For memory chipmakers, prosperity usually arrives with an expiry date. Rising prices finance new factories; the factories produce a glut; the glut destroys the profits that built them. AI has interrupted the cycle. SK hynix expects demand to outstrip supply through 2030. For the boom to last, AI customers must keep spending faster than chipmakers can add usable capacity. Industry analysts disagree over how durable those supply constraints will prove. Morgan Stanley’s Shawn Kim argues that supply will eventually catch up. “Structurally higher AI secular growth riding on top of a cycle... is still a cycle,” he wrote in an October note
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 中国存储芯片制造商正在追赶。等他们追上后会发生什么？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 受益于人工智能（AI）热潮，存储芯片行业许久未曾如此景气。韩国芯片制造商正报告非凡的盈利，并罕见地对好日子的持续充满信心。SK hynix第三季度营业利润增长逾七倍，达到83.3万亿韩元（620亿美元），营业利润率接近80%。Samsung Electronics营业利润增长近九倍，达到107.4万亿韩元，其存储业务也创下自身纪录。在黄海另一边，中国的挑战者也在分享这场意外之财。ChangXin Memory Technologies（CXMT）规模仍小得多，但其季度营收增长逾七倍，达到1187亿元人民币（178亿美元），归属于股东的净利润达到544亿元，扭转了多年的亏损。CXMT和Yangtze Memory Technologies（YMTC）是中国推动存储芯片自给自足的两大支柱，也是北京在美国出口限制下追求更广泛技术自主的一部分。新增资本、新建工厂和日益先进的技术，正帮助它们挑战长期主导该行业的海外 incumbents。Gavekal Technologies研究主管Laila Khawaja表示，剩余的技术差距“很难弥合”。她预计，中国和非中国存储市场将在供应链和技术路径上分化，但认为中国供应商在国内取得的进展将外溢至全球定价和议价能力。她说：“中国供应商无需向海外市场倾销产品，就能形成这种压力。”CXMT于2016年在中国东部安徽省省会合肥成立，如今已成为全球第四大DRAM生产商。DRAM是计算机和智能手机使用的工作存储器。Counterpoint Research最新数据显示，2026年第三季度，CXMT占全球DRAM营收的9%，高于一年前的5%。政府资金帮助其进入这一资本密集型行业。如今，存储芯片热潮正为CXMT的产能爬坡提供资金：2026年前九个月，其营收增长逾八倍，达到2690亿元。其7月在上海进行的巨型IPO募资666亿元，成为当年亚洲规模最大的IPO。Morgan Stanley估计，到2028年，CXMT的晶圆月产能可能达到50万片，约占全球DRAM总量的15%，其比特出货量在2025年至2028年间预计以40%的复合年增长率增长。CXMT也在沿技术阶梯向上攀登。在10月30日的业绩说明会上，该公司强调已利用第五代制程开始量产，并称该制程每片晶圆生产的芯片至少比上一代多50%。CXMT还表示，已验证采用第六代4F2设计的样品；理论上，与传统布局相比，该设计可将存储单元缩小三分之一。公司计划在年底前向客户发送采用这项技术的服务器存储模块样品。YMTC于同年成立于武汉，在中央和省级state支持下，在无需供电即可保存数据的NAND闪存领域也取得了类似进展。据Counterpoint称，到2026年第二季度，YMTC按出货量排名全球第三，市场份额为16.5%，超过日本的Kioxia。Counterpoint Research高级分析师Choi Jeong-ku表示：“在AI推动NAND超级周期之际，尽管面临地缘政治逆风，YMTC仍凭借对能力和产能的审慎投资，成为增长最快的供应商。”他还指出，这家芯片制造商2026年的营收增速预计将比行业及其竞争对手快六倍。YMTC的部分优势来自Xtacking架构。该架构于2018年发布，先在不同的晶圆上构建存储单元及其控制电路，再将两者键合在一起，从而实现更高存储密度和更快数据传输。当地媒体报道称，Samsung已获得YMTC混合键合专利许可，SK hynix据称也在洽谈相关事宜；与此同时，Micron正面临这家中国企业提起的专利侵权诉讼。YMTC正寻求通过在上海上市募资330亿元，但尚无明确时间表。招股说明书显示，其第一季度净利润为334亿元，超过2025年全年利润的两倍。设备订单也印证了同一趋势。Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment China（AMEC）生产在芯片上蚀刻 microscopic structures 的设备，2026年前九个月录得创纪录订单，其中约60%来自存储芯片制造商。更艰难的考验，是把这些技术进展转化为能够以有竞争力的成本、可靠且大规模量产的芯片。CXMT早些时候关于4F2的公告曾震动投资者，导致SK hynix、Samsung和Micron股价当日大跌，不过市场对AI支出的更广泛担忧也拖累了整个行业。然而，其竞争对手的态度更为谨慎。SK hynix表示，将在转向新设计前继续延伸其成熟的6F2架构。管理层在第三季度业绩电话会上表示：“技术开发的时点与商业化的时点彼此不同。”Samsung也在开发4F2。Micron则未将其纳入路线图，认为更小的晶体管布局未必能提高密度，而用于储存电荷的电容器仍是限制因素。Nomura预计，CXMT的4F2芯片要到2027—2028年才能实现量产，并估计其制造技术仍落后领先者至少三年。Macquarie的Daniel Kim在10月报告中写道：“CXMT仍落后行业领先者约两代技术。”他估计，CXMT的传统DRAM制程每片晶圆可提供的存储容量仅约为行业领先制程的65%。在高带宽内存（HBM）领域，差距更大。HBM通过堆叠DRAM芯片，为AI处理器快速输送数据。Khawaja说：“CXMT目前主要仍是传统DRAM制造商，尚不能以盈利方式大规模生产HBM。”她估计，CXMT现有DRAM平台的良率——即可用芯片所占比例——仍未达到成熟行业的85%—90%。YMTC在NAND领域更接近领先者，但在最前沿的堆叠层数方面仍落后约一代。增加层数需要能够穿过堆叠结构蚀刻更深、更窄结构的设备，而这也是中国设备制造商落后的领域之一。设备仍是两家公司面临的核心制约。除了技术、制造诀窍和研究人才方面的差距，Khawaja表示，国内设备制造商还面临“专利围墙，更不用说严格的验证周期以及对设备稳定性的高要求”。她表示：“我的基准判断仍是，外国供应商在中国的市场份额将进一步被蚕食。”即使中国芯片不离开本土，这种替代也可能影响全球价格。她说，首个突破口出现在智能手机、PC和存储设备使用的主流存储芯片领域；北京针对受state支持用户的国产化 mandate，以及中国企业规避供应风险的努力，为这一进程提供了助力。随着成熟制造商优先保障AI产品，短缺也在促使中国以外的客户认证中国替代品。一旦通过认证，中国供应商就能作为第二或第三供应来源站稳脚跟，而这“可能从长期影响三巨头[Samsung、SK Hynix、Micron]的议价能力”。压力不会均匀分布。在传统DRAM方面，CXMT构成的挑战比先进HBM更为直接，后者的制造差距仍然很大。YMTC进军企业级SSD，可能使其在价值更高、数据中心存储用量更大的市场与行业龙头Samsung展开更直接竞争。Counterpoint Research预计，到2028年，与服务器相关的产品将贡献YMTC近39%的营收，而2024年这一比例几乎为零。Counterpoint研究主管MS Hwang表示：“更大的问题在于，YMTC能否将这些进展转化为中国以外客户的设计订单，而不只是国内超大规模云服务商的设计订单。”Khawaja说，中期更大的风险是，在新增产能上线后AI需求放缓。这可能促使 incumbents 将DRAM产能转向传统产品，而中国企业在该领域更强的竞争可能削弱其定价能力。她补充称，设备制约使中国很快引发供给过剩的可能性不大。对存储芯片制造商而言，繁荣通常都带着有效期。价格上涨为新工厂提供资金；这些工厂制造出供给过剩；供给过剩又摧毁了支撑它们扩张的利润。AI打断了这一周期。SK hynix预计，到2030年需求都将超过供应。要让繁荣持续，AI客户必须继续以快于芯片制造商新增可用产能的速度投入。行业分析师对供应制约究竟能持续多久存在分歧。Morgan Stanley的Shawn Kim认为，供应最终将追赶上需求。他在10月的一份报告中写道：“结构性更高的AI长期增长叠加于一个周期之上……终究仍是一个周期。”

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.summary_zh: 阿布贾——联邦政府已签署Port Harcourt International Airport为期30年的特许经营协议，作为吸引私人投资、提高运营效率并释放该国亏损机场经济潜力的一部分。航空与航天发展部长Festus Keyamo先生昨日在阿布贾与Port Harcourt Airport Company Limited签署特许经营协议时披露了这一消息。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.body: ABUJA—The Federal Government has signed a 30-year concession agreement for the Port Harcourt International Airport, as part of efforts to attract private investment, improve operational efficiency and unlock the economic potential of the nation’s loss-making airports. Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Mr. Festus Keyamo, disclosed this, yesterday, in Abuja during the signing of the concession agreement with Port Harcourt Airport Company Limited. Keyamo said the concession was aimed at improving the operational efficiency of the airport, boosting revenue generation and unlocking its commercial potential. He explained that the Federal Government has been using profits generated from major airports to subsidise the operations of other airports that were running at a loss. “Some of our airports are being run at a loss. We make so much money from some of our primary airports, and most of those profits are ploughed into running other airports,” Keyamo said. He noted that the concession had the approval of President Bola Tinubu and the Federal Executive Council, adding that the process was not a sudden decision but one that successive administrations had struggled to implement. Keyamo said previous attempts to concession airports were frustrated by resistance from labour unions and court cases involving the government. He, however, attributed the successful conclusion of the process to negotiations with aviation unions, saying the government had secured their agreement before signing the deal. The minister assured workers that the concession would not lead to job losses or a reduction in their conditions of service. He said Tinubu had directed that the welfare of aviation workers must be protected throughout the concession process. “President Bola Tinubu was very concerned about that, that no worker should lose his job. The conditions of service should remain the same,” he said. Keyamo added that the concessionaire would be subjected to performance reviews every five years to ensure compliance with the terms of the agreement. He warned that the government could take back the airport if the concessionaire failed to meet the agreed standards. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府将哈科特港机场特许经营权授予企业，为期30年
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/fg-c.body_zh: 阿布贾——联邦政府已签署哈科特国际机场30年期特许经营协议，这是政府为吸引私人投资、提高运营效率并释放全国亏损机场经济潜力而采取的措施。航空与航天发展部长费斯图斯·凯亚莫昨日在阿布贾与哈科特机场有限公司签署特许经营协议时披露了此事。凯亚莫表示，此项特许经营旨在提高机场运营效率、增加收入并释放其商业潜力。他 explained，联邦政府一直利用主要机场创造的利润补贴其他亏损机场的运营。凯亚莫说：“我们的一些机场处于亏损状态。我们从一些主要机场赚到大量资金，而这些利润大部分都用于维持其他机场的运营。”他指出，这项特许经营已获总统博拉·蒂努布和联邦执行委员会批准，并补充说，这并非一项突然作出的决定，历届政府都曾努力推动落实。凯亚莫称，此前推进机场特许经营的尝试因工会抵制以及涉及政府的诉讼而受挫。不过，他将这一进程得以成功完成归功于与航空业工会进行的谈判，称政府在签署协议前已取得工会同意。部长向工作人员保证，特许经营不会导致失业，也不会降低他们的待遇条件。他说，蒂努布已指示在整个特许经营过程中必须保障航空业员工的福祉。凯亚莫说：“总统博拉·蒂努布非常关注此事，确保没有任何员工失去工作，待遇条件应保持不变。”他还补充说，特许经营方每五年都将接受绩效评估，以确保遵守协议条款。他警告，如果特许经营方未达到商定标准，政府可以收回机场经营权。此处发表的意见不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.title: Gov’t plans 3% discount on GoldBod’s gold purchases after taking over programme costs from BoG
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.summary: The government plans to introduce a 3% discount on small-scale gold purchases in 2027 to reduce the cost of accumulating foreign exchange and building reserves through domestic gold purchases. The measure, outlined in the 2027 Budget, comes after the transfer of the gold-buying programme from the Bank of Ghana to GoldBod, with the Ministry of Finance now responsible for financing its costs.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.summary_zh: 政府计划从2027年起，对小规模黄金购买提供3%的折扣，以降低通过国内购金积累外汇和充实储备的成本。该措施载于2027年预算，是将黄金购买计划从加纳银行移交给加纳黄金局后出台的，目前财政部负责为该计划的成本提供资金。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.body: The government plans to introduce a 3% discount on small-scale gold purchases in 2027 to reduce the cost of accumulating foreign exchange and building reserves through domestic gold purchases. The measure, outlined in the 2027 Budget, comes after the transfer of the gold-buying programme from the Bank of Ghana to GoldBod, with the Ministry of Finance now responsible for financing its costs. According to the budget, the cost of generating foreign exchange through the Ghana Accelerated National Reserve Accumulation Policy fell from 16% in 2025 to 5% in 2026. Government now intends to reduce it further to 2%. “To reduce this cost further to 2 per cent, Government will, in consultation with industry stakeholders, introduce a 3 per cent discount on small-scale gold purchases in 2027,” the budget states. The proposal addresses an important question raised by the programme’s earlier trading model: whether the price paid for gold leaves enough room to cover export costs and generate foreign exchange. Under the previous arrangement, GoldBod facilitated gold purchases on behalf of the Bank of Ghana, buying from small-scale miners at spot prices and, in some cases, at a premium. GoldBod earned fees for its services, while the central bank financed the purchases and absorbed the associated losses. The Bank of Ghana’s 2025 financial statements reported that the Domestic Gold Purchase Programme generated losses of approximately GH¢22 billion. JoyNews Research subsequently identified several sources of the losses, including service and assay fees, discounts on gold sold to off-takers and exchange-rate differences. Its analysis highlighted the gap between the forex bureau rate used to purchase gold and the reference rate used in the central bank’s accounting. Some losses reflected valuation effects rather than direct economic costs, but they nevertheless weakened the Bank of Ghana’s balance sheet. According to the government, GoldBod began conducting doré gold purchases on April 1, 2026. A memorandum signed in July formalised the transfer of the programme from the Bank of Ghana. In practical terms, the transfer moved the financial burden away from the central bank. It did not automatically make the underlying transactions cheaper. The proposed discount now targets the purchase price itself. Buying gold at a lower price could create more room to cover refining, transport, financing and other trading costs. It could also reduce the amount government needs to provide to support the programme. The government’s own target suggests the discount will reduce the programme’s cost rather than eliminate it. Even after the proposed adjustment, the budget envisages a remaining cost of 2%. The government also has to balance reducing acquisition costs with keeping the official buying system attractive to miners and traders. A lower purchase price could improve the programme’s finances. But its effect on the volume of gold supplied through licensed channels will depend on the prices and payment terms available elsewhere. The budget says the government will develop the measure in consultation with industry stakeholders and specifically calls on the Ghana National Association of Small-Scale Miners and the Licensed Gold Buyers Associations to support the reforms. Government continues to emphasise the programme’s wider benefits. The budget reports that GoldBod has exported 88 tonnes of small-scale gold worth $12 billion since January 2026, supporting foreign-exchange supply, reserve accumulation and the cedi. Those benefits explain why the programme remains important to government. They also make it necessary to report its costs transparently. The 3% discount is a concrete response to the acquisition-cost problem. But transferring responsibility for financing the programme from the Bank of Ghana to the Ministry of Finance does not, in itself, resolve the underlying economics of the transactions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.title_zh: 尼日利亚政府接管博茨瓦纳黄金公司的项目成本后，计划对GoldBod的黄金采购提供3%的折扣
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-plans-3.body_zh: 政府计划于2027年对小规模黄金采购给予3%的折扣，以降低通过国内采购黄金积累外汇和充实储备的成本。这项措施载于2027年预算，出现在黄金采购计划由加纳央行移交给加纳黄金局之后，目前财政部负责为相关成本提供资金。根据预算，依据《加纳加速国家储备积累政策》创造外汇的成本已从2025年的16%降至2026年的5%。政府现 intends 进一步将其降至2%。预算指出：“为进一步将这一成本降至2%，政府将在与行业利益相关方协商后，于2027年对小规模黄金采购给予3%的折扣。”该提案回应了此前交易模式提出的一个重要问题：黄金收购价格能否留出足够空间，以覆盖出口成本并创造外汇。在此前安排下，加纳黄金局代表加纳央行促成黄金采购，以现货价格从小型矿商处收购黄金，有时还支付溢价。加纳黄金局就其服务收取费用，而央行则负责为采购提供资金并承担相关损失。加纳央行2025年财务报表显示，国内黄金采购计划造成约225亿加纳塞地（GH¢）的亏损。JoyNews Research随后查明亏损的多个来源，包括服务费和检测费、出售给收购方的黄金折价，以及汇率差异。其分析凸显了黄金收购所采用的外汇兑换商汇率与央行会计核算所采用的参考汇率之间的差距。部分亏损反映的是估值影响，而非直接经济成本，但仍削弱了加纳央行的资产负债表。据政府称，加纳黄金局于2026年4月1日开始采购合质金。7月签署的一份备忘录正式确认了该项目从加纳央行移交。实际上，此次移交减轻了中央银行承担的财务负担，但并未自动降低底层交易成本。拟议折扣如今直接针对采购价格本身。以更低价格购入黄金，可能为覆盖精炼、运输、融资及其他交易成本创造更大空间，也可能减少政府为支持该计划所需拨付的资金。政府自身设定的目标表明，这项折扣将降低而非消除该计划成本。即使完成拟议调整，预算仍预计会有2%的剩余成本。政府还必须在降低收购成本与维持官方收购体系对矿商和交易商吸引力之间取得平衡。更低的收购价格可能改善该计划的财务状况，但它对通过持牌渠道供应的黄金数量的影响，将取决于其他地方可获得的价格和付款条件。预算称，政府将与行业利益相关方共同制定这项措施，并特别呼吁加纳全国小型矿工协会和持牌黄金买家协会支持改革。政府继续强调该计划的广泛效益。预算报告称，自2026年1月以来，加纳黄金局已出口88吨小规模黄金，价值120亿美元，为外汇供应、储备积累和塞地提供支持。这些效益解释了政府为何仍重视该计划，也意味着必须透明报告其成本。3%的折扣是针对收购成本问题采取的具体措施。但是，将该计划的融资责任从加纳央行移交给财政部，本身并不能解决这些交易的根本经济问题……

https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.summary_zh: 亚太经济合作组织（APEC）正在筹备其最受关注的会议之一，预计美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将出席在中国深圳举行的领导人峰会。尽管APEC并非正式的政治或安全联盟，但其年度领导人会议为大国讨论经济关系、投资、供应链和地区稳定提供了重要平台。
https://moderndiplomacy.eu/2026/11/13/wh.body: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum is preparing for one of its most closely watched gatherings, with US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin expected to attend the leaders’ summit in Shenzhen, China. The meeting comes as geopolitical tensions, trade disputes and conflicts affecting global energy markets place growing pressure on international economic cooperation. The 21-member forum brings together economies responsible for a substantial share of global output and trade. Although APEC does not operate as a formal political or security alliance, its annual leaders’ meeting provides an important platform for major powers to discuss economic relations, investment, supply chains and regional stability. Here are five key facts about APEC and the issues likely to shape this year’s summit. Founded in 1989 in Canberra, Australia, APEC began as an informal dialogue involving 12 economies. It has since developed into the Asia-Pacific region’s leading economic cooperation forum, promoting trade, investment, economic growth and regional integration. MD Briefing delivers expert analysis across five global fronts — the Indo-Pacific, energy, geoeconomics, European security, and the Middle East — every Monday morning. Free. The grouping’s 21 members account for approximately 62% of global GDP and around half of international trade, making it an important platform for discussions about the global economy. One distinctive feature is that APEC refers to its participants as “member economies” rather than countries. This arrangement allows both Hong Kong, which is governed by China, and Taiwan, which Beijing claims as part of its territory, to participate under their respective designations. However, India, despite being the world’s most populous country, is not a member. APEC also operates differently from organisations that impose legally binding obligations on their members. Its decisions are reached through consensus, and commitments are voluntary and non-binding. This allows economies with different political systems and strategic interests to participate without accepting a common set of enforceable economic rules. China is hosting APEC for the third time, following previous summits in Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014. This year’s choice of Shenzhen carries both economic and strategic significance. Located close to Hong Kong, Shenzhen is part of China’s Greater Bay Area, which also includes Macau. Beijing aims to develop the region into a major international centre for technology, finance and innovation. The city is also home to some of China’s most prominent technology and manufacturing companies, including BYD, Huawei and Tencent. Its economic transformation from a relatively small settlement into a major technology and industrial centre makes it an important showcase for China’s development model. Chim Lee, a senior analyst at the Economist Intelligence Unit, said the choice reflects both domestic and international considerations. Shenzhen provides China with an opportunity to highlight its technological capabilities, trade ambitions and resilience amid geopolitical uncertainty. Hosting the summit in the city also allows Beijing to present its vision of the Greater Bay Area as an increasingly important centre of global economic activity. The presence of several major world leaders is expected to make this year’s meeting particularly significant. Chinese President Xi Jinping is set to chair the leaders’ meeting and deliver remarks. US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin are also among the expected participants, creating the possibility of high-level discussions involving three major powers. Other expected attendees include Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and the leaders of Canada, Australia, Mexico, Indonesia, Malaysia, South Korea and Vietnam. Taiwan has designated Stan Shih, founder of Acer, as its representative. Japan has not formally confirmed whether Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi will attend, while New Zealand has yet to officially announce its delegation. The potential participation of Trump, Xi and Putin will attract particular attention because their countries have overlapping economic interests but sharply different positions on trade, security and international conflicts. However, the presence of leaders at the same summit does not necessarily mean that formal bilateral or trilateral agreements will follow. Several geopolitical and economic disputes are expected to shape discussions in Shenzhen. The economic consequences of conflict in the Middle East are likely to feature prominently. Disruptions to energy supplies and shipping routes can affect global trade, supply chains and inflation, creating challenges for economies that depend heavily on imported energy. For APEC members, the issue is particularly important because economic growth across the region remains closely connected to international trade and reliable energy supplies. The possible presence of all three leaders places their diplomatic interactions among the summit’s main points of interest. China has shown reluctance to participate in nuclear disarmament discussions, partly because its nuclear arsenal is smaller than those of the United States and Russia. Washington and Moscow may also seek to discuss the war in Ukraine, although their respective positions on China could differ. The summit could therefore provide opportunities for diplomatic contact, even if the leaders do not reach substantive agreements. Relations between Washington and Beijing will be another major focus. Both sides are facing difficulties in meeting commitments associated with an extended trade truce, according to analysts. Rare earth supplies, artificial intelligence, tariffs and technology restrictions are likely to remain important areas of disagreement. US arms sales to Taiwan will also be closely watched, given Beijing’s strong opposition to military cooperation between Washington and Taipei. These issues extend beyond bilateral trade. They affect global manufacturing, technology supply chains and the ability of businesses to operate across major markets. Regional security tensions will also influence the summit’s diplomatic environment. Relations between China and Japan have remained strained since November 2025, when Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi suggested that Japan could deploy its military if Chinese action against Taiwan also threatened Japanese territory. Beijing strongly objected to her remarks. China’s relationship with the Philippines is also under pressure because of continuing disputes in the South China Sea. These tensions involve maritime claims and competing interests over access to strategically important waters. The participation of both countries’ leaders could provide an opportunity for diplomatic engagement, although the underlying disputes remain unresolved. APEC consists of 21 member economies spanning the Asia-Pacific region: The diversity of its membership is one of APEC’s defining characteristics. It brings together advanced industrial economies, emerging markets and developing economies, allowing discussions on trade and investment across a broad geographical and economic landscape. The APEC leaders’ meeting is scheduled for November 18 and 19, preceded by an annual CEO summit on November 17 and 18. The discussions will take place against a backdrop of trade uncertainty, geopolitical competition and concerns about the resilience of international supply chains. The gathering’s significance will depend not only on the declarations issued by its members but also on whether major economies can maintain dialogue despite their differences. For China, hosting the summit offers an opportunity to demonstrate its economic influence and present Shenzhen as a centre of technological development. For the United States, Russia and other participants, the meeting provides a platform to engage with key regional economies while navigating competing strategic priorities. APEC’s consensus-based and non-binding structure limits its ability to resolve major geopolitical disputes. Nevertheless, its economic reach makes it an important venue for maintaining communication among powers whose decisions have consequences well beyond the Asia-Pacific region. https://punchng.com/seplat-fixes-q3-divi.summary_zh: Seplat Energy Plc宣布了计算其2026年第三季度中期股息和特别股息奈拉等值金额所采用的适用外汇汇率。首席财务官Eleanor Adaralegbe签署的声明称，该换算数值符合Seplat Energy既有的股息支付程序，并采用尼日利亚中央银行于2026年11月11日公布的尼日利亚外汇市场汇率。
https://punchng.com/seplat-fixes-q3-divi.body: Seplat Energy Plc has announced the applicable foreign exchange rate for calculating the naira equivalent of its third-quarter 2026 interim and special dividends. In a corporate disclosure issued on Thursday from its offices in Lagos and London, the dual-listed energy company confirmed that shareholders who elected to receive their payouts in naira, or whose default currency is naira, will have their dividends converted at a rate of N1,358.34 to one United States dollar. According to the statement signed by Chief Financial Officer Eleanor Adaralegbe, the conversion figure aligns with Seplat Energy’s established dividend payment procedures and reflects the Nigerian Foreign Exchange Market rate published by the Central Bank of Nigeria on 11 November 2026. The company advised shareholders seeking clarity on default currency rules to consult its earlier regulatory announcement published on 29 October 2026, via its corporate website. The exchange rate disclosure follows Seplat Energy’s strong operational and financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, which prompted the board to declare a combined Q3 payout comprising an interim dividend and a special dividend. That distribution was underpinned by growth in revenue and free cash flow amid higher onshore and offshore production, with the qualification and record date closing on 12 November 2026, ahead of electronic dividend disbursement scheduled for on or around 27 November 2026. Seplat Energy, which trades on the Premium Board of the Nigerian Exchange Limited and the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange, “is Nigeria’s leading indigenous energy company” and operates a broad portfolio of onshore and shallow-water assets across the Niger Delta, alongside three gas processing plants and interests in three export terminals. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title: Makinde’s campaign group demands probe of Tinubu’s N11.2trn crude oil-backed loans
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: The presidential campaign organisation of Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has called for an open investigation into the federal government’s reported commitment of about 340 million barrels of Nigeria’s future crude oil production to secure loans estimated at N11.2 trillion.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 奥约州州长塞伊·马金德的总统竞选组织呼吁，对联邦政府据报承诺以尼日利亚未来约3.4亿桶原油产量换取估计11.2万亿奈拉贷款一事进行公开调查。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The presidential campaign organisation of Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde has called for an open investigation into the federal government’s reported commitment of about 340 million barrels of Nigeria’s future crude oil production to secure loans estimated at N11.2 trillion. The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) accused President Bola Tinubu’s administration of committing future oil revenues to debt obligations without sufficient public disclosure, warning that the arrangements could constrain Nigeria’s finances for years. In a statement on Thursday, the organisation’s Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Ihediwa, said the reported loans were obtained through four financing arrangements: Project Gazelle, Project Gazelle II, Project Leopard and Project Leopard II. It demanded that the federal government disclose the identities of the lenders, the amounts borrowed, interest rates, management fees and repayment schedules, as well as the precise volume of crude oil committed under each arrangement. “President Tinubu should give a public explanation on the loan arrangements,” the organisation said. It also called for the disclosure of the pricing formula for the crude oil deliveries, the outstanding liabilities being refinanced and the full financial implications of the transactions. The campaign organisation described the reported arrangements as fiscally reckless, arguing that the government was committing future oil revenues to finance present expenditure without demonstrating corresponding investments in industrial development, infrastructure and improved living standards. It warned that fixed repayment obligations could limit Nigeria’s ability to benefit fully from increases in international crude oil prices, potentially reducing future government revenues and restricting the country’s fiscal flexibility. The organisation also recalled its earlier warning that Mr Tinubu was leading Nigeria towards what it likened to the financial predicament of 19th-century Egypt under Khedive Ismail. It said excessive foreign borrowing and spending under the Egyptian ruler eventually contributed to British occupation of the country in 1882. “A nation that repeatedly pledges its future revenues to finance present excesses risks surrendering its economic independence,” the campaign organisation said. The organisation said the reported borrowing arrangements were particularly concerning amid the economic difficulties facing Nigerians, including hunger, poorly funded public hospitals and deteriorating highways. It argued that commodity-backed financing arrangements should be subjected to public scrutiny and demonstrate clear economic returns and measurable benefits to citizens. “We therefore task the National Assembly to subject these financing arrangements to rigorous legislative scrutiny including an open public hearing,” the campaign organisation stated. It said such a hearing should establish the full extent of Nigeria’s crude oil commitments and assess the implications for Federation Account revenues and the country’s long-term fiscal sustainability. “Economic success is not measured by borrowing or debt restructuring, but by tangible gains in production, jobs, infrastructure, industry and living standards,” it said. PREMIUM TIMES reported Thursday how Governor Makinde, who is contesting next year’s presidential election on the platform of the Allied People’s Movement (APM), criticised the handling of the economy by President Bola Tinubu who is seeking reelection as the presidential candidate of the All Progressives Congress. Mr Makinde, who will complete his second and final term as governor in May 2027, recalled supporting Mr Tinubu to win the 2023 presidential election. He said he withdrew his support for Mr Tinubu and decided to vie for the presidency himself after being disappointed by the president’s performance
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队要求调查蒂努布以原油为抵押的112亿奈拉贷款
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 奥约州州长塞yi·马金德总统竞选组织呼吁对联邦政府据报承诺动用尼日利亚未来约3.4亿桶原油产量以获取估计达11.2万亿奈拉贷款一事展开公开调查。马金德—达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）指责博拉·蒂努布总统政府未经充分公开披露便将未来石油收入用于偿债，警告称这些安排可能在未来多年限制尼日利亚的财政。该组织战略传播主任理查德·伊赫迪瓦周四在一份声明中表示，据报这些贷款通过四项融资安排取得：瞪羚项目、瞪羚二号项目、猎豹项目和猎豹二号项目。该组织要求联邦政府披露贷款机构名称、借款金额、利率、管理费、还款时间表，以及每项安排所承诺的原油具体数量。该组织表示：“蒂努布总统应就这些贷款安排作出公开解释。”它还要求披露原油交付的定价公式、正在再融资的未偿债务，以及这些交易造成的全部财务影响。该竞选组织称，据报这些安排在财政上极其轻率，并认为政府正将未来石油收入用于为当前支出融资，却未能在产业发展、基础设施建设和改善生活水平方面作出相应投入。它警告称，固定的偿债义务可能限制尼日利亚充分受益于国际原油价格上涨的能力，潜在后果包括未来政府收入减少以及国家财政灵活性受限。该组织还重申此前警告，称蒂努布先生正把尼日利亚带向其所说的、类似19世纪埃及在伊斯梅尔帕夏治下所处的财政困境。该组织表示，在这位埃及统治者执政时期，过度对外借款和支出最终促成了英国于1882年占领该国。该竞选组织称：“一个反复抵押未来收入来为当前过度支出融资的国家，有可能丧失经济独立。”该组织表示，在尼日利亚民众面临饥饿、公共医院资金不足和公路状况恶化等经济困难之际，据报这些借款安排尤其令人担忧。它认为，以商品为担保的融资安排应接受公众监督，并证明具有明确的经济回报和可衡量的公民受益。该竞选组织声明：“因此，我们责成国民议会对这些融资安排进行严格立法审查，包括举行公开听证会。”它表示，此类听证会应查明尼日利亚原油承诺的全部范围，并评估其对联邦账户收入和国家长期财政可持续性的影响。该组织说：“经济成功不是以借款或债务重组来衡量的，而是以生产、就业、基础设施、工业和生活水平的切实改善来衡量。”《Premium Times》周四报道，马金德州长将以人民联盟运动（APM）的政纲参加明年的总统选举。他批评了寻求以全进步大会候选人身份连任的博拉·蒂努布总统的经济治理方式。马金德先生将于2027年5月完成其第二个也是最后一个州长任期。他回顾称，自己曾支持蒂努布先生赢得2023年总统选举。他说，在对总统的表现感到失望后，他撤回了对蒂努布先生的支持，并决定亲自竞选总统

https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.summary_zh: 拟议中的《自然资源收入管理法》将取代现行《石油收入管理法》。现行法律主要关注该国石油和天然气行业的收入。财政部长在解释制定新法律的必要性时表示，现行法律适用范围有限，仅涵盖石油收入，导致其他重要自然资源未被纳入统一、全面的收入管理框架。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.body: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson has announced plans to introduce a new law to regulate revenues from Ghana’s natural resources, including oil, gold, lithium and bauxite. The proposed Natural Resource Revenue Management Act will replace the existing Petroleum Revenue Management Act, which focuses primarily on revenues from the country’s oil and gas sector. The new legislation forms part of a series of financial management reforms the government plans to implement in 2027 to strengthen accountability, improve the management of public resources and ensure that natural resource wealth benefits both current and future generations. Presenting the 2027 Budget and the New Economy Agenda in Parliament, Dr Forson said the government would also establish a Ghana Sovereign Wealth Fund and introduce a Loans Act to address longstanding weaknesses in public financial management. "As a complement to the revenue and expenditure measures, Government will implement the following reforms to address long-standing weaknesses in how we manage our public resources," he told Parliament. He said the three measures were intended to establish stronger financial management systems and ensure that the country's public resources were managed responsibly. "Together, these reforms will make sound financial management a lasting feature of our economy," Dr Forson stated. Explaining the need for the new legislation, the Finance Minister said the existing law was limited in scope as it covered only petroleum revenues, leaving other important natural resources outside a single comprehensive revenue management framework. "Government will introduce a Natural Resource Revenue Management Act to replace the Petroleum Revenue Management Act," he announced. "The current law covers only oil revenues. The new law will bring revenues from oil, gold, lithium, bauxite and all other extractive resources under one clear and accountable framework, for the benefit of present and future generations," he said. The proposed legislation is expected to provide a unified framework for managing revenues from the country's extractive resources, strengthen oversight and establish clearer guidelines for allocating and using the funds. Dr Forson also disclosed that the government intended to channel natural resource revenues towards major national infrastructure projects. He cited the use of oil and mineral royalties to support the construction of the Accra-Kumasi Expressway as an example of how proceeds from the country's natural resources could be invested in critical infrastructure. "We have already used oil and mineral royalties to fund Ghana's first expressway, the Accra-Kumasi Expressway," he told Parliament. "Building on that experience, our natural resource revenues will only be directed to major national infrastructure projects," he added
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.title_zh: 政府将以更广泛的自然资源法律取代《石油收入管理法》
https://www.myjoyonline.com/govt-to-repl.body_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士宣布，计划出台一项新法律，规范加纳来自石油、黄金、锂和铝土矿等自然资源的收入。拟议中的《自然资源收入管理法》将取代现行《石油收入管理法》，后者主要关注该国石油和天然气行业的收入。新立法是政府计划于2027年实施的一系列财务管理改革的一部分，旨在加强问责、改善公共资源管理，并确保自然资源财富惠及当代和子孙后代。福尔松博士在议会提交2027年预算和《新经济议程》时表示，政府还将设立加纳主权财富基金，并出台《贷款法》，以解决公共财务管理中长期存在的薄弱环节。他告诉议会：“作为收入和支出措施的补充，政府将实施以下改革，以解决我们管理公共资源时长期存在的薄弱环节。”他说，这三项措施旨在建立更完善的财务管理制度，并确保国家公共资源得到负责任的管理。福尔松博士表示：“这些改革结合起来，将使稳健的财务管理成为我国经济的一项持久特征。”财政部长在解释新立法的必要性时表示，现行法律范围有限，仅涵盖石油收入，导致其他重要自然资源未被纳入统一、完善的收入管理体系。他宣布：“政府将出台《自然资源收入管理法》，取代《石油收入管理法》。”他说：“现行法律仅涵盖石油收入。新法律将把石油、黄金、锂、铝土矿及其他所有采矿资源的收入纳入一个明确且问责有力的统一框架，惠及当代和子孙后代。”拟议立法预计将为管理该国采矿资源收入提供统一框架，加强监督，并为资金分配和使用确立更明确的指引。福尔松博士还透露，政府打算将自然资源收入投入重大国家基础设施项目。他以利用石油和矿产权利金支持修建阿克拉—库马西高速公路为例，说明如何将国家自然资源所得投资于关键基础设施。他告诉议会：“我们已经利用石油和矿产权利金，为加纳首条高速公路阿克拉—库马西高速公路提供资金。”他补充道：“在此基础上，我们的自然资源收入将专门用于重大国家基础设施项目。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/2027-budget-.body: Government has allocated GH¢782 million to the Ministry of Sports and Recreation in the 2027 Budget to support sports development and the welfare of people involved in the sector. Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson announced the allocation during his presentation of the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy to Parliament on Thursday. "We have allocated GH¢782 million to the Ministry of Sports and Recreation to support the development of sports and the people who participate in it," Dr Forson told Parliament. The allocation comes alongside a series of proposed interventions aimed at strengthening Ghana's sports infrastructure, improving grassroots participation and creating sustainable pathways for athlete development. Among the major projects outlined in the budget is the construction of 10 new multipurpose sports stadia in underserved regions, with seating capacities ranging from 5,000 to 12,000. Government also intends to complete the National Sports Policy and its implementation framework, finalise regulations under the Ghana Sports Fund Act, 2025 (Act 1159), and review the Sports Act, 2016 (Act 934). The budget further outlines plans to strengthen structured school and grassroots sports programmes to improve talent identification and athlete progression. Ghana is also expected to begin preparations towards hosting the 2027 CAF Under-20 Africa Cup of Nations, a 12-nation competition expected to create opportunities in sports tourism, hospitality and transportation. The GH¢782 million allocation will therefore support a wide range of sports development priorities, although the budget statement's headline figure does not, on its own, establish how much will go towards each programme. Further details on the distribution of the allocation, including funding for infrastructure, national teams, athlete welfare and the organisation of sporting competitions, will be important in assessing its impact on the sector

https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-s.body: Finance Minister Dr Cassiel Ato Forson says the government has secured about US$3 billion for the construction of the Accra-Kumasi Expressway, with the funds held in a dedicated project account at the Bank of Ghana. Presenting the 2027 Budget Statement and Economic Policy to Parliament on Thursday, November 12, 2026, he said the account contained US$2.2 billion and GH¢9 billion as of November 11. “As of yesterday, 11th November 2026, the project account at the Bank of Ghana held US$2.2 billion and GH¢9 billion, together equivalent to about US$3 billion. The money is in the safe custody of the Bank of Ghana,” he said. Dr Forson said the funds had been secured ahead of the commencement of construction, describing the development as the fulfilment of a government commitment. “Before actual construction of the Accra-Kumasi Expressway begins, the money is ready. We promised to secure the financing. We have done so. Promise made, promise fulfilled,” he said. The Finance Minister said detailed feasibility studies, engineering designs, costing, and environmental and social assessments had been completed. He said the engineer’s construction estimate for the 198.7-kilometre, six-lane expressway now stood at US$2.98 billion. According to him, the estimate includes contingencies, supervision, land acquisition and compensation. Dr Forson said the revised estimate was more than US$1 billion below an initial projection of about US$4 billion. The government has issued tenders through an international competitive tendering process, with the exercise expected to be completed by the end of 2026. Dr Forson said the final contract prices would be determined through the competitive process. He added that all contract awards would be subject to commitment control approval and value-for-money assessments, in accordance with procurement and public financial management laws. The government has dedicated the Annual Budget Funding Amount (ABFA) from petroleum revenues, together with mineral royalties, to the Accra-Kumasi Expressway project. The project is expected to connect more than 10 million people. With the tendering process expected to conclude by the end of 2026, the next major step will be the award of contracts and commencement of construction
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-s.title_zh: 政府为阿克拉—库马西高速公路筹得约30亿美元
https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-s.body_zh: 财政部长卡西尔·阿托·福尔松博士表示，政府已为阿克拉—库马西高速公路建设筹集约30亿美元，相关资金存放于加纳银行的项目专用账户中。2026年11月12日星期四，他向议会提交《2027年预算声明和经济政策》时说，截至11月11日，该账户内有22亿美元和90亿塞地亚。“截至昨日，即2026年11月11日，加纳银行的项目专用账户内有22亿美元和90亿塞地亚，合计约合30亿美元。这笔资金由加纳银行妥善保管。”他说。福尔松博士表示，政府已在高速公路动工前落实资金，并将这一进展视为兑现政府承诺。“在阿克拉—库马西高速公路正式动工之前，资金已经就绪。我们承诺落实融资，现在已经做到。作出承诺，兑现承诺。”他说。财政部长表示，详细的可行性研究、工程设计、成本核算以及环境和社会评估均已完成。他说，工程师编制的这条全长198.7公里、双向六车道高速公路的施工估算目前为29.8亿美元。据他介绍，该估算包括应急费用、监理、土地征收和补偿。福尔松博士表示，修订后的估算比最初预计的约40亿美元低逾10亿美元。政府已通过国际竞争性招标程序发出招标文件，预计将于2026年底前完成。福尔松博士说，最终合同价格将通过竞争程序确定。他补充称，所有合同授予都将按照采购法和公共财政管理法接受承诺控制审批及物有所值评估。政府已从石油收入中划拨年度预算资金额（ABFA），并连同矿产权利金一并用于阿克拉—库马西高速公路项目。该项目预计将连接逾1000万人。随着招标程序预计于2026年底结束，下一主要步骤将是授予合同并启动建设

https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.summary_zh: 信息与国家导向部长Mohammed Idris呼吁尼日利亚人在2027年再次选举总统Bola Tinubu，称政府需要更多时间解决国家面临的经济困境和生活成本上涨问题。部长承认，尼日利亚人对当前经济困境、贫困加剧和饥饿问题有理由感到担忧，但表示政府改革带来的益处需要时间才能体现在民众生活中。
https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.body: The Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, has appealed to Nigerians to re-elect President Bola Tinubu in 2027, saying the administration needs more time to address the country’s economic hardship and rising cost of living. Idris made the appeal on Thursday during the APC’s 2027 presidential and governorship campaign flag-off at the Minna Trade Fair Complex, Niger State. The minister acknowledged that Nigerians had reasons to be concerned about the prevailing economic hardship, rising poverty and hunger but said the benefits of the government’s reforms would take time to reflect in people’s lives. “I appeal for the understanding of Nigerians. President Bola Tinubu means well for Nigerians. Let’s give him more time to complete the good things he has already started,” Idris said. He also urged Niger State residents to re-elect Governor Mohammed Bago, saying his administration’s achievements had made a significant impact on the state in its first term. Wear Nigerian fabrics, eat local food, Soludo urges citizens Tinubu pledges more projects as Okpebholo marks two years 2027: Kebbi farmers’ group endorses Tinubu, Idris Idris called on eligible voters to support APC candidates at all levels in next year’s elections, saying doing so would enable them to enjoy the dividends of democracy. In his remarks, Bago assured Tinubu of 100 per cent votes for the APC in Niger State. The governor, who promised that his second term would be more rewarding, urged residents to turn out en masse to vote for APC candidates in the presidential, governorship, senatorial and House of Representatives elections. Dignitaries at the campaign flag-off included the North-Central Zonal Vice-Chairman of the APC, Mu’azu Rijau, who represented the party’s National Chairman, Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda; former Nigerian Ambassador to South Africa, Abdullahi Idris; and former Niger State Deputy Governor, Ahmed Musa Ibeto, among others. Chika Otuchikere
https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.title_zh: 2027年：再次选举Tinubu，以完成经济改革
https://punchng.com/2027-re-elect-tinubu.body_zh: 信息与国家Orientation部长穆罕默德·伊德里斯呼吁尼日利亚人在2027年再次选举总统博拉·蒂努布，称本届政府需要更多时间来应对该国严峻的经济困境和不断上涨的生活成本。星期四，伊德里斯在尼日尔州明纳贸易博览会综合大楼举行的APC 2027年总统和州长竞选启动活动上发出这一呼吁。部长承认，尼日利亚人有理由对当前普遍存在的经济困难、贫困加剧和饥饿问题感到担忧，但表示政府改革带来的益处需要时间才能体现在民众生活中。伊德里斯说：“我呼吁尼日利亚人给予理解。博拉·蒂努布总统是真心为尼日利亚人着想。让我们给他更多时间，让他完成已经启动的美好事业。”他还敦促尼日尔州居民再次选举州长穆罕默德·巴戈，称其政府在首个任期内取得的成就已对该州产生了重大影响。索卢多敦促公民穿着尼日利亚传统 fabrics、食用本地食品；蒂努布承诺推出更多项目；奥克佩布洛就任两周年之际，2027年：凯比农民团体支持蒂努布。伊德里斯呼吁符合条件的选民在明年各级选举中支持APC候选人，表示这样将使他们享受民主的成果。巴戈在讲话中向蒂努布保证，APC将在尼日尔州获得100%的选票。这位州长曾承诺第二个任期将带来更多回报，并敦促居民大批前往投票，在总统、州长、参议员和众议员选举中支持APC候选人。竞选启动活动上的嘉宾包括APC中北部地区副主席穆阿祖·里贾乌，他代表党全国主席普罗夫·嫩塔韦·伊尔瓦特达；尼日利亚前驻南非大使阿卜杜拉希·伊德里斯；尼日尔州前副州长艾哈迈德·穆萨·伊贝托等。奇卡·奥图奇凯雷

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: The proposed revival of Korea's mandatory tender offer system, abolished in 1998 following the Asian financial crisis, has reignited debate nearly three decades later.
