https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 总统Bola Tinubu于星期三敦促奥多州选民，确保他在2027年1月16日总统选举中以至少120万张选票获胜。总统Tinubu由副总统Kashim Shettima代表出席并发表讲话。他说，在该州登记的210万选民中，预计奥多州将投给他不少于120万票。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: President Bola Tinubu , on Wednesday, urged voters in Ondo State to ensure his return with at least 1.2 million votes in the 16 January 2027 presidential election. The president spoke at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally in Akure on Wednesday. Represented by Vice President Kashim Shettima, President Tinubu said he expected no less than 1.2 million votes from Ondo out of the 2.1 million registered voters in the state. INEC declared that about 1.8 million voters have collected their Permanent Voter Cards in the state, leaving about 200,000 cards uncollected a few months before the election. “It is our expectation that Ondo should be able to deliver 1.2 million votes out of the 1.8 million PVCs collected so far,” he said. He also mocked his political opponents, such as Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the National Democratic Party (NDC), respectively, as lacking the competence and consensus to lead the country. “Looking at the rally today in Ondo, it is shut down. Our political opponents are conducting rallies on Instagram and Facebook,” he said. He also noted that Atiku, who hails from Adamawa State, has no alignment with most notable leaders in his state and therefore lacks the capacity to lead the country. The president said the same about Mr Obi, whom he described as lacking the support of former and present governors of Anambra State. “That you have the ability to import cheap wine from South Africa, does not mean you can govern Nigeria,” The president said of Mr Obi, adding that the country had fared better under the current administration and deserving the votes of all Nigerians. The Ondo State Governor, Lucky Aiyedatiwa, while delivering his welcome address, promised that the state would ensure it delivered nothing less than one million votes for President Tinubu during the election. He said the president’s reforms had trickled down to the masses of Ondo in the form of developments, including key appointments such as three ministers and heads of agencies. But the Director General of the Tinubu Presidential Campaign Council, Abdullaziz Yari, said that, given the benefits accruing to Ondo State from the Tinubu administration, the president deserved more than one million votes from the state. Mr Yari urged party leaders and other members to unite to ensure they deliver the maximum votes in January. Earlier, the Chairman of the Progressives Governors Forum and Governor of Imo State, Hope Uzodima, while addressing the rally, urged Ondo voters to collect their PVCs if they want to deliver the pledged one million votes. He also urged the various groups within the party to close ranks and end the bickering in order to be able to garner the required votes for the president. Senate Leader, Opeyemi Bamidele, also harped on unity among leaders of the party in Ondo State following reports that there are various factions running parallel campaigns for the president. Mr Bamidele, an indigene of the neighbouring Ekiti State, said he had a message from President Tinubu to Ondo APC, urging party leaders to recognise the governor as the coordinator of the campaigns in the state and to team up with him to deliver votes during the election. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 博拉·蒂努布总统周三敦促奥恩多州选民，在2027年1月16日总统选举中确保他至少获得120万张选票。总统于周三在阿库雷举行的全体进步大会党总统竞选集会上发表讲话。副总统卡希姆·谢蒂马代表蒂努布总统出席。蒂努布总统表示，在该州210万名登记选民中，他预计奥恩多州将至少投出120万票。独立国家选举委员会宣布，该州约有180万名选民已经领取永久选民卡，距离选举还有数月，仍有约20万张选民卡尚未领取。他说：“我们期望奥恩多州能够从目前已领取的180万张永久选民卡中投出120万票。”他还嘲讽了非洲民主大会党的阿提库·阿布巴卡尔和人民民主党的彼得·奥比，称他们缺乏领导国家的能力和共识。他说：“看看今天奥恩多州的集会，它已经关闭了。我们的政治对手却是在Instagram和Facebook上举办集会。”他还指出，来自阿达瓦瓦州的阿提库没有得到该州大多数知名领导人的支持，因此缺乏领导国家的能力。总统对奥比先生也表达了同样的看法，称他缺乏阿南布拉州前任和现任州长的支持。总统谈到奥比先生时表示：“你能从南非进口廉价葡萄酒，并不意味着你能够治理尼日利亚。”他补充说，国家在现任政府治理下取得了更好的成效，理应获得所有尼日利亚人的选票。奥恩多州州长拉基·艾耶达蒂瓦在欢迎词中承诺，该州将在选举中确保为蒂努布总统投出不少于100万票。他说，总统推行的改革已经惠及奥恩多州民众，体现在多项发展成就中，包括任命三名部长和各机构负责人。不过，蒂努布总统竞选委员会主任阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里表示，鉴于蒂努布政府为奥恩多州带来的益处，总统理应获得该州超过100万张选票。亚里先生敦促党内领导人和其他成员团结起来，确保在1月为总统争取到尽可能多的选票。此前，进步州长论坛主席、伊莫州州长霍普·乌佐迪马在集会上发言，敦促奥恩多州选民领取永久选民卡，如果他们希望兑现承诺的100万票。他还敦促党内各个团体加强团结、停止争执，以便为总统争取到所需选票。参议院领袖奥佩耶米·巴米德莱也强调，在有关奥恩多州存在多个派别为总统分别开展竞选活动的报道之后，党内领导人必须团结一致。巴米德莱先生是邻近的埃基蒂州本地人。他说，他带来了蒂努布总统给奥恩多州全体进步大会党成员的信息，敦促党内领导人承认州长是该州竞选活动的协调人，并与州长携手合作，在选举中争取选票。奥恩多州和埃多州前州长奥卢塞贡·米米科与阿德姆斯·奥希奥莫雷，以及拉各斯州州长巴巴吉德·桑沃-奥卢出席了集会。

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body: Layer 1 Nigeria produced an average of 1.687 million barrels of crude oil and condensate per day in October 2026, the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) has said. Data released by the commission on Wednesday showed that daily production peaked at 1.79 million barrels per day (bpd), while the lowest output during the month was 1.60 million bpd. The data showed that crude oil production, excluding condensate, averaged 1.51 million barrels per day (mbpd) during the review period. This represented 101 per cent of Nigeria’s 1.5 million bpd production quota allocated by the Organisation of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). According to the report, Nigeria had met its assigned OPEC crude oil production quota for six consecutive months. It said the country produced 1.53 million bpd in May, 1.55 million bpd in June, 1.51 million bpd in July, 1.50 million bpd in August, 1.53 million bpd in September and 1.51 million bpd in October. The report, however, indicated a 1.7 per cent month-on-month decline in crude oil production. It attributed the relatively stable performance in recent months to improved operational stability, production uptime and crude evacuation efficiency. The commission said the sustained performance in October reflected the commitment of operators and industry stakeholders to improving operational efficiency, maintaining asset integrity and enhancing production reliability across the upstream sector. A breakdown of daily average crude oil and condensate production by terminals and streams showed that Forcados Terminal recorded the highest output of 318.49 thousand barrels per day (kbpd). Bonny Terminal followed with 311.02 kbpd, while Qua Iboe Terminal recorded 173.97 kbpd. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.title_zh: 尼日利亚原油产量达到168万桶/日
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/nige.body_zh: 尼日利亚上游石油监管委员会（NUPRC）表示，尼日利亚第一层油田在2026年10月平均每日生产原油和凝析油168.7万桶。该委员会周三发布的数据显示，日产量最高达到179万桶（bpd），当月最低产量为160万桶。数据显示，在审查期内，不含凝析油的原油日均产量为151万桶（mbpd），相当于石油输出国组织（OPEC）分配给尼日利亚的150万桶日产量配额的101%。报告称，尼日利亚已连续6个月完成其获分配的OPEC原油产量配额。该国5月产量为153万桶/日，6月为155万桶/日，7月为151万桶/日，8月为150万桶/日，9月为153万桶/日，10月为151万桶/日。然而，报告指出，原油产量环比下降1.7%。报告将近几个月相对稳定的表现归因于运营稳定性、生产设备可用率及原油外输效率的改善。该委员会表示，10月持续稳定的表现反映了运营商和行业利益相关方为提高运营效率、维护资产完整性以及增强上游行业生产可靠性所作的承诺。按终端和油流划分的原油及凝析油日均产量明细显示，Forcados Terminal产量最高，达到31.849万桶/日（kbpd）。Bonny Terminal以31.102万桶/日紧随其后，Qua Iboe Terminal产量为17.397万桶/日。此处发表的意见不代表Vanguard报社或其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 财政部长李炯烈周三呼吁韩国驻海外使团的金融专员密切监测美国中期选举对全球经济的影响，包括各国如何回应。他补充说：“我们还需要关注美国中期选举后政治格局的变化将如何影响特朗普政府的政策方向”，并要求这些专员密切监测相关事态发展。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il on Wednesday called for South Korea's financial attaches in overseas missions to closely monitor the impact of the U.S. midterm elections on the global economy, including how individual countries are responding. Lee made the remarks during his first meeting with financial attaches at 18 overseas missions since taking office in September, held virtually to review the latest economic trends in major countries, according to the Ministry of Finance and Economy. During the meeting, Lee stressed that South Korea faces external uncertainties, including fiscal instability in Europe and global geopolitical tensions, despite the country's robust exports. "In order to turn recent achievements into sustainable growth, we need to preemptively identify changes in the external environment and take steps to address risks in advance," Lee said during the meeting. "We also need to focus on how changes in the political landscape following the U.S. midterm elections will affect the Trump administration's policy direction," the finance minister added, asking the attaches to closely monitor relevant developments. The finance minister also called for the attaches to closely watch the fiscal crisis in France and its potential impact on the global economy, as well as global supply chains amid the Russia-Ukraine war and the U.S.-Iran war. The finance ministry said it will continue to communicate closely with the financial attaches to review economic and policy trends in major countries and proactively respond to external risks
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 韩国财长呼吁密切监测美国中期选举的影响
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 财政部长李亨-il于周三呼吁韩国驻海外使团的财政专员密切关注美国中期选举对全球经济的影响，包括各国如何应对。李亨-il自9月上任以来首次与18个海外使团的财政专员会面，会议以线上方式举行，旨在审议主要国家的最新经济趋势。韩国财政经济部表示，李亨-il在会议上发表上述言论。他说：“为了把近期成果转化为可持续增长，我们需要预先识别外部环境的变化，并提前采取措施应对风险。”这位财政部长补充道：“我们还需要重点关注美国中期选举后政治格局的变化将如何影响特朗普政府的政策方向。”他要求各财政专员密切关注相关动态。财政部长还呼吁各专员密切观察法国的财政危机及其对全球经济的潜在影响，以及俄乌战争和美伊战争期间全球供应链的变化。韩国财政部表示，将继续与各财政专员保持密切沟通，审议主要国家的经济和政策趋势，并主动应对外部风险。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: HD Construction Equipment has joined hands with the Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs to honor Ethiopian soldiers who fought and died during the 1950-53 Korean War, unveiling a memorial wall bearing their names at Holy Trinity Cathedral in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The company said it held a ceremony to dedicate the memorial wall at the cathedral on Wednesday, coinciding with the International Memorial Day for U.N. Korean War Veterans. The event was attended by HD Construction Equipment CEO Moon Jae-young, Veterans Minister Kwon Oh-eul, Korean Ambassador to Ethiopia Koo Hong-seok, Ethiopian defense officials and Korean War veterans and their families. HD Construction Equipment and the veterans ministry signed a memorandum of understanding in May to establish memorial facilities in countries that sent troops to support Korea under U.N. Command. Ethiopia was selected as the first site, with HD Construction Equipment covering the full cost of construction. The wall features individual plaques inscribed with the names of the 122 fallen soldiers, as well as messages of gratitude and remembrance in Korean, English and Amharic, Ethiopia's official working language. It also includes a bronze relief depicting members of the Kagnew Battalion marching alongside Ethiopia’s national symbol, the lion. "It is deeply meaningful to permanently inscribe the names of Ethiopian heroes who gave their lives defending Korea's freedom and peace,” Kwon said in his congratulatory remarks for the event. “The government will continue to honor the U.N. veterans who demonstrated extraordinary solidarity and humanity across national borders and do its utmost to ensure that future generations in Korea and the countries that sent troops remember and carry forward the legacy of their service and solidarity." Alongside the memorial project, HD Construction Equipment will expand its cooperation with Ethiopia by supporting efforts to train local workers and develop skills needed for the country's infrastructure and industrial sectors. The company is working with local institutions to establish a training center to develop skilled construction equipment operators and maintenance technicians. The center will provide training in equipment operation and maintenance to local young people, including descendants of Korean War veterans, helping develop skilled workers and expand employment opportunities. “I hope the memorial wall will serve as a place to remember the noble sacrifices of Ethiopian veterans who fought for Korea and pass on their spirit to future generations,” Moon said. Ethiopia was the only African country to deploy ground troops to the Korean War. Its elite Kagnew Battalion, made up of imperial guards, sent about 3,500 soldiers to the conflict and recorded 253 victories in 253 engagements. A total of 122 Ethiopian soldiers were killed

The government had sanctioned 105 schools across the State at an estimated cost of ₹200 crore each as part of its efforts to provide quality education to children, irrespective of their socio-economic background, he said. Speaking after laying the foundation stone for a Telangana Public School building at the Government Boys’ School in Kazipet on Wednesday (November 11, 2026), under the Warangal West Assembly constituency, Mr. Vikramarka said the government was determined to develop an education system comparable to those in the world’s top 10 developed countries. These institutions would offer English-medium education from pre-primary to Class 12, with digital classrooms, modern teaching methods, trained teachers and other facilities. The schools would function under a semi-residential model, under which the government would provide uniforms, shoes, textbooks, notebooks, school bags and transportation facilities. Students would receive breakfast and lunch at school and return home in the evening after sports and other activities. Mr. Vikramarka said the model was designed to provide quality education without depriving children of the opportunity to spend time with their families. He said the government had introduced a breakfast scheme for nearly 27 lakh students studying in government schools across the State this year. Providing breakfast to such a large number of students within an hour was a unique initiative, he claimed. Recalling the contributions of India’s first Education Minister Maulana Abul Kalam Azad on his birth anniversary, Mr. Vikramarka said the government was committed to carrying forward his ideals of promoting education and scientific knowledge. 特伦甘纳邦副首席部长马卢·巴蒂·维克拉马尔卡表示，邦政府正努力从下一学年起开办105所“青年印度综合寄宿学校”中的数所学校，目前施工进展迅速。他说，作为为不同社会经济背景儿童提供优质教育努力的一部分，邦政府已批准在全邦设立105所学校，每所估算成本为₹200 crore。

维克拉马尔卡于2026年11月11日星期三，在瓦朗加尔西选区 Kazipet 的政府男子学校为一栋特伦甘纳公立学校教学楼奠基后表示，邦政府决心打造一套可与世界前10个发达国家相媲美的教育体系。

谈及“特伦甘纳公立学校”计划，副首席部长表示，每个选区都已获批设立一所学校。这些机构将提供从学前教育到12年级的英语授课教育，并配备数字教室、现代教学方法、经过培训的教师及其他设施。

学校将采用半寄宿制模式，由政府提供校服、鞋子、教科书、笔记本、书包和交通设施。学生将在校享用早餐和午餐，参加体育及其他活动后于傍晚回家。维克拉马尔卡表示，这一模式旨在提供优质教育，同时不剥夺儿童与家人相处的时间。

他说，今年邦政府已在全邦政府学校推出了早餐计划，覆盖近27万名学生。他声称，在一小时内为如此大规模的学生提供早餐是一项独特举措。

值印度首任教育部长毛拉纳·阿卜杜勒·卡拉姆·阿扎德诞辰之际，维克拉马尔卡表示，邦政府致力于传承他推动教育和科学知识的理念。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: Nigeria’s solid minerals sector generated more than N101 billion in revenue January through September, up from N6 billion in 2023, the Minister of Solid Minerals Development, Dele Alake, has said. Mr Alake attributed the improvement to the reforms introduced by President Bola Tinubu’s administration, saying revenue from the sector rose to N38 billion in 2024 and N70 billion in 2025 before topping N101 billion in the first nine months of 2026. He disclosed the figures on Tuesday in Abuja at the unveiling of the All Progressives Congress 2027–2031 manifesto. According to the minister, figures from the Central Bank of Nigeria showed that revenue from the sector continued to rise in 2026. “When I resumed there in 2023, the total revenue that the sector generated was N6 billion. With the introduction of creative policies and reforms, within one year, in 2024, it rose to N38 billion. By 2025, it rose to N70 billion,” he said. Mr Alake said the increase demonstrates the impact of the administration’s economic policies and efforts to restructure the mining sector. The minister defended the removal of petrol subsidy and the unification of multiple exchange rates, arguing that President Tinubu has prioritised national interest over political considerations ahead of the 2027 general election. “Ordinary politicians will think of the next election and avoid contentious policies that probably could mar their political aspirations. But not President Bola Tinubu. He puts the nation ahead of self,” he noted. Mr Alake asserted that no civilian government since Nigeria’s independence in 1960 has undertaken structural reforms on the scale of the current administration. He said the new manifesto will consolidate the reforms and extend their benefits to security, healthcare, agriculture, industrialisation, manufacturing and solid minerals. The minister added that the administration’s objective is to translate macroeconomic improvements into better living conditions for Nigerians. Nigeria has deposits of several commercially valuable minerals, including lithium, gold, iron ore, limestone, barite, coal and lead-zinc, but the sector has historically contributed relatively little to the country’s overall economic output. The government has repeatedly identified mining as an alternative source of revenue and foreign exchange earnings, particularly as it seeks to reduce dependence on crude oil. However, the sector continues to face challenges, including illegal mining, weak regulation, insecurity in mining communities, limited processing capacity and inadequate geological data. The government has also been stepping up efforts to expand local processing and value addition rather than the exportation of raw mineral resources, with the aim of creating jobs and scaling up industrial activity. Also speaking at the event, the Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, urged Nigerians to support the administration’s economic reforms, saying their benefits are becoming evident across different sectors. Mr Idris cited improved security on the Abuja-Kaduna and Abuja-Kano highways, 1.6 million beneficiaries of the student loan scheme, declining inflation and rising gross domestic product as evidence of progress. He also said Nigeria’s removal from the Financial Action Task Force grey list and improved international credit ratings have strengthened investor confidence. Minister of Budget and Economic Planning Atiku Bagudu said the president believes Nigeria can attain the level of economic development recorded by countries such as Brazil. He stated that Nigerians have begun to experience the benefits of having a leader willing to take difficult decisions, particularly in implementing economic reforms
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title_zh: 尼日利亚固体矿产收入9个月达到1010亿奈拉
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 尼日利亚固体矿产部门今年1月至9月创造了超过1010亿奈拉的收入，高于2023年的60亿奈拉。固体矿产发展部长Dele Alake表示，这一增长得益于总统Bola Tinubu政府推出的改革。他说，该部门的收入在2024年增至380亿奈拉，2025年增至700亿奈拉，随后在2026年前九个月突破1010亿奈拉。Alake部长周二在阿布贾举行的全体进步大会党2027—2031年党纲发布活动上公布了这些数据。据部长介绍，尼日利亚中央银行的数据显示，该部门的收入在2026年持续增长。他说：“我于2023年在那里复职时，该部门创造的总收入为60亿奈拉。随着创新政策和改革的推出，仅用一年时间，到2024年，这一收入便增至380亿奈拉；到2025年，又增至700亿奈拉。”Alake部长表示，这一增长证明了政府经济政策以及重组采矿行业所作努力所产生的影响。部长还为取消汽油补贴和统一多重汇率辩护，认为在2027年大选之前，Tinubu总统把国家利益置于政治考量之上。他说：“普通政客会考虑下一次选举，回避可能损害其政治前景的争议性政策。但Bola Tinubu总统不会。他把国家置于个人利益之上。”Alake部长断言，自1960年尼日利亚独立以来，历届文职政府都没有开展过当前政府这种规模的结构性改革。他说，新党纲将巩固这些改革，并将其惠及范围扩大到安全、医疗保健、农业、工业化、制造业和固体矿产领域。部长还表示，政府的目标是把握宏观经济改善成果，改善尼日利亚民众的生活条件。尼日利亚拥有多种具有商业价值的矿产储量，包括锂、金、铁矿石、石灰石、重晶石、煤和铅锌，但该部门历来对国家整体经济产出的贡献相对较少。政府多次将采矿业确定为收入和外汇收益的替代来源，尤其是希望借此减少对原油的依赖。然而，该部门仍面临非法采矿、监管薄弱、采矿社区安全形势严峻、加工能力有限以及地质数据不足等挑战。政府也在加大力度，扩大本地加工和增值业务，而不是出口未经加工的矿产资源，以创造就业岗位并扩大工业活动。同一活动上发言的信息与国家导向部长Mohammed Idris敦促尼日利亚人支持政府经济改革，称这些改革的益处正在不同领域显现。Idris部长列举了阿布贾—卡杜纳和阿布贾—卡诺公路安全状况改善、160万人成为学生贷款计划受益者、通货膨胀率下降以及国内生产总值增长，作为取得进展的证据。他还表示，尼日利亚被金融行动特别工作组列入灰名单一事已有结果，加上国际信用评级改善，增强了投资者的信心。预算与经济规划部长Atiku Bagudu说，总统相信尼日利亚能够达到巴西等国所实现的经济发展水平。他指出，尼日利亚人已经开始享受由一位愿意作出艰难决策、特别是推动经济改革的领导人所带来的益处

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.body: ABUJA — Members of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) on Wednesday staged a protest at the Federal High Court in Abuja, demanding the release of the Certified True Copy (CTC) of the judgment nullifying the party’s National Working Committee led by former Senate President, David Mark. The protesters accused the trial judge, Justice Peter Lifu, of withholding the November 5 judgment despite an application by the party’s lawyers and payment of the prescribed fees, arguing that the delay was frustrating their efforts to challenge the ruling at the Court of Appeal. The letters bore the subject: “Urgent Appeal for Diplomatic Attention and Support for Due Process, the Right of Appeal and Credible Elections in Nigeria – Re: Judgment Delivered on 5th November, 2026 in Suit No: FHC/ABJ/CS/1819/2025 (Nafiu Bala Gombe Vs. ADC & Ors).” Speaking during the protest, a former Acting Chairman of the ADC in the Federal Capital Territory, Yusuf Shehu Tijani, described the judgment as a sham and called on the National Judicial Council (NJC) to intervene. “Our reason for coming here today is what Justice Lifu is doing. He is holding on to the sham judgment he said he passed. He should send the CTC, so that we can get it and appeal the judgment. “Moreover, the Supreme Court already affirmed the leadership of Senator David Mark as the National Chairman of the African Democratic Congress. So why is the High Court going against that recognition, saying he’s passing a judgment? “Now the judgment you passed, give us the Certified True Copy so that we can appeal. He is refusing to do that. That is why we are here,” Tijani said. He said the protest was intended to draw the NJC’s attention to the alleged delay and compel the judge to release the document. “So the protest is to call on the NJC to pressure this man, let him do what is right, because justice must prevail in Nigeria. This is not a jungle. This is a country that has laws, that has rules, and we have to follow the Constitution of the country. “The stated law is that he should send the CTC so that we can appeal the judgment, which is a sham judgment in the first place,” he added. The protest followed a November 10 petition addressed to the Chief Judge of the Federal High Court, Justice John Tsoho, by members of the ADC candidates’ forum, demanding the immediate release of the judgment. In the petition signed by Audu Aliyu on behalf of the candidates, the group said its lawyers applied for the CTC immediately after Justice Lifu delivered the judgment on November 5 and paid the prescribed fees, but had yet to receive the document despite repeated visits to the court registry. The candidates said the delay was undermining their constitutional right to appeal, warning that the expiration of relevant election deadlines could render the right meaningless. “We disagree with the judgment. We have a constitutional right to appeal it. But we cannot appeal what we do not have. “As at today, 10th November, 2026, five (5) days after judgment, the CTC has NOT been released to us. Our lawyers have visited the Registry daily to no avail without any lawful explanation,” the petition stated. The petitioners also alleged that they had credible information that the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) was pressuring the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to implement the judgment despite their inability to obtain its certified copy. Citing Sections 241 and 242 of the 1999 Constitution, which provide for appeals from decisions of the Federal High Court to the Court of Appeal, as well as Section 294(1), they argued that withholding the judgment could effectively deny them access to appellate justice. In a warning about the implications of the alleged delay, the candidates stated: “If a party can obtain a judgment against the opposition on Thursday, and the CTC is withheld until the election timetable closes, then the right of appeal becomes a mere illusion. Democracy dies not by coup, but by Registry delay.” They urged the Chief Judge to direct the Registrar to release the CTC within 24 hours of receiving the petition, setting Wednesday, November 11, as the deadline. The petitioners also notified the Chief Judge that ADC members, candidates and support groups would converge on the court premises by 10am on Wednesday to demand the document, insisting that the gathering was not intended as a protest against the judiciary but a demand for access to the judgment. Copies of the petition were sent to the President of the Court of Appeal, the Chief Justice of Nigeria, the NJC, the INEC Chairman, the Nigerian Bar Association, Abuja branch, and the Inspector-General of Police. The November 5 judgment nullified Mark’s emergence as ADC National Chairman and invalidated decisions taken by the party under his leadership, including the process that produced former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar as its presidential candidate for the 2027 general elections. Justice Lifu also directed INEC not to recognise or act on decisions taken at the party’s 99th National Executive Committee meeting held on July 27, 2025. The judgment followed a suit filed by Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former Deputy National Chairman of the ADC (North-East), who argued that he was constitutionally entitled to assume the party’s leadership following the resignation of its former National Chairman, Ralph Nwosu. The ADC filed a notice of appeal on November 6 and also applied for a stay of execution, urging INEC not to take any action capable of prejudicing the outcome of the appeal. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.title_zh: 全国民主大会（ADC）抗议者就马克判决争议向尼日利亚司法委员会、联合国、欧盟、英国和美国使馆提出申诉
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/adc-.body_zh:
阿布贾——非洲民主大会（ADC）成员周三在阿布贾联邦高等法院举行抗议，要求获得判决核证真实副本（CTC）。该判决推翻了由前参议院议长David Mark领导的该党全国工作委员会。抗议者指控审理法官Peter Lifu法官无视该党律师提交的申请及已缴纳的规定费用，仍扣留11月5日的判决，认为这一拖延妨碍了他们向上诉法院提出异议。信函主题为：“请求外交关注并支持尼日利亚正当程序、上诉权及可信选举的紧急呼吁——关于2026年11月5日在第FHC/ABJ/CS/1819/2025号案件中作出的判决（Nafiu Bala Gombe诉ADC等）”。

抗议期间，ADC联邦首都区前代理主席Yusuf Shehu Tijani称该判决是一场骗局，并呼吁国家司法委员会（NJC）介入。他说：“我们今天来到这里，是因为Lifu法官正在这样做。他扣留着自己所称的骗局判决。他应当把CTC交给我们，让我们取得判决并提出上诉。

“此外，最高法院已经确认参议员David Mark担任非洲民主大会全国主席的领导权。既然如此，高等法院为何要与这一确认相抵触，称他正在作出判决？

“你们既然已经作出判决，就把核证真实副本交给我们，以便我们提出上诉。他拒绝这样做，所以我们才会来到这里。”Tijani说。

他说，此次抗议旨在引起NJC对所称拖延行为的关注，并迫使法官发布该文件。

“因此，我们举行抗议，是要求NJC向这个人施压，让他做正确的事，因为正义必须在尼日利亚得到伸张。这里不是丛林，而是一个有法律、有规则的国家，我们必须遵守国家宪法。

“法律规定，他应当把CTC交给我们，以便我们对判决提出上诉，而该判决从一开始就是骗局判决。”他补充说。

此次抗议之前，ADC候选人论坛成员已于11月10日向联邦高等法院首席法官John Tsoho法官提交请愿书，要求立即发布判决。由Audu Aliyu代表候选人签署的请愿书称，该党律师在Lifu法官于11月5日作出判决后立即申请了CTC并缴纳规定费用，但多次前往法院登记处仍未获文件。候选人们表示，这一拖延正在削弱他们依法享有的上诉权，并警告说，相关选举截止日期一旦届满，这项权利可能就会变得毫无意义。

“我们不认同该判决。我们依法享有上诉权。但如果无法取得判决，我们便无法提出上诉。

“截至今天，即2026年11月10日，判决作出5天后，CTC仍未向我们发布。我们的律师每天前往登记处，却始终无果，也未得到任何合法解释。”请愿书指出。

请愿人还声称，他们掌握可靠信息，称全进步大会（APC）正在迫使独立国家选举委员会（INEC）执行该判决，而请愿人自己却无法取得判决核证副本。他们援引1999年《宪法》第241条和第242条以及第294条第（1）款。这些条款规定了对联邦高等法院裁决提出上诉至上诉法院的相关事项。请愿人认为，扣留判决实际上可能使他们无法获得上诉司法救济。

候选人在警告所称拖延可能造成的后果时表示：“如果某一方可以在星期四取得针对反对派的判决，而CTC却被扣留到选举时间表截止，那么上诉权就会沦为空幻。民主并非死于政变，而是死于登记处的拖延。”他们敦促首席法官指示登记官在收到请愿书后24小时内发布CTC，并将11月11日星期三设为最后期限。

请愿人还通知首席法官，ADC成员、候选人及支持团体将于周三上午10时聚集法院场所，要求取得该文件，并强调此次集会并非针对司法机构的抗议，而是要求获取判决。

请愿书副本已送交上诉法院院长、尼日利亚首席大法官、NJC、INEC主席、尼日利亚律师协会阿布贾分会以及警察总监。

11月5日的判决撤销了Mark当选ADC全国主席的资格，并宣布该党在其领导下作出的决定无效，其中包括推举前副总统Atiku Abubakar参选2027年大选的程序。Lifu法官还指示INEC不得承认或执行该党于2025年7月27日举行的第99届全国执行委员会会议所作出的决定。

该判决源于ADC东北部前全国副主席Nafiu Bala Gombe提起的诉讼。他主张，在该党前全国主席Ralph Nwosu辞职后，他依据宪法有权接掌该党领导权。ADC于11月6日提交上诉通知，并申请暂缓执行，敦促INEC不要采取任何可能妨碍上诉结果的行动。本文所载评论不代表《Vanguard》报及其任何员工的观点

https://leadership.ng/dangote-refinery-i.body: Dangote Petroleum Refinery’s initial public offering (IPO) has recorded 172 per cent oversubscription, with N5.85 trillion in bids for 11.15 billion shares against 4.1 billion offered at N525 each. Subscription data seen by Nairametrics showed the N5.85 trillion in bids far exceeded the company’s initial fundraising target of N2.15 trillion, underscoring massive investor appetite for the refinery and setting the stage for one of the most significant equity transactions in African capital market history. The offering launched on September 14, 2026, initially offered approximately 4.1 billion ordinary shares at N525 each. The subscription period, initially scheduled to close on October 13, was subsequently extended to October 27 following regulatory approval. The scale of demand surprised even capital market analysts.For every share available, investors applied for nearly three shares, a level of oversubscription rarely seen in the Nigerian market. However, the subscription figures represent investor applications rather than final allotments, with the amount ultimately raised dependent on the allocation process and regulatory approvals. The strong subscription performance highlighted both the strategic importance of the refinery and the depth of liquidity now available in the Nigerian capital market, driven by domestic and international investors seeking exposure to a major energy infrastructure asset. Retail investor participation was a major feature of the IPO, supported by an extensive distribution network involving banks, stockbrokers and digital investment platforms. One investor applied for 771 million shares worth about N405 billion, or 6.92 per cent of total demand. Two groups of five investors each applied for 671.5 million shares worth N352.54 billion and 667.91 million shares worth N350.65 billion, respectively. The IPO also attracted significant interest from international institutional investors. Bloomberg earlier reported that the offering received approximately $4.1 billion in applications, comprising about $1.9 billion from Nigerian investors and a further $2.1 billion from prospective international investors. According to the report, South Africa’s Public Investment Corporation (PIC), which manages approximately $220 billion in pension assets, sought a substantial allocation. Nigerian pension fund managers were also reported to have expressed interest in acquiring shares in the refinery. The reported international demand reflects the refinery’s strategic importance as a major energy infrastructure asset and its potential role in transforming Africa’s petroleum refining industry. With subscription demand substantially exceeding the original offer size, attention is now expected to shift to the allotment process. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) allowed Dangote Refinery to absorb up to 30 per cent of additional oversubscription on top of its base offer. The offering forms part of the refinery’s broader financing strategy as it pursues an ambitious expansion programme intended to increase processing capacity to approximately 1.4 million barrels per day. The refinery’s recent financial performance has also provided investors with a basis for evaluating its growth prospects. For the nine months ended September 2026, the company reported revenue of $22.48 billion, representing a 144.47 per cent increase compared with the corresponding period of 2025. https://leadership.ng/dangote-refinery-i.body_zh: 丹格特炼油厂的首次公开募股（IPO）获得172%的超额认购，投资者针对111.5亿股股份提出总额达N5.85万亿元的申购，而此次发行规模为41亿股，每股N525。Nairametrics看到的认购数据表明，N5.85万亿元的申购额远超公司最初N2.35万亿元的融资目标，凸显出投资者对该炼油厂的热烈需求，并为非洲资本市场历史上规模最大的股权交易之一奠定了基础。此次发行于2026年9月14日启动，最初发行约41亿股普通股，每股价格为N525。认购期原定于10月13日结束，但在获得监管批准后延长至10月27日。需求的规模甚至令资本市场分析师感到意外。每有一份可供认购的股份，投资者就申购近三份，这种超额认购水平在尼日利亚市场极为罕见。不过，这些认购数据代表的是投资者的申购申请，而非最终获配数量；最终筹集的金额将取决于分配流程和监管审批。强劲的认购表现既凸显了该炼油厂的战略重要性，也反映出尼日利亚资本市场目前拥有深厚的流动性，来自国内外的投资者都希望借此投资于一项大型能源基础设施资产。散户参与此次IPO是一项显著特点，银行、股票经纪商和数字投资平台组成的广泛销售网络为散户参与提供了支持。一名投资者申购了7.71亿股，价值约N4050亿，占总需求的6.92%。两个各由五名投资者组成的团体分别申购了6.715亿股和6.6791亿股，价值分别为N3525.4亿和N3506.5亿。此次IPO也吸引了国际机构投资者的广泛关注。彭博社此前报道称，此次发行收到约$41亿的申购申请，其中约$19亿来自尼日利亚投资者，另有约$21亿来自有意参与的国际投资者。据报道，管理约$2200亿养老金资产的南非公共投资公司（PIC）寻求获得大量配售。尼日利亚养老金管理机构的基金经理据报也表达了收购该炼油厂股份的意向。国际需求反映出该炼油厂作为大型能源基础设施资产的战略重要性，以及它在推动非洲石油炼制行业转型方面可能发挥的作用。由于认购需求大幅超过最初发行规模，市场关注点预计将转向获配流程。证券交易委员会（SEC）允许丹格特炼油厂在基础发行规模之外，再吸收最多30%的额外超额认购。此次发行是该炼油厂整体融资战略的一部分；该厂正在推进一项雄心勃勃的扩建计划，拟将加工能力提高至约每日140万桶。该炼油厂近期的财务表现也为投资者评估其增长前景提供了依据。截至2026年9月的九个月，公司报告营收为$224.8亿，较2025年同期增长144.47%。税后利润增至$47.3亿，而上年同期亏损约$1.17亿。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角，直接推送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时获取全天候最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Olushola Bello Olushola Bello是《Leadership Newspaper》的高级记者，报道尼日利亚资本市场、产业部门及更广泛的经济议题。她以高影响力报道和对商业动态及金融市场的深入分析闻名，并以坚定的编辑判断以及对准确、公平的承诺为报道基础

https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.summary: Despite the differences in stop rates, the true yields remained relatively close across the instruments, settling at 18.83 per cent, 18.85 per cent and 18.68 per cent for the 154-day, 252-day and 329-day bills, respectively. https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.summary_zh: 尽管各期限票据的止售收益率存在差异，但这些工具的实际收益率总体保持相对接近，154天期、252天期和329天期票据的收益率分别稳定在18.83%、18.85%和18.68%。投资者对329天期票据的强烈偏好表明，在预计货币条件可能发生变化的情况下，投资者愿意投入资金更长时间，以获得当前收益率。
https://leadership.ng/cbn-sells-n3-85trn.body: The strong demand, which translated to a bid-to-cover ratio of 2.71 times, indicates sustained investor appetite for high-yielding government securities, particularly longer-dated instruments. Data from the auction results showed that the apex bank allotted N3.854 trillion across the three tenors, representing 2.57 times the amount offered, in what signals its continued effort to mop up excess liquidity from the financial system. A breakdown of the results showed that the 329-day instrument attracted the highest subscription of N2.82 trillion, accounting for about 69.3 per cent of the total bids received. The CBN offered N500 billion on the instrument but recorded subscriptions of N2.82 trillion, out of which N2.79 trillion was allotted at a stop rate of 15.99 per cent. The 252-day instrument also recorded subscriptions above its offer, attracting N791.5 billion against N500 billion offered. The apex bank sold N783.5 billion at a stop rate of 16.68 per cent. However, demand for the 154-day instrument fell below the amount offered, as subscriptions stood at N457.89 billion against N500 billion on offer. The CBN allotted N280.76 billion on the instrument at a stop rate of 17.44 per cent. The auction results showed a declining stop-rate structure across the three maturities, with the 154-day instrument recording the highest rate of 17.44 per cent, followed by 16.68 per cent on the 252-day bill and 15.99 per cent on the 329-day instrument. Despite the differences in stop rates, the true yields remained relatively close across the instruments, settling at 18.83 per cent, 18.85 per cent and 18.68 per cent for the 154-day, 252-day and 329-day bills, respectively. The strong preference for the 329-day instrument suggests that investors are willing to commit funds for longer periods to secure prevailing returns, amid expectations of possible changes in monetary conditions. The scale of the allotment, particularly on the longest tenor, also highlights the CBN’s willingness to absorb liquidity beyond its initial auction target. With total sales exceeding the offer by N2.35 trillion, the auction represents another significant liquidity management operation by the apex bank. The development comes as investors continue to position their portfolios around attractive fixed-income returns, with demand concentrated on longer-dated instruments offering relatively competitive yields. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.summary_zh: 韩国总理韩升效周三承诺为农民创造更好的环境，并表示政府已为明年的农业预留了史上规模最大的预算。韩升效在农民节典礼上致辞称，政府已划拨超过3万亿韩元（22亿美元）的农民补贴，这笔资金被称为“公共利益直接支付”；这是该预算首次突破3万亿韩元大关。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook pledged Wednesday to create a better environment for farmers, saying the government has set aside the largest-ever budget for farming for next year. Han said in an address at a Farmers' Day ceremony that the government has earmarked more than 3 trillion won ($2.2 billion) in subsidies for farmers, known as "public interest direct payment," the first time the budget has exceeded the 3 trillion-won mark. She also said the government more than tripled the budget for the rural basic income from some 300 billion won to more than 1.1 trillion won for next year and will keep increasing the budget going forward. The government is also preparing to introduce retirement pension for farmers, she said. "The president said last month that agriculture is a national security industry and a strategic industry that is essential to the survival of the Republic of Korea," Han said. "First of all, I believe that creating an environment where farmers can work with peace of mind is crucial for safeguarding agricultural security." "Expanding smart farming is of vital importance for the future," she said. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 如今发生变化的是用来逃避作弊的技术，从篡改答题卡和发送短信，到人工智能（AI）驱动的眼镜。几个世纪后，手机让作弊变成了一项协同行动。一名教育部官员表示：“防止利用AI眼镜作弊并非教育部一家的责任。”他还指出，负责医疗执照和技术资格考试的机构也需要应对这一问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: What has changed is the technology used to get away with it, from altered answer sheets and text messages to artificial intelligence (AI)-powered glasses. As the methods grow more sophisticated, detecting them has become increasingly difficult. Even the civil service examinations of the 1392-1910 Joseon Dynasty were vulnerable to cheaters. In a 1699 scandal, 15 of 33 successful candidates were found to have passed through irregular means, including the swapping of names attached to exam papers. Centuries later, mobile phones made cheating a coordinated operation. During the 2004 college entrance exam, students in Gwangju divided up roles among high-scoring test takers, intermediaries and recipients, passing answers through text messages. According to Ministry of Education figures released in 2005, the scores of 472 students were invalidated for cheating on college entrance exams from the 2002 through 2005 academic years. Of those, 412 had used text messages. The scandal prompted tighter restrictions on electronic devices and tougher penalties. More recently, smart glasses have added another challenge for exam supervisors. Two people were caught using AI-enabled glasses during TOEIC English-language tests in May. Three candidates wearing smart glasses were also caught at national technical qualification exams in Seoul, Gwangju and Mokpo, South Jeolla Province. Similar cases have surfaced in university entrance examinations. A survey from the education ministry released Monday found four cases involving smart glasses in middle and high school exams this year — one at a middle school and three at high schools. The survey covered 5,679 schools nationwide. At a high school in North Jeolla Province, a teacher grew suspicious when a student repeatedly touched the frames of his glasses during an exam. A green light reflected in the lenses helped give him away. All four students received zeros for the subjects concerned, while the three high school students faced additional disciplinary measures. The issue comes as Korea prepares for its annual College Scholastic Ability Test on Nov. 19. A separate tally found 1,229 cheating violations over the past five years, although many involved writing answers after time was called rather than using electronic devices. “Preventing cheating with AI glasses is not an issue for the Ministry of Education alone,” a ministry official said, adding that agencies overseeing medical licensing and technical qualification exams also need to address the problem. Smart glasses and other electronic devices will be banned from test centers on exam day. Officials are also exploring ways to detect the glasses electronically, but have yet to find a reliable solution
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 从隐蔽纸条到人工智能眼镜，作弊呈现出新形式
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 发生变化的是用来逃避作弊 detection 的技术，从篡改答题卡、发送短信，到利用人工智能（AI）眼镜作弊。随着手段日益精密，侦破作弊也变得越来越困难。即使是1392年至1910年朝鲜王朝的公务员考试，也曾容易受到作弊者侵害。1699年的一起丑闻中，33名录取者里有15人被认定通过不正当手段通过考试，其中包括调换试卷上的姓名。数百年后，手机使作弊变成了一项协同行动。在2004年高考期间，光州的学生在高分考生、中间人和接收者之间分工，通过短信传递答案。根据教育部于2005年公布的数据，2002年至2005学年的大学入学考试中，共有472名学生的成绩因作弊而作废，其中412人使用了短信。这场丑闻促使有关部门收紧对电子设备的限制，并加大处罚力度。近来，智能眼镜又给考试监考人员带来了另一项挑战。今年5月，两人在TOEIC英语考试中被发现使用人工智能眼镜。在韩国全罗南道首尔、光州和木浦举行的国家技术资格考试中，也有三名佩戴智能眼镜的考生被抓到。大学入学考试中也出现了类似案例。教育部周一发布的一项调查发现，今年初中和高中考试涉及智能眼镜的案件共有4起，其中初中1起、高中3起。调查覆盖全国5679所学校。在全罗北道的一所高中，一名教师在考试期间因一名学生反复触碰眼镜框而产生怀疑。镜片上反射的绿色灯光让他识破了作弊。这4名学生的相关科目成绩均为零，3名高中生还受到额外纪律处分。在韩国准备于11月19日举行年度大学修学能力试验之际，又出现了这一问题。另一项统计显示，过去五年共有1229起作弊违规行为，尽管其中许多是在停止答题信号后继续抄写答案，而非使用电子设备。教育部一名官员说：“防止利用AI眼镜作弊并非教育部一家机构能够解决的问题。”他还表示，负责医疗执照和技术资格考试的机构也需要应对这一问题。考试当天，智能眼镜及其他电子设备将被禁止带入场内。有关部门还在研究通过电子手段侦测智能眼镜的方法，但尚未找到可靠的解决方案……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea warns of rare vision-loss risk linked to GLP-1 drugs
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety issued a safety alert Wednesday to medical professionals and patients over a potential risk of a rare eye condition associated with GLP-1 obesity drugs, including popular obesity treatments Wegovy and Mounjaro. The move follows safety measures by overseas regulators concerning nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a condition caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve that can lead to sudden, potentially permanent vision loss.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 食品与药品安全部周三向医疗 professionals 和患者发布安全警报，警告 GLP-1 肥胖药物可能与一种罕见眼病有关，其中包括广受欢迎的肥胖治疗药物 Wegovy 和 Mounjaro。此前，海外监管机构已针对非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）采取安全措施；这种疾病由流向视神经的血流减少引起，可能导致突然且可能永久的视力丧失。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Ministry of Food and Drug Safety issued a safety alert Wednesday to medical professionals and patients over a potential risk of a rare eye condition associated with GLP-1 obesity drugs, including popular obesity treatments Wegovy and Mounjaro. The move follows safety measures by overseas regulators concerning nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy (NAION), a condition caused by reduced blood flow to the optic nerve that can lead to sudden, potentially permanent vision loss. In June last year, the European Medicines Agency classified it as a very rare side effect of semaglutide, the active ingredient in Wegovy, estimating it may affect up to 1 in 10,000 users. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration asked drugmakers Monday to add a possible increased risk of NAION to the warnings and precautions on GLP-1 drug labels. The letter advises medical professionals to stop treatment and have patients examined immediately if NAION is suspected in those taking GLP-1 drugs, which aid weight loss by mimicking a hormone that regulates appetite and blood sugar. Patients with related symptoms are advised to consult their doctors right away. The food and drug ministry also asked companies selling GLP-1 drugs in Korea to submit data, including plans to amend their product approvals in light of the safety information. Based on the submissions, the ministry will consider revising the drugs’ usage precautions. The safety measure comes amid surging demand for GLP-1 obesity treatments in Korea. According to drug utilization review data submitted by the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Service to Rep. Han Zee-a of the People Power Party in July, Mounjaro was prescribed 1,501,161 times from its domestic launch last August through May this year. Monthly prescriptions rose about 14.7 times, from 18,579 in August last year to 273,140 in May this year. By age group, people in their 30s accounted for the largest share at 36 percent, followed by those in their 40s at 27.1 percent, those in their 20s at 16.9 percent and those in their 50s at 14.6 percent. Wegovy was prescribed a cumulative 1,228,867 times from its October 2024 launch through May this year. People in their 20s and 30s accounted for 46.4 percent of that total
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国警告称，GLP-1药物存在罕见的失明风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国食品药品安全部周三向医务人员和患者发布安全警报，警示GLP-1类肥胖药物（包括热门减重药Wegovy和Mounjaro）可能存在一种罕见眼病的风险。此举是在海外监管机构针对非动脉炎性前部缺血性视神经病变（NAION）采取安全措施之后发布的。NAION由流向视神经的血流减少引起，可能造成突发性且可能永久性的视力丧失。去年6月，欧洲药品管理局将其列为司美格鲁肽的一种极罕见副作用；司美格鲁肽是Wegovy的活性成分，监管机构估计，每10,000名使用者中可能有多达1人受到影响。美国食品药品监督管理局周一要求药品制造商在GLP-1类药物标签的警告和注意事项中加入NAION风险可能上升的提示。该信函建议医务人员在服用GLP-1类药物的患者疑似患有NAION时停止治疗，并立即安排患者接受检查；这类药物通过模拟调节食欲和血糖的激素来帮助减重。出现相关症状的患者被建议立即咨询医生。食品药品安全部还要求在韩国销售GLP-1类药物的公司提交相关数据，包括根据安全信息修改产品批准事项的计划。该部将根据提交的材料考虑修订这些药物的使用注意事项。采取这项安全措施之际，GLP-1类肥胖治疗药物在韩国的需求激增。根据健康保险审查评价服务7月提交给国民力量党议员韩在爱的药品使用审查数据，自去年8月在韩国上市以来至今年5月，Mounjaro的处方量达1,501,161次。月处方量约增长14.7倍，从去年8月的18,579次增至今年5月的273,140次。按年龄组划分，30多岁人群占比最高，为36%；其次是40多岁人群，占27.1%；20多岁人群占16.9%；50多岁人群占14.6%。自2024年10月上市以来至今年5月，Wegovy累计处方1,228,867次。20多岁和30多岁人群占总数的46.4%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Police chief nominee's confirmation hearing set for Nov. 18
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The National Assembly will hold a confirmation hearing for Kim Jong-chul, nominee for commissioner general of the Korean National Police Agency (KNPA), next week, officials said Wednesday. The KNPA commissioner general nominee can be appointed by the president even without parliamentary consent following the confirmation hearing.

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The National Assembly will hold a confirmation hearing for Kim Jong-chul, nominee for commissioner general of the Korean National Police Agency (KNPA), next week, officials said Wednesday. https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.summary: The Minister of Steel Development, Prince Shuaibu Abubakar Audu, disclosed this at a stakeholders’ engagement to validate the proposed Scrap Metal (Collection, Trading, Recycling and Regulation) Regulations, 2026, held in Lagos from 9 November to 10. Represented by Ime Eprikpo, director of Metallurgical Raw Material Development and Investment Promotion, Audu said the regulations would establish a transparent and sustainable scrap metal value chain to support industrialisation.
https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.summary_zh: 钢铁发展部长Shuaibu Abubakar Audu亲王在拉各斯举行的利益相关方磋商活动中披露了有关情况。此次活动于11月9日至10日举行，旨在验证拟议中的《2026年废金属（收集、交易、回收与监管）条例》。冶金原材料开发与投资促进主任Ime Eprikpo代表Audu出席活动。他表示，这些条例将建立透明、可持续的废金属价值链，以支持工业化。
https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.body: The Minister of Steel Development, Prince Shuaibu Abubakar Audu, disclosed this at a stakeholders’ engagement to validate the proposed Scrap Metal (Collection, Trading, Recycling and Regulation) Regulations, 2026, held in Lagos from 9 November to 10. Represented by Ime Eprikpo, director of Metallurgical Raw Material Development and Investment Promotion, Audu said the regulations would establish a transparent and sustainable scrap metal value chain to support industrialisation. He described scrap metal as a vital raw material for steelmaking and manufacturing, with the potential to create jobs, reduce waste and promote a circular economy. However, he warned that poor regulation encouraged infrastructure theft, unsafe dismantling and environmental degradation. The proposed framework provides for operator licensing, regulation of collection centres, transaction traceability, safety standards and stronger enforcement against illicit trade. “Our objective is not to suppress legitimate commercial activity. Rather, it is to establish a system in which lawful businesses can operate with greater clarity and confidence, while activities involving stolen materials, unsafe practices or environmental harm are addressed through appropriate regulatory and legal measures,” he said. Audu assured small-scale operators, many of whom depend on scrap trading for their livelihoods, of a pathway to formalisation with requirements proportionate to their business scale. Expressing concern over the theft of electrical cables, railway components, manhole covers, and other public infrastructure, he called for stricter supplier verification, improved transaction records, and collaboration with security agencies to curb the trade in stolen metals. He urged stakeholders to submit practical recommendations to strengthen the draft regulations and address potential implementation challenges. FG Targets Steel Industry Growth: The Permanent Secretary, Ambassador Nura Abba Rimi, represented by Christopher T. Wanje, Director of Metallurgical Inspectorate and Environmental Protection, said the initiative aligned with President Bola Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda to build a competitive and self-sustaining steel industry. He described effective scrap metal regulation as essential to securing raw materials, improving resource efficiency and strengthening local manufacturing. Industry Backs Regulation: The National President of the National Association of Scrap and Waste Dealers Employers of Nigeria, Comrade Pastor Engr. Ogbu Luke Uchechukwu, described the engagement as a landmark step towards an organised and economically viable scrap industry. Similarly, NESREA Director-General, Dr Innocent Bariate Bariko, represented by Engr. Walter Okoye, welcomed the initiative, noting that although scrap metal was vital to steel production and the circular economy, poor regulation posed environmental and public health risks. Busari Olanrewaju of Kam Steel Integrated Company Ltd. also pledged the company’s support through training for scrap collectors, standardised grading, modern sorting and shredding technologies, and increased local utilisation of Nigerian scrap metal. https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.title_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府推动监管废金属交易
https://leadership.ng/fg-moves-to-regula.body_zh: 钢铁发展部长谢艾布·阿布巴卡尔·奥杜亲王在11月9日至10日于拉各斯举行的利益相关方会议上披露了这一信息，会议旨在验证拟议的《2026年废金属（收集、交易、回收与监管）条例》。冶金原材料开发与投资促进主任伊梅·埃普里克波代表奥杜出席。他表示，这些条例将建立一个透明、可持续的废金属价值链，以支持工业化。他指出，废金属是炼钢和制造业的重要原材料，具有创造就业、减少废弃物和促进循环经济的潜力。然而，他警告称，监管不力会助长基础设施盗窃、不安全拆解和环境恶化。拟议框架规定了对经营者进行许可管理、规范收集中心、实施交易可追溯性、制定安全标准，并加强打击非法贸易。他说：“我们的目标不是压制合法商业活动，而是建立一套制度，使合法企业能够在更清晰、更有信心的情况下经营，同时通过适当的监管和法律措施处理涉及被盗材料、不安全做法或环境危害的活动。”奥杜向小规模经营者保证，其中许多人依靠废金属贸易维持生计，针对他们提供合规转化路径，且相关要求与其经营规模相称。他对电缆、铁路设施、井盖和其他公共基础设施被盗表示关切，呼吁加强供应商核验、改善交易记录，并与安全机构合作，以遏制被盗金属交易。他敦促利益相关方提交切实可行的建议，以强化条例草案并应对潜在的实施挑战。联邦政府推动钢铁工业发展：冶金监察与环境保护主任克里斯托弗·T·万杰代表常任秘书、大使努拉·阿巴·里米出席上述活动。万杰表示，此项举措与博拉·蒂努布总统的“ renewed Hope”议程相一致，旨在建设一个具有竞争力且能够自我 sustaining 的钢铁工业。他指出，有效监管废金属对于保障原材料供应、提高资源效率和加强本地制造至关重要。业界支持监管：尼日利亚全国废品与废弃物经销商雇主协会全国主席、同志牧师兼工程师奥格布·卢克·乌切库卢表示，此次协商是迈向组织化且经济上可持续的废品行业的重要一步。同样，NESREA总干事英nocent·巴里亚特·巴里科由工程师沃尔特·奥科耶代表，对这项举措表示欢迎，并指出，尽管废金属对钢铁生产和循环经济至关重要，但监管不力会带来环境和公共健康风险。Kam Steel Integrated Company Ltd.的布萨里·奥兰雷乔也承诺支持公司通过为废品收集人员提供培训、推行标准化分级、采用现代化分拣和粉碎技术，以及提高尼日利亚废金属的本地利用等方式予以支持。我们拥有独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接送达您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS 的 WhatsApp 频道，随时随地获取更新 → 加入我们的 WhatsApp 频道 --> --> 西拉斯·埃泽古 西拉斯·埃泽古是《Leadership Newspaper》的高级记者，报道包括矿山和钢铁在内的多个领域。

https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.title: Niger LGAs To Introduce Dedicated Nutrition Budget Lines In 2027
https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.summary: The resolution was contained in a communiqué adopted at a two-day capacity-building retreat on sustainable nutrition financing for the executive chairmen of the 25 LGAs, organised by the Civil Society Scaling Up Nutrition in Nigeria (CS-SUNN) in partnership with the Niger State Government. According to the communiqué, the LGAs will also inaugurate and operationalise Local Government Committees on Food and Nutrition across the 25 councils by the first quarter of 2027.
https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.summary_zh: 该决议载于一份为期两天的可持续营养融资能力建设研讨会通过的公报中。研讨会面向尼日利亚25个地方政府行政区的行政主席举行，由尼日利亚民间社会推动营养规模化组织（CS-SUNN）与尼日尔州政府合作主办。公报称，这些地方政府行政区还将于2027年第一季度前，在全部25个行政委员会设立并启动地方食品与营养委员会。
https://leadership.ng/niger-lgas-to-intr.body: The resolution was contained in a communiqué adopted at a two-day capacity-building retreat on sustainable nutrition financing for the executive chairmen of the 25 LGAs, organised by the Civil Society Scaling Up Nutrition in Nigeria (CS-SUNN) in partnership with the Niger State Government. The retreat, held in Abuja from November 5 to 6, 2026, also resolved that the local governments would move beyond budgetary approvals to ensure predictable quarterly cash releases for nutrition programmes. The chairmen further committed to developing Annual Operational Plans to guide nutrition spending and implementation, as well as strengthening accountability mechanisms to ensure that allocated funds and nutrition commodities reach intended beneficiaries. According to the communiqué, the LGAs will also inaugurate and operationalise Local Government Committees on Food and Nutrition across the 25 councils by the first quarter of 2027. The committees are expected to coordinate nutrition planning, budgeting, implementation and monitoring at the grassroots level under the leadership of the respective LGA chairmen. The retreat noted that although ₦500 million was already available in the state nutrition account, securing budgetary allocations alone was insufficient without timely releases and effective utilisation of the funds. Participants therefore called for sustained advocacy and engagement with government institutions to ensure that existing financial commitments translate into interventions that address malnutrition. They also identified the UNICEF Child Nutrition Fund’s 1:1 matching arrangement as an opportunity to mobilise additional resources for nutrition, stressing the need for timely counterpart funding by government. The communiqué further recommended capacity-building programmes for nutrition desk officers and focal persons to improve their skills in planning, budget preparation, data analysis and field monitoring. To strengthen transparency, the LGAs also resolved to collaborate with the State Committee on Food and Nutrition, CS-SUNN and community structures to track nutrition resources and prevent the diversion of commodities. Participants emphasised the need for community sensitisation and the promotion of locally produced nutritious foods, including Tom Brown, to encourage demand for maternal, infant and young child feeding services. The retreat observed that nutrition interventions were often carried out on an ad hoc basis in many LGAs due to the absence of dedicated budget lines, making structured planning and predictable financing necessary for sustainable results. Roy Vincent Trinidad (Reserve), the Armed Forces of the Philippines’ spokesperson on matters relating to the West Philippine Sea, said he agreed with the Vice President that the Philippines should not antagonize other countries but stressed that asserting its maritime rights was a separate matter. “We are not picking a fight with any country over the West Philippine Sea,” Trinidad said in a press briefing at Camp Aguinaldo. “By merely standing up for what is rightfully and legally ours, we are not fighting any other country.” Trinidad was responding to Duterte’s remarks during a gathering with overseas Filipino workers in Hong Kong on Sunday, where she urged the government to maintain good relations with China despite the maritime dispute. The Vice President warned that deteriorating bilateral ties could threaten the jobs and businesses of Filipinos working in China. She also called for a team of diplomats and negotiators to handle the dispute rather than resorting to confrontations at sea or exchanges on social media. READ: Marcos wants South China Sea code of conduct finalized during Asean She further cited the disparity between the two countries’ military capabilities, arguing that the government should consider the consequences of confronting a more powerful neighbor. Asked about Duterte’s comparison of the Philippines’ military strength with China’s, Trinidad said the AFP would continue performing its mandate regardless of its capabilities. “It is not about military strength. We have what we have. We are improving our capabilities,” he said. “Given what we have, we are good. Given more, we could perform even better. But it will not stop the AFP from fighting, from standing up, from supporting all our government officials who stand up for our rights in the West Philippine Sea.” Trinidad also stressed that every Filipino, including elected officials, has a responsibility to defend the country’s national interests. “The Arbitral Tribunal of 2016 is a legal landmark that upheld the maritime entitlements of the Philippines. Every Filipino should champion this,” he said. The 2016 arbitral ruling invalidated China’s sweeping maritime claims in the South China Sea, although Beijing has refused to recognize the decision. Trinidad also said the AFP would not scale back its activities in the West Philippine Sea despite calls to preserve diplomatic space for talks with Beijing. Asked whether the military should tone down its assertion of Philippine maritime rights to give diplomacy a chance, Trinidad said the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and the defense establishment had distinct responsibilities. “We leave the statement of the [DFA] at that inasmuch as they are the primary vehicle of government for diplomacy,” he said. “On the side of the [Department of National Defense] and the AFP, we have a mandate to perform to secure the integrity of the national territory, protect our sovereignty, and look after the welfare of the Filipino people,” he added. The DFA earlier reminded officials, particularly members of the defense and security sector, to align their statements and actions with President Marcos’ foreign policy direction, particularly with regard to China. The Navy said the launch, conducted from the Hainan International Commercial Launch Center in Wenchang, Hainan, at 4:24 a.m., produced an unusual phenomenon over this city and several Philippine-held island stations in the West Philippine Sea, raising concerns over the potential security implications of similar activities. The Long March 12 rocket is known to produce light and smoke trails as it enters the final stage of its launch, followed by loud sounds attributed to sonic booms. These effects were observed in this city about nine minutes after the launch, when bright lights illuminated the sky before loud explosions were heard. Navy personnel deployed at various stations in the West Philippine Sea also reported similar observations, particularly in Lawak, Patag, and Likas Islands, as well as Rizal (Commodore) Reef. Personnel assigned to the Tubbataha Reef Natural Park reported seeing a bright luminous object approximately 35 kilometers (19 nautical miles) from their station. The area had earlier been identified by the Philippine Space Agency as a possible drop zone for debris from the rocket. Based on its initial assessment, NavComWest said the phenomenon, known as a “space jellyfish,” was likely caused by the expansion of rocket exhaust gases at high altitudes. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Korea's top economic policymaker said Wednesday the government will release annual economic growth forecasts three times a year starting in 2027, up from the current two, to respond more proactively to changing economic conditions. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il made the announcement as he discussed details of the government's economic growth strategy for next year with relevant ministers, indicating the plan will seek sustainable growth by addressing disparities.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 韩国最高经济决策官员周三表示，政府将从2027年起每年发布3次年度经济增长预测，高于目前的2次，以更主动地应对不断变化的经济形势。财政部长李炯一在与相关部长讨论政府明年的经济增长战略细节时宣布了这一消息，并表示该计划将通过解决差距问题来寻求可持续增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea's top economic policymaker said Wednesday the government will release annual economic growth forecasts three times a year starting in 2027, up from the current two, to respond more proactively to changing economic conditions. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il made the announcement as he discussed details of the government's economic growth strategy for next year with relevant ministers, indicating the plan will seek sustainable growth by addressing disparities. "In order to promptly respond to the changing environment at home and abroad, the government will increase the number of economic outlooks issued from two to three, which would mark the first change in 32 years," Lee said. Lee said the government will no longer release a separate economic growth strategy for the second half of the year under the revised system, but will instead draw up supplementary measures to address economic conditions when it announces its growth forecasts. The finance minister said details will be announced in December following discussions with relevant ministries. During the meeting, Lee added that the government will continue efforts to maintain the current growth momentum through flagship initiatives, including the three megaprojects
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 财政部长：政府每年将公布3次经济增长预测
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国最高经济决策官员周三表示，政府从2027年起将每年发布三次经济增长预测，而目前是每年两次，以更主动地应对不断变化的经济状况。财政部长李炯一是在与相关部长讨论政府明年的经济增长战略细节时宣布这一消息的，并表示该计划将通过解决差距问题来寻求可持续增长。李说：“为了迅速应对国内外环境的变化，政府将把发布经济展望的次数从两次增加到三次，这将是32年来首次作出这一调整。”李表示，在修订后的制度下，政府将不再单独发布下半年经济增长战略，而是在公布增长预测时制定补充措施，应对经济状况。这位财政部长说，相关部委讨论完成后，具体细节将于12月公布。会上，李补充说，政府将继续通过包括三大超级项目在内的旗舰项目，努力维持当前的增长势头

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/pol.body: Korea will extend its fuel tax cuts by another two months through January to ease the financial burden on the public amid lingering uncertainty in the Middle East, the finance ministry said Wednesday. The Ministry of Finance and Economy said the decision was made at a meeting of economy-related ministers chaired by Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il, taking into account the need to ease the burden on households and the government's capacity to respond to future price volatility. Under the measure, the current tax cuts of 15 percent on gasoline and 25 percent on diesel and butane, originally set to expire at the end of this month, will remain in place through the end of January. The ministry said the larger tax cuts on diesel and butane reflect the importance of diesel to industrial and logistics operations and the widespread use of butane as fuel for small trucks

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea will launch a new task force led by the finance minister to address widening disparities across various sectors, the government said Wednesday. Finance Minister Lee Hyoung-il unveiled the plan during a meeting with economy-related ministers, saying the task force will consist of five working groups tasked with addressing disparities in the labor market, industries, regions, generations and social classes. Each group will be led by a vice minister responsible for the respective area and work with state-run research institutes to identify key policy tasks. "The artificial intelligence transformation could deepen and accelerate disparities, leading to a K-shaped divide," the government said. The working groups will officially launch Thursday, with each set to report its detailed goals to the task force by early December. Key policy agendas will be reflected in Korea's economic growth plan for 2027

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: In September, it was also confirmed that South Korea had formally notified the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of its intention to begin consultations on an arrangement under Article 14 of its Comprehensive Safeguards Agreement. It is time to put specific negotiating objectives in writing. As the agreement’s first anniversary approaches, Seoul and Washington need an implementation plan that places fuel procurement and construction preparations on a single, coordinated timeline.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 9月还确认，韩国已正式通知国际原子能机构（IAEA），打算就依据其《全面保障协定》第14条达成安排开始磋商。现在是时候将具体谈判目标书面确定了。随着该协定即将迎来首个周年纪念日，首尔和华盛顿需要制定一份实施计划，将燃料采购和建设准备工作纳入同一个协调推进的时间表。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: As the first anniversary of the ROK–U.S. Joint Fact Sheet singed in November 2025 approaches, Seoul and Washington should demonstrate concrete progress in implementing their commitments. The United States approved South Korea’s construction of nuclear-powered submarines and pledged close cooperation on the requirements for the program, including avenues to source fuel. Those political commitments must now be translated into clear timelines and clearly assigned responsibilities. Securing a shipyard alone will not deliver a nuclear-powered submarine. Fuel specifications and supply arrangements must be established to align reactor design and testing, submarine construction and entry into service. Delays in fuel cooperation could lead to design changes, higher costs and uncertainty for companies considering investment. Diplomatic negotiations and domestic development must not become trapped in a cycle in which each waits for decisions from the other. There has been some progress. In December 2025, the two countries’ foreign affairs officials agreed on the need to move promptly toward follow-up consultations on nuclear cooperation, shipbuilding and nuclear-powered submarines. At a congressional hearing in March, a senior State Department official explained that an interagency review was underway, with the Pentagon addressing infrastructure issues and the State Department handling matters related to potential nuclear fuel provision. In June, delegations from both countries met in Seoul for follow-up consultations on nuclear-powered submarines and civil nuclear cooperation. They agreed to pursue tangible results promptly and establish a mechanism to review progress. In September, it was also confirmed that South Korea had formally notified the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) of its intention to begin consultations on an arrangement under Article 14 of its Comprehensive Safeguards Agreement. This is an important step toward developing naval nuclear propulsion while upholding nonproliferation obligations. However, according to an Oct. 30 news report, a senior South Korean presidential official said that follow-up security negotiations remained on hold and that a second round had yet to be scheduled. Beginning consultations does not, by itself, guarantee sustained progress. Procedural progress must also be distinguished from securing fuel. The Joint Fact Sheet did not guarantee direct U.S. fuel supply or delivery by a specified date. Nor do consultations with the IAEA determine the supplier or delivery schedule. The government nevertheless has a responsibility to explain what has been agreed and which decisions remain outstanding. The most immediate reason South Korea needs nuclear-powered submarines is the threat posed by North Korea’s submarine-launched ballistic missiles. Because the movements of North Korean submarines and the timing of a potential launch cannot be predicted with certainty, the ability to maintain prolonged underwater surveillance and tracking is essential. Nuclear-powered submarines offer advantages in submerged endurance and sustained high-speed operations. Their effectiveness increases when they operate alongside surface ships, maritime patrol aircraft and underwater surveillance systems. South Korea must also prepare for neighboring countries’ expanding submarine forces and maritime influence. Protecting sea lines of communication and maritime interests, while strengthening the persistence of combined ROK–U.S. anti-submarine warfare operations, serves both allies. A greater South Korean contribution to surveillance and anti-submarine warfare in surrounding waters would also give the U.S. Navy greater operational flexibility. The missions of South Korean nuclear-powered submarines should, however, be grounded in the defense of the Korean Peninsula and South Korea’s sovereign authority over decisions concerning their employment. For more than seven decades, the ROK–U.S. alliance has remained one of the world’s strongest. South Korea’s submarine construction expertise and naval maintenance capabilities are valuable assets for the United States as well. Nuclear fuel cooperation and shipbuilding cooperation should not be treated as a simple exchange of concessions. The case should instead be made clearly that both can strengthen the alliance’s maritime security and industrial base. It is time to put specific negotiating objectives in writing. A framework should identify the supplier, uranium enrichment level and fuel form, the timing of initial delivery, ownership arrangements and principles for managing spent nuclear fuel. Both governments should also identify the U.S. laws and congressional review procedures applicable to the particular materials or technology to be transferred. Civil nuclear enrichment and reprocessing cooperation and fuel cooperation for naval propulsion serve different purposes and follow different legal pathways. Each therefore requires a clearly defined negotiating agenda. Regardless of the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections, engagement between South Korea’s National Assembly and the U.S. Congress must deepen. Reliable implementation of executive-level agreements requires understanding and support across party lines. Lawmakers from South Korea’s governing and opposition parties should jointly engage the relevant House and Senate committees and key members of Congress. They should explain the military requirement, the benefits to the alliance, the proposed use of low-enriched uranium and the measures intended to uphold nonproliferation commitments. Parliamentary diplomacy must go beyond goodwill visits. South Korean representatives should provide evidence-based answers to congressional questions about fuel management, technology protection, financial responsibilities and the industrial benefits for members’ states and districts. The National Assembly should support the government’s negotiations while scrutinizing budgets, schedules and safety arrangements. Bipartisan support should be accompanied by responsible oversight that helps sustain the program. South Korea must also strengthen its domestic arrangements for implementing the program. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs should lead diplomatic negotiations with Washington, while the Ministry of National Defense and the Defense Acquisition Program Administration define operational requirements and acquisition schedules. Nuclear research institutions and industry should specify the scope of development and technical requirements, and safety regulators should participate from the outset. A governmentwide coordination mechanism must make clear who is responsible for each decision and when it must be made, so that negotiated outcomes can be translated promptly into program execution. Preparations that can proceed should advance while fuel decisions remain pending. Defining operational performance requirements, securing design personnel and preparing testing and maintenance infrastructure should move forward in parallel, with careful management of the risk that fuel decisions may require changes. The government should work backward from the design and construction schedule to set negotiating milestones and prepare contingencies for delays. It should report regularly to the National Assembly on progress and major risks, using closed briefings for sensitive matters. Alliance credibility is demonstrated through implementation. South Korea must prepare for responsible development and effective nonproliferation arrangements, while the United States should clarify the practical pathways for fulfilling its commitments. Legislators in both countries should support this work across election cycles and changes of government. As the agreement’s first anniversary approaches, Seoul and Washington need an implementation plan that places fuel procurement and construction preparations on a single, coordinated timeline. Ret. Navy Capt. Moon Keun-sik is distinguished professor of Graduate School of Public Policy at Hanyang University in Seoul

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 随着2025年11月签署的韩美联合情况说明首个周年即将到来，首尔和华盛顿应以具体进展证明双方正在履行承诺。美国已批准韩国建造核动力潜艇，并承诺就该项目的相关要求密切合作，包括核燃料来源渠道。这些政治承诺如今必须转化为明确时间表和清晰的责任分工。仅找到一家造船厂并不能造出核动力潜艇。双方必须确定燃料规格和供应安排，使反应堆设计与测试、潜艇建造及服役相互衔接。燃料合作若延误，可能导致设计变更、成本上升，并给考虑投资的企业带来不确定性。外交谈判与国内研发不能陷入彼此等待对方决定的循环。目前已取得一些进展。2025年12月，两国外交事务官员同意，应迅速推进关于核合作、造船和核动力潜艇的后续磋商。3月举行的一次国会听证会上，美国国务院一名高级官员表示，跨部门审查正在推进，五角大楼负责处理基础设施问题，国务院负责处理与可能提供核燃料有关的事务。6月，两国代表团在首尔举行后续磋商，讨论核动力潜艇和民用核合作。双方同意迅速取得实质性成果，并建立审查进展的机制。9月，韩国还确认已正式通知国际原子能机构（IAEA），拟就其《全面保障监督协定》第14条所设安排开始磋商。这是朝着发展海军核动力推进技术迈出的重要一步，同时也能履行不扩散义务。然而，据10月30日的一篇新闻报道，韩国总统府一名高级官员称，后续安保谈判仍处于搁置状态，第二轮会谈尚未安排。启动磋商本身并不能保证持续进展。还必须将程序性进展与落实燃料供应区分开来。《联合情况说明》并未保证美国直接供应燃料或规定具体交付日期。与IAEA磋商也无法确定供应方或交付时间表。尽管如此，政府仍有责任说明双方已经商定什么，以及哪些决定仍未作出。韩国急需核动力潜艇的直接原因，是朝鲜弹道导弹潜艇带来的威胁。由于朝鲜潜艇的动向及潜在发射时间无法准确预测，长期保持水下监视和追踪能力至关重要。核动力潜艇在水下续航和持续高速运行方面具有优势。与水面舰艇、海上巡逻机和水下监视系统协同行动时，其效能会进一步提高。韩国还必须为邻国不断扩大的潜艇力量和海上影响做好准备。保护海上交通线和海洋利益，同时加强韩美联合反潜行动的持续能力，对两个盟友都有益。韩国为周边水域监视和反潜作战作出更大贡献，也会让美国海军获得更大的行动灵活性。不过，韩国核动力潜艇的任务必须以朝鲜半岛防务为根基，且其使用决定必须由韩国依据主权作出。七十多年来，韩美同盟一直是世界上最强大的同盟之一。韩国的潜艇建造专长和海军维护能力对美国同样宝贵。核燃料合作与造船合作不应被视为简单的利益交换，而应明确说明双方合作都能增强同盟的海上安全和产业基础。是时候把具体谈判目标写入文件了。框架应明确供应方、铀浓缩丰度和燃料形态、首次交付时间、所有权安排以及乏核燃料管理原则。双方政府还应查明适用于拟转让特定材料或技术的美国法律及国会审查程序。民用核浓缩与后处理合作，以及舰船核动力推进所需的燃料合作，服务于不同目标，遵循不同法律路径，因此各自都需要边界清晰的谈判议程。无论美国中期选举结果如何，韩国国会与美国国会之间的交流都必须深化。可靠落实行政层级协议，需要跨党派理解和支持。韩国执政党和反对党议员应共同接触众议院和参议院的相关委员会及国会重要成员，说明军事需求、对同盟的益处、拟使用低浓缩铀的情况，以及旨在维护不扩散承诺的措施。议会外交不能止于礼节性访问。韩国代表应基于证据回答国会议员关于燃料管理、技术保护、财政责任以及相关成员国和选区工业收益的问题。韩国国会应支持政府谈判，同时严格审查预算、进度和安全安排。两党支持应伴随负责任的监督，以帮助项目持续推进。韩国还必须加强落实项目的国内机制。外交部应牵头与华盛顿开展外交谈判，国防部和国防事业厅则界定作战需求及采购时间表。核研究机构和产业界应明确研发范围和技术要求，安全监管机构应从一开始便参与。面向全政府的协调机制必须明确每项决定由谁负责以及应在何时作出，从而把谈判成果迅速转化为项目执行。燃料决定尚未作出期间，可以推进能够开展的准备工作。界定作战性能要求、落实设计人员以及准备测试和维护基础设施应同步推进，同时谨慎管理燃料决定可能引发变更的风险。政府应从设计和建造进度倒推，设定谈判里程碑，并为延误准备应急方案。政府应定期向国会报告进展和重大风险，敏感事项则采用闭门简报。同盟的可信度通过执行来体现。韩国必须为负责任的研发和有效的不扩散安排做好准备，美国则应明确履行承诺的实际路径。两国议员应跨越选举周期和政府更迭，支持这项工作。随着协议首个周年临近，首尔和华盛顿需要一份实施计划，把燃料采购和建造准备纳入同一条协调时间表。退役海军上校文根植是首尔汉阳大学公共政策研究生院杰出教授。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea added 139,000 jobs in October from a year earlier, government data showed Wednesday, with job growth exceeding the 100,000 mark for the fourth consecutive month. The number of employed people came to 29.17 million in October, compared with 29.04 million a year earlier, according to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics. Job growth turned positive in June after declining by 40,000 in May, the first drop in 17 months. The country's jobless rate came to 2 percent last month, down 0.2 percentage point from a year earlier. The number of unemployed people totaled 602,000 in October, down 56,000 from the same month in 2025. The employment rate for people aged 15 to 64 came to 70.4 percent, up 0.3 percentage point from a year earlier. The figure for those aged 15 to 29, on the other hand, fell 1.7 percentage points to 42.9 percent

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month for talks on the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), as New Delhi and Washington remain engaged for an early conclusion of the first tranche of the deal, an official said on Tuesday. Indian officials remain positive about the proposed mutually beneficial agreement and ruled out any disruption to the negotiations following the outcome of the recent US midterm elections.
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 一名美国官员周二表示，美国官员团队本月早些时候访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协定（BTA）举行会谈，新德里和华盛顿仍在努力推动尽早敲定该协议的第一批条款。印度官员对这项拟议中的互利协议持积极态度，并排除美国近期中期选举结果会干扰谈判的可能性。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: A team of US officials visited India earlier this month for talks on the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), as New Delhi and Washington remain engaged for an early conclusion of the first tranche of the deal, an official said on Tuesday. The two sides discussed issues related to customs and trade facilitation during meetings in New Delhi last week, the official said, requesting anonymity. Indian officials remain positive about the proposed mutually beneficial agreement and ruled out any disruption to the negotiations following the outcome of the recent US midterm elections. The US and India have a very consequential relationship which, apart from trade, draws strengths from economic, political and security imperatives, an official said, asking not to be named. According to trade experts, uncertainty created by Washington’s frequent trade measures and the use of tariffs as a negotiating tool had been major hurdles to signing an interim BTA, even though a preliminary draft is almost ready. The two countries issued a joint statement on February 7 outlining a framework for an interim BTA. However, the agreement was not signed after the US Supreme Court invalidated the legal basis for the preferential tariff mechanism Washington had offered, the experts said. India is now awaiting a preferential tariff framework that gives it exporters competitive access compared with exporters from competing countries, they said. The US government is also keen to finalise the agreement at the earliest, they added. In September, US Ambassador Sergio Gor said India and the United States were working to build a “fair, reciprocal and mutually beneficial” trade relationship. “The US-India relationship stands at a historic high point. Pick any sector and the United States and India are working together on it,” Gor said at the 66th annual session of the Automotive Component Manufacturers Association (ACMA) in New Delhi. HT reported it on September 3. Gor said cooperation between the two countries extended from information technology and data centres to pharmaceuticals, defence sales and military exercises. He also pointed to potential cooperation in space, citing NASA’s invitation to ISRO to participate in its Moon Base programme. India and the US have been negotiating a bilateral trade agreement since Prime Minister Narendra Modi and US President Donald Trump met in Washington on February 13, 2025. In February this year, the two countries announced that they had finalised a framework for an interim BTA. Subsequent changes to the US tariff regime, however, have affected the negotiations

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body_zh: 一名美国官员周二表示，本月初，一支美国官员团队访问印度，就拟议中的双边贸易协议（BTA）举行会谈；目前，新德里和华盛顿仍在推动尽早敲定该协议的第一阶段内容。该官员在上周于新德里举行的会议中介绍了相关情况，并要求匿名。印度官员仍对拟议中的互利协议持积极态度，并排除美国近期中期选举结果对谈判造成任何中断的可能。另一名要求匿名的官员表示，美印关系非常重要，除贸易外，这种关系还受到经济、政治和安全需要的推动。据贸易专家称，尽管初步草案已接近完成，但华盛顿频繁采取贸易措施以及把关税作为谈判工具，给签署临时BTA造成了重大障碍。专家表示，两国于2月7日发表联合声明，概述了临时BTA的框架。然而，美国最高法院裁定华盛顿所提供的优惠关税机制失去法律依据后，该协议并未签署。专家称，印度目前正等待一套优惠关税框架，使印度出口商相较于来自竞争国家的出口商获得具有竞争力的市场准入。他们补充说，美国政府也希望尽早敲定协议。9月，美国大使Sergio Gor表示，印度和美国正努力建立“公平、互惠和互利”的贸易关系。Gor在新德里举行的汽车零部件制造商协会（ACMA）第66届年会上说：“美印关系正处于历史最高点。无论选择哪个行业，美国和印度都在携手合作。”《论坛时报》于9月3日报道了此事。Gor表示，两国之间的合作涵盖信息技术、数据中心、药品、防务产品销售和军事演习等领域。他还指出双方在太空领域存在合作潜力，并提到NASA邀请印度空间研究组织（ISRO）参与其“月球基地”计划。自总理Narendra Modi与美国总统Donald Trump于2025年2月13日在华盛顿会晤以来，印度和美国一直在谈判双边贸易协议。今年2月，两国宣布已完成临时BTA框架。然而，美国关税制度随后发生的变化对谈判产生了影响
